title: Executive Director
description:
Job Summary
  
  
The Executive Director will provide strategic leadership and overall business direction for Esthetics International Group and EIG Singapore ,driving sustainable growth, business performance and operational excellence across its professional skincare, beauty, wellness and haircare portfolio.
  
  
The role will be responsible for developing and executing business strategies, overseeing commercial and business development functions, strengthening business positioning, and identifying new opportunities to expand the company's market presence.
  
  
Working closely with senior management and key stakeholders, the Executive Director will lead business transformation initiatives, support in driving group financial performance and ensure the organisation remains competitive in the evolving beauty and wellness industry.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Strategic Leadership & Business Development
  
  
Develop and execute the company's overall business strategy, long-term objectives and growth plans.
  
  
Identify new business opportunities, market segments and strategic partnerships to expand the company's presence.
  
  
Drive business expansion initiatives across professional skincare, beauty, wellness and haircare sectors.
  
  
Evaluate market trends, competitor activities and industry developments to identify opportunities for sustainable growth.
  
  
Provide strategic recommendations to the Board and senior management on business direction and investment opportunities.
  
  
2. Business & Financial Performance
  
  
Oversee the company's financial performance, including revenue growth, profitability, budgeting and cost management.
  
  
Establish business targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor organisational performance.
  
  
Drive revenue generation and improve overall business efficiency across business units.
  
  
Review financial reports and operational performance to identify areas for improvement.
  
  
Ensure effective allocation of resources to support business objectives and financial sustainability.
  
  
3. Organisational Management
  
  
Provide overall leadership and oversight of business operations, ensuring operational efficiency and service excellence.
  
  
Oversee the performance of the company's business units, including professional skincare and salon operations.
  
  
Implement policies, procedures and performance standards to support business growth.
  
  
Drive process improvements and business transformation initiatives.
  
  
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards and internal policies.
  
  
4. Brand Management & Commercial Development
  
  
Strengthen the company's brand positioning and market presence across its professional beauty and wellness portfolio.
  
  
Oversee commercial strategies for the company's retail, salon and professional distribution channels.
  
  
Develop strategic relationships with business partners, suppliers, distributors and industry stakeholders.
  
  
Identify opportunities to introduce new products, services and business concepts.
  
  
Drive marketing and commercial initiatives to enhance customer engagement, brand awareness and market competitiveness.
  
  
5. Leadership & Stakeholder Management
  
  
Lead, develop and mentor senior management teams to achieve organisational goals.
  
  
Build a high-performance culture through effective leadership, accountability and talent development.
  
  
Foster strong relationships with key business partners, customers and external stakeholders.
  
  
Represent the company in strategic business discussions, negotiations and industry engagements.
  
  
Ensure alignment across departments and business units in executing the company's strategic priorities.
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Marketing or a related discipline.
  
  
10 years of relevant senior management, corporate or leadership experience, preferably within the beauty, skincare, wellness, retail or consumer services industry.
  
  
Proven track record in business strategy, commercial development and organisational leadership.
  
  
Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, financial planning and business performance management.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple business operations.
  
  
Strong strategic thinking, business development and stakeholder management capabilities.
  
  
Excellent communication, negotiation and leadership skills.
  
  
Ability to drive business growth, manage organisational change and deliver sustainable business results.
  
  
Listed on the Main Board of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad since March 2004,
  
  
Esthetics International Group (EIG)
  
  
is one of the market leaders in the beauty and wellness industry in ASEAN and Hong Kong, with over 31 years’ experience in the Industry. EIG has an extensive distribution network of more than 1,000 independent professional salons across ASEAN and Hong Kong, and owns and operates more than 74 Aster Spring corporate outlets and kiosks in four countries in Malaysia, Singapore, Hong Kong and Thailand.
  
  
EIG is the exclusive distributor of
  
  
Dermalogica
  
  
,
  
  
Davines
  
  
,
  
  
Tisserand, Young Blood and evo
  
  
as well as develops and distributes our own Fast Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) skin care brand,
  
  
Clinelle
  
  
.
  
  
The Group has regional offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Thailand and Indonesia with the headquarters located in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.
  
  
EIG Dermal Wellness (S)
  
  
Pte Ltd and AsterSpring International (S) Pte. Ltd.
  
  
(previously known as Leonard Drake (S) Pte Ltd) are proud to be wholly owned subsidiaries of
  
  
EIG Group
  
  
. We welcome dynamic candidates to be part of our team.

title: Portfolio Revenue Director - Food & Beverage - Singapore
description:
**Introduction**

Take the lead in shaping Food and Beverage revenue strategy and performance across a diverse portfolio of hotels and outlets throughout EAPAC. This is an opportunity to influence senior stakeholders, develop regional capability and turn commercial insights into practical actions that improve revenue and profitability. You will also help expand the reach of Food and Beverage Revenue Services while leading a team committed to strong performance and continuous improvement.

**Your day to day**

* Lead Food and Beverage revenue strategy across a portfolio of hotels, restaurants, bars, spas and other ancillary revenue streams.
* Use demand, capacity, pricing, menu mix, promotional and customer data to identify opportunities that improve revenue and profitability.
* Lead performance, forecasting, budgeting and strategy reviews, working with hotel leaders and regional Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Digital and Operations teams.
* Expand the Food and Beverage Revenue Services portfolio by building strong business cases, engaging senior stakeholders and supporting the successful onboarding of new hotels.
* Lead, coach and develop the regional team while improving reporting, data quality, productivity and the use of automation, artificial intelligence and analytics.

**What we need from you**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Hospitality, Revenue Management, Business or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in hospitality, revenue management, commercial strategy or Food and Beverage leadership.
* Experience leading complex Food and Beverage revenue strategies within a hotel, cluster, portfolio or regional environment.
* Strong knowledge of forecasting, capacity optimisation, pricing, menu engineering, financial analysis and profitability.
* Proven ability to lead and develop teams, influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex commercial insights clearly.

title: Director, Product Strategy and Governance
description:
This is a unique opportunity to contribute to Manulife's product strategy and governance agenda as we continue our transformation toward a customer-segment and proposition-driven model. In this role, you will support the development of our product portfolio by leveraging data-driven insights, customer analytics and robust governance practices to help deliver solutions that make decisions easier and lives better.

You will work closely with stakeholders across Distribution, Marketing, Risk, Technology, Operations and Product teams to support how products are designed, prioritised and governed. This role offers broad exposure across the product lifecycle, providing opportunities to influence strategic initiatives, strengthen governance practices and enhance customer-centric decision making. You will gain visibility across the organisation while contributing to the evolution of Manulife's product proposition and governance capabilities.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities**

* Support the development and execution of customer-segment, persona and proposition-led product strategies through analytics, customer insights and market intelligence.
* Conduct customer, market and portfolio analyses to support product strategy, opportunity assessment and prioritisation decisions.
* Support the ongoing enhancement of the product governance framework, ensuring alignment with risk, compliance and regulatory requirements.
* Contribute to product portfolio reviews, performance monitoring and strategic planning activities.
* Partner closely with Distribution, Marketing, Legal, Risk, Finance, Technology & Operations to support successful delivery of product initiatives.
* Provide data-driven recommendations and insights to support product development and proposition decisions.
* Coordinate governance forums, audits and regulatory submissions, ensuring timely and accurate completion of deliverables.
* Identify opportunities to improve governance effectiveness and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate controls.
* Prepare analysis, management updates and recommendations for senior stakeholders and governance committees.
  

  

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in product development, product strategy, governance, customer insights, analytics or related disciplines.
* Strong understanding of customer-centric strategy, segmentation, insights and analytics-driven decision making.
* Experience in product governance, regulatory management or product development within financial services.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior stakeholders.
* Excellent analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
* Highly collaborative, adaptable and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Experience working across cross-functional teams and influencing outcomes without direct authority.
* Experience in life insurance or wealth management products preferred.
  

  

**When you join our team:**

* We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
* We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
* As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

**About Manulife and John Hancock**

Manulife Financial Corporation is a leading international financial services provider, helping people make their decisions easier and lives better. To learn more about us, visit https://www.manulife.com/en/about/our-story.html.

**Manulife is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

We strive to attract, develop and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to foster an inclusive work environment that embraces the strength of cultures and individuals. title: International Marketing Director
company: ALIBABA SOUTHEAST ASIA HOLDING PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Internal Job Title :**  
Senior Product Operation Expert
  
  
Job Description
  
  
**1. Define the regional market strategy:** Own market entry and growth across Southeast Asia. Build a tiered approach for Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore based on developer population, willingness to pay and competitive landscape, and set clear priorities, growth targets and go-to-market playbooks for each country.
  
  
**2. Build local brand awareness and share of voice:** Grow Qoder's presence on each country's leading developer communities and social platforms, such as Viblo in Vietnam and Dicoding in Indonesia, as well as Facebook tech groups, Telegram, LinkedIn, and tech content on YouTube and TikTok, which matter across the region, to raise awareness of Qoder among local developers.
  
  
**3. Build a local KOL and community network:** Identify and nurture relationships with tech KOLs, YouTubers and community leaders in each country; partner with local tech organizations such as GDG and AWS User Groups to host meetups, workshops and hackathons; and develop a network of local Qoder Ambassadors.
  
  
**4. Expand university and talent partnerships:** Engage leading universities in the region (e.g., NUS, NTU, Universitas Indonesia, Institut Teknologi Bandung, Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology, Chulalongkorn University) and coding bootcamps; launch student programs, campus ambassador programs and curriculum partnerships to win over the next generation of developers.
  
  
**5. Break into IT services and outsourcing companies:** Target large IT services and software outsourcing firms in Vietnam, the Philippines, Malaysia and beyond, as well as tech unicorns (e.g., engineering teams at Grab, GoTo and Sea); drive adoption of Qoder's Teams and Enterprise editions and build flagship local customer case studies.
  
  
**6. Drive content and product localization:** Lead localization of the product UI, documentation, tutorials and marketing content into local languages (Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese, Thai, etc.). Given Southeast Asian users' price sensitivity and preference for local payment methods, drive regional pricing and integration of local payment options (GCash, DANA, OVO, MoMo, GrabPay, etc.).
  
  
**7. Leverage ecosystem resources:** Partner with Alibaba Cloud's Southeast Asia team, local cloud providers, telecom operators, IT training institutions and government digital economy programs in each country on co-marketing and channel distribution.
  
  
**8. Represent Qoder at regional conferences and events:** Plan Qoder's participation in major Southeast Asian tech events (e.g., SuperAI Singapore, Tech in Asia, Echelon and national developer conferences) to strengthen its regional influence.
  
  
**9. Bring market insights back to HQ and ensure compliance:** Gather user needs and competitive intelligence from each market, monitor local data and privacy regulations (Singapore's PDPA, Indonesia's PDP Law, Vietnam's Personal Data Protection Decree, etc.), and feed these insights into HQ's product and strategy decisions.
  
  
Job Qualification
  
  
1. Bachelor's degree or above, with 5+ years of experience in marketing, growth or business development in Southeast Asia. Background in developer tools, SaaS, cloud computing, AI, or taking internet products global is preferred.
  
  
2. Professional working proficiency in English. Proficiency in at least one local language (Bahasa Indonesia, Vietnamese or Thai) is preferred; Chinese is a plus.
  
  
3. Deep understanding of developer ecosystems, tech communities and the digital marketing landscape across Southeast Asian countries, with experience tailoring strategies to different markets. An existing network of local KOLs, communities, universities or media is highly desirable.
  
  
4. Proven track record of taking a product or market from 0 to 1 in Southeast Asia, with quantifiable results (user growth, community size, conversion, revenue, etc.).
  
  
5. Strong ability to collaborate across countries, time zones and cultures; willing to travel frequently within the region.
  
  
6. Strong interest in AI and large language models, and eager to be a hands-on, power user of AI coding tools.

title: Director of Business Development Acquisitions and Integration
description:
The opportunity
  
  
LinkEdge is a Singapore distribution business serving consumer brands across retail and trade channels. We plan to expand into Malaysia and explore company acquisitions in Singapore and Malaysia. This role will establish and develop those initiatives while leading the commercial and operational performance of our existing Singapore business.
  
  
Reporting to the CEO, you will develop new principal partnerships, evaluate market entry and acquisition opportunities, and plan the integration of approved businesses and portfolios. You will also remain accountable for Singapore revenue, margins, operating profit, working capital and service, working closely with Finance, HR and specialist advisers.
  
  
Business development acquisitions and integration
  
  
·
  
  
Develop regional business.
  
  
Develop opportunities for new principal partnerships, distribution mandates, categories and channels. Build the Malaysia market entry strategy, assess routes to market and potential partners, and recommend a phased plan to the CEO.
  
  
·
  
  
Build an acquisition pipeline.
  
  
Establish acquisition criteria and identify potential companies in Singapore and Malaysia. Assess strategic fit, commercial potential and operating capability, and prepare initial recommendations for further evaluation.
  
  
·
  
  
Evaluate opportunities.
  
  
Coordinate commercial and operational due diligence with Finance, legal and other advisers. Assess valuation assumptions, working capital, investment needs, risks and potential benefits. Support negotiations and prepare business cases for the company's investment approval process.
  
  
·
  
  
Plan and lead integration.
  
  
Create onboarding plans for new principal portfolios and integration plans for proposed acquisitions. Lead implementation after the necessary approvals and transaction completion, covering people, customers, stock, systems, supply chain and service continuity.
  
  
·
  
  
Strengthen partnerships.
  
  
Lead joint plans and business reviews with principals and key customers. Work with the CEO on strategic relationships and major negotiations, and translate approved commitments into disciplined execution.
  
  
Commercial and operational leadership
  
  
·
  
  
Own Singapore business performance.
  
  
Lead annual plans, budgets and reviews for existing and new Singapore portfolios. Manage revenue, margins, operating costs and profitability, and take timely corrective action.
  
  
·
  
  
Deliver reliable execution.
  
  
Lead commercial, trade marketing, retail operations, supply chain and IT/data teams. Improve forecasting, inventory availability, order fulfilment, warehousing and delivery performance through coordinated planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Build a scalable organisation.
  
  
Develop accountable leaders and clear decision rights. Create repeatable onboarding processes and shared capabilities so new portfolios can be added efficiently, with dedicated resources where commercially necessary.
  
  
·
  
  
Improve decisions and productivity.
  
  
Use business analytics, dashboards, process simplification and automation to improve visibility and reduce cost to serve. Partner with Finance on working capital, controls and business performance, and with HR on capability, succession and workforce planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Maintain commercial discipline.
  
  
Protect confidential information and manage competing portfolio interests. Maintain governance, safety and service standards. Keep commercial commitments within delegated authority; acquisition and investment decisions require the relevant CEO or Board approvals.
  
  
Experience and capabilities
  
  

* At least 15 years of relevant experience in FMCG, FMEG, consumer products or distribution, including at least 5 years in senior leadership with profit and loss accountability and responsibility across multiple functions.
* A record of profitable growth, developing principal or customer partnerships, and launching or integrating new portfolios. Experience evaluating acquisitions, coordinating due diligence or integrating acquired businesses is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Singapore distribution channels and practical supply chain and retail execution experience. Knowledge of Malaysia distribution markets and market entry planning is an advantage.
* Sound commercial judgement and financial capability, including margins, trade investment, budgeting, inventory, receivables and working capital.
* Clear leadership communication, effective negotiation and the ability to develop managers, align teams and lead change in a growing business.
* A degree in business, management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What success looks like
  
  
Profitable Singapore performance; a credible Malaysia expansion plan; a qualified opportunity pipeline and sound investment recommendations; successful launches and integration of approved opportunities; dependable service; and stronger teams, working capital and productivity.
  
  
Please apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV and examples of relevant business development, operational leadership and integration experience.
  
  
LinkEdge International Pte Ltd
  
  
Where FMCG and FMEG careers accelerate.
  
  
LinkEdge International is one of Singapore's fastest-growing Go-To-Market distribution companies. We partner with world-class global FMCG and FMEG brands to deliver end-to-end distribution — retail sales, e-commerce, warehousing, transportation, merchandising and trade marketing — across 2,300+ outlets in five channels: Modern Trade, General Trade, Food Service, Specialty and eCommerce.
  
  
Founded in 2018 and led by veterans of leading multinationals, we combine MNC-grade discipline with entrepreneurial speed. Our data-driven approach to retail execution sets us apart in the market — and our people are the ones who bring it to life every day.
  
  
Why join LinkEdge?
  
  
Work with iconic brands.
  
  
Represent some of the world's most trusted FMCG and FMEG names in one of Asia's most competitive markets.
  
  
Grow faster.
  
  
In a lean, high-performance team of 130+, you'll take real ownership early — no waiting years for responsibility.
  
  
Learn from the best.
  
  
Our leadership brings decades of experience from top global companies, and we invest in developing every team member.
  
  
Be part of the growth story.
  
  
We're scaling rapidly, adding new brands, channels and capabilities — and creating new opportunities for our people as we grow.
  
  
If you're ambitious, hands-on and passionate about winning at retail, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Join us. Let's build the future of Go-To-Market distribution together.

Founded in the mid-1970s as a collective of scientists committed to developing innovative products for the life sciences industry, New England Biolabs is now a recognized world leader in the discovery and production of enzymes for molecular biology applications.

title: Client Program Director
description:
**Opportunity**

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

  

**Purpose of the Role**

The Client Program Director is the senior programme leader responsible for connecting customer strategy, operational execution, performance governance and account growth. Working across customer and company leadership, Commercial, Product, Operations, Technology and Finance, this role develops and delivers a joint programme roadmap that strengthens service continuity, supply chain visibility and measurable value creation.

  

The role requires a trusted advisor who can translate complex supply chain priorities into actionable plans and lead global, cross-functional teams through influence. Experience supporting a technology OEM, Tier 1 supplier or manufacturing-led supply chain is strongly preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Strategy and Growth**
--------------------------------

* Partner with customer and company leadership to develop the account strategy, programme roadmap and growth priorities.
* Build trusted relationships across supply chain, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, technology, finance and senior leadership.
* Translate customer requirements and market developments into integrated logistics solutions and improvement opportunities.
Support new business development, solution design and value-creation initiatives.  

  

**Operational and Programme Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Establish and govern operational KPIs, ensuring accurate reporting, clear ownership and timely corrective action.
* Lead regional and global governance forums covering performance, risks, root causes, decisions and action closure.
* Manage production-critical risks, supplier escalations, inventory concerns, transport disruptions and service failures.
* Own the programme plan and project pipeline, including scope, governance, resources, milestones, dependencies and executive reporting.
Lead the transition of new business from implementation into stable operations.  

  

**Performance and Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------

* Drive structured exception management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement across the operating model.
* Identify and deliver measurable improvements in cost, productivity, service, resilience and supply chain visibility.
* Maintain customer satisfaction and strengthen internal stakeholder engagement.
Ensure Standard Operating Procedures, billing processes and operational documentation remain accurate and controlled.  

  

**Executive Governance, Risk and Compliance**
---------------------------------------------

* Prepare monthly executive updates and lead Quarterly Business Reviews and strategic customer sessions.
* Maintain clear visibility of account performance, projects, customer sentiment, risks and value creation.
* Establish controls that minimise operational, commercial, compliance, trade-control and HSSE exposure.
Escalate material risks with clear impact assessments, ownership and mitigation plans.  

  

**Team and Community Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Support team onboarding, capability development and succession planning.
* Contribute to objective setting, coaching, recognition and performance management.
Share best practices across local, regional and global programme-management communities.  

  

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, programme management, customer operations or operational leadership.
* Proven experience leading complex customer programmes and cross-functional initiatives across multiple geographies.
* Strong capabilities in operational governance, KPI management, continuous improvement, risk mitigation and value creation.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver results within a global matrix organisation.
* Excellent relationship-management, communication, negotiation, facilitation and executive-presentation skills.
Working knowledge of Lean or business-improvement methodologies.  

  

Preferred Experience

* Experience within a technology OEM, Tier 1 supplier or manufacturing supply chain.
* Understanding of JIT/JIS operations, supplier management, production planning and plant logistics.
* Experience with production-critical logistics, multi-tier supplier networks and operational disruption management.
* Knowledge of inbound, outbound, aftermarket and supplier logistics.
* Experience in Lead Logistics, LLP/4PL, control tower or integrated supply chain environments.
* Familiarity with supply chain measures such as on-time delivery, ASN performance, supplier compliance, transit performance and inventory health.
* PMP, APICS CSCP/CLTD or Lean Six Sigma certification would be advantageous.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com .

title: GENERAL DIRECTOR
description:
百铺乐现招聘一名经验丰富的餐饮总经理,全面负责餐厅的经营管理、业务发展、财务表现及团队建设。该职位需要制定并执行经营策略,优化日常运营流程,提升服务质量及盈利能力,确保餐厅持续稳定发展。
  
  
Baipule is seeking an experienced General Manager to oversee the restaurant's overall business operations, strategic development, financial performance and team management. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies, improving operational efficiency, enhancing service standards and profitability, and ensuring sustainable business growth.
  
  
Key Responsibilities / 主要工作职责
  
  
1. 整体经营与战略管理 / Business Operations & Strategic Management
  
  
负责餐厅整体经营管理,制定年度经营计划、业务目标及发展策略。
  
  
Oversee overall restaurant operations and develop annual business plans, operational objectives and growth strategies.
  
  
监督经营绩效,分析营业收入、成本结构及市场趋势,制定改善方案。
  
  
Monitor business performance, analyse revenue, cost structures and market trends, and implement improvement initiatives.
  
  
评估业务发展机会,推动品牌推广、市场拓展及长期业务增长。
  
  
Evaluate business development opportunities and drive brand promotion, market expansion and long-term business growth.
  
  
2. 财务与成本控制 / Financial Management & Cost Control
  
  
制定及监督餐厅运营预算,管理营业收入、采购成本、人力成本及日常营运开支。
  
  
Develop and oversee operational budgets, including revenue, procurement costs, manpower expenses and daily operating expenditures.
  
  
定期分析财务及经营报告,提出提高盈利能力及成本效益的改善措施。
  
  
Review financial and operational reports regularly and recommend measures to improve profitability and cost efficiency.
  
  
监督供应商合作及采购管理,确保采购成本合理、供应稳定及产品质量符合要求。
  
  
Oversee supplier relationships and procurement activities to ensure cost efficiency, supply continuity and product quality.
  
  
3. 团队管理与人力资源规划 / Team Leadership & Human Resource Planning
  
  
领导及管理餐厅前厅与后厨团队,明确各岗位职责及工作绩效标准。
  
  
Lead and manage front-of-house and kitchen teams, establishing clear responsibilities and performance standards.
  
  
负责员工招聘规划、培训、绩效评估及团队发展,提升整体工作效率。
  
  
Oversee manpower planning, recruitment, training, performance evaluation and team development to improve overall productivity.
  
  
建立良好的内部沟通及团队合作机制,确保餐厅各部门协调运作。
  
  
Foster effective internal communication and teamwork to ensure smooth coordination across restaurant functions.
  
  
4. 服务品质与运营管理 / Service Quality & Operational Excellence
  
  
监督餐厅日常运营,确保服务流程、食品品质及顾客体验符合公司标准。
  
  
Oversee daily restaurant operations to ensure service procedures, food quality and customer experience meet company standards.
  
  
建立及优化标准操作流程(SOP),提升运营效率及服务一致性。
  
  
Develop and improve standard operating procedures (SOPs) to enhance operational efficiency and service consistency.
  
  
处理重大顾客反馈及运营问题,推动服务改善并维护餐厅品牌声誉。
  
  
Manage significant customer feedback and operational issues, implement service improvements and maintain the restaurant's brand reputation.
  
  
5. 合规管理与风险控制 / Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management
  
  
确保餐厅运营符合新加坡相关食品安全、卫生、消防、工作场所安全及雇佣法规要求。
  
  
Ensure restaurant operations comply with applicable Singapore food safety, hygiene, fire safety, workplace safety and employment regulations.
  
  
监督相关营业执照、监管要求及内部合规程序的执行情况。
  
  
Oversee compliance with applicable business licensing requirements, regulatory obligations and internal procedures.
  
  
识别及管理运营风险,建立适当的预防措施及应急处理机制。
  
  
Identify and manage operational risks, and establish appropriate preventive measures and contingency procedures.
  
  
Job Requirements / 任职要求
  
  
具备工商管理、酒店管理、餐饮管理或相关领域的文凭、学位或同等专业经验。
  
  
Diploma or degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Management or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  
  
具备至少5年餐饮、酒店或相关服务行业管理经验,其中包括团队领导或高级运营管理经验。
  
  
Minimum 5 years of management experience in the food and beverage, hospitality or related service industry, including team leadership or senior operational management experience.
  
  
熟悉餐饮企业运营管理、财务预算、成本控制及人员管理。
  
  
Strong knowledge of F&B operations, financial budgeting, cost control and manpower management.
  
  
具备良好的领导能力、沟通协调能力、商业判断力及问题解决能力。
  
  
Strong leadership, communication, coordination, commercial judgement and problem-solving skills.
  
  
了解新加坡餐饮行业相关法规、食品卫生标准及工作场所安全要求。
  
  
Knowledge of relevant Singapore F&B regulations, food hygiene standards and workplace safety requirements.
  
  
能够独立制定经营计划、监督执行进度,并对整体经营表现负责。
  
  
Ability to independently develop business plans, monitor implementation and take accountability for overall business performance.
  
  
能够根据餐厅运营需要,灵活安排工作时间,包括必要的周末及公共假期。
  
  
Ability to work flexible hours, including weekends and public holidays when required by business operations.
  
  
BAIPULE PTE. LTD.
  
  
operates
  
  
Baipule Korean-Chinese BBQ (百铺乐烤串)
  
  
, a casual dining restaurant located at 44 Mosque Street in Singapore’s Chinatown.
  
  
We specialise in Korean-Chinese style barbecue and grilled skewers, offering a variety of freshly prepared meats, skewers, cold dishes and other Asian-inspired dishes in a lively and welcoming dining environment.
  
  
At Baipule, we believe that good food goes together with good service. Our front-of-house and kitchen teams work closely together to provide customers with an enjoyable dining experience.
  
  
As our business continues to grow, we welcome motivated and responsible individuals to join our team. We value teamwork, a positive working attitude, good customer service, food quality, hygiene and workplace safety.
  
  
Join Baipule and grow with our team.
  
  
百铺乐私人有限公司(BAIPULE PTE. LTD.)
  
  
旗下经营
  
  
Baipule Korean-Chinese BBQ(百铺乐烤串)
  
  
,餐厅位于新加坡牛车水 Mosque Street,是一家以韩式及中式烧烤、烤串为特色的休闲餐饮品牌。
  
  
百铺乐提供多种新鲜制作的肉类、烤串、凉菜及亚洲风味餐点,致力于为顾客打造轻松、热闹且舒适的用餐体验。
  
  
我们相信,优质的餐饮体验不仅来自好的食物,也来自好的服务。前厅与后厨团队相互配合,共同为顾客提供高效、友善及愉快的用餐体验。
  
  
随着业务持续发展,我们欢迎积极、有责任心的伙伴加入百铺乐团队。我们重视团队合作、积极的工作态度、良好的顾客服务,以及食品品质、卫生与工作场所安全。
  
  
欢迎加入百铺乐,与我们一起成长。

title: CEO
description:
About Cloudwise
  
  
Cloudwise is a cloud services and software company that specialises in IT Service Management (ITSM), observability and AIOps. We help enterprises run complex, hybrid IT environments more reliably and efficiently. We have teams in Singapore, Hong Kong, Mainland China and the Middle East, and Singapore is our regional hub for growth across Asia Pacific and beyond.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for a Chief Executive Officer to lead our Singapore entity and drive regional growth. Reporting to the Board / Group Management, the CEO is fully accountable for the strategy, commercial results, operations and organisational development of the Singapore business. You will turn the Group’s vision into a clear regional plan, build strong client and partner relationships, and lead a lean, high-performing multinational team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategy & Business Leadership
  
  
Set and carry out the business strategy and annual operating plan for Singapore and the markets it covers, in line with Group direction.
  
  
Own full P&L responsibility, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs and cash flow.
  
  
Find and prioritise growth opportunities across industries such as financial services, telecommunications, government and large enterprises.
  
  
Commercial & Market Development
  
  
Lead the go-to-market strategy for our ITSM, observability and AIOps solutions, covering direct sales, channel partners and alliances with cloud providers.
  
  
Build and maintain relationships with key clients, strategic partners, industry bodies and government agencies.
  
  
Personally lead major deals, strategic accounts and important negotiations.
  
  
Operations & Governance
  
  
Make sure the Singapore entity complies with all corporate governance, regulatory, data protection (PDPA) and contractual requirements.
  
  
Set up sound management systems, KPIs and reporting to the Board, and present regular business reviews and forecasts.
  
  
Work with Finance, Legal and HR to manage risk, budgets and internal controls.
  
  
People & Organisation
  
  
Build, lead and develop a multi-functional team spanning sales, pre-sales, delivery, customer success and support functions.
  
  
Encourage a culture of customer focus, accountability, innovation and collaboration across offices.
  
  
Plan for key roles and develop the next generation of leaders.
  
  
Cross-regional Collaboration
  
  
Work closely with Group HQ and the regional offices in Hong Kong, China and the Middle East to align product roadmaps, share resources and deliver to clients.
  
  
Bring local market insights and customer needs back to the Group’s product and R&D teams.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  
  
At least 15 years of professional experience in enterprise software, SaaS, cloud or IT services, including at least 5 years in a General Manager, Country Manager, Managing Director or equivalent senior leadership role with full P&L responsibility.
  
  
Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations. Domain knowledge in ITSM, observability, APM, monitoring or AIOps is highly preferred.
  
  
Proven track record of growing revenue in the Asia Pacific B2B enterprise market and building channel and partner ecosystems.
  
  
Experience leading teams across countries, and working effectively in a matrix organisation with an overseas headquarters.
  
  
Strong business sense, executive presence, and communication and negotiation skills, including at C-level.
  
  
Excellent command of English. Proficiency in Mandarin is required, because the role works closely with Group HQ, colleagues and clients in Mainland China and Hong Kong.
  
  
Willing to travel regionally as business needs require.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives
  
  
【Long-term incentive / equity scheme, if applicable】
  
  
Annual leave, medical and insurance benefits
  
  
The chance to shape and scale a fast-growing AIOps business across the region
  
  
Interested candidates, please click “Apply Now” and submit your updated resume. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
  
  
Cloudwise is a pioneer vendor that provides high quality digital operation products and solutions on ITOM and ITSM. We assist in monitoring and improving business operations based on the original business service logic, and help optimize user experience.

title: [Travel Retail APAC] - Head of Retail, Aesop
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
The Head of Retail, Travel Retail APAC leads the Retail and Education functions across the region, with the ambition to elevate retail performance while protecting and strengthening the distinctive Aesop experience.
  
  
The role translates regional commercial and brand priorities into exceptional execution at the store level—building capable teams, strengthening retail productivity, and ensuring every customer encounter reflects Aesop’s approach to consultation, hospitality and product knowledge.
  
  
Reporting to the Brand Business Development & Marketing Director, you will partner closely with regional teams, retail partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to curate a consistent yet locally inspired luxury retail experience across a fast-evolving Travel Retail landscape.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Retail Strategy & Performance
* Define and lead the APAC Travel Retail strategy for retail excellence, aligned with regional business and brand priorities.
* Drive sustainable retail performance across the network, with clear focus on productivity, conversion, average transaction value, recruitment and customer engagement.
* Establish retail KPIs and routines to identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
* Partner with Commercial teams and retailers to elevate store and counter performance.
* Support new openings, renovations and strategic retail projects, ensuring operational readiness and strong execution.
* Identify opportunities to simplify ways of working and improve retail effectiveness across markets.
* Retail Experience & Excellence
* Champion a distinctive and consistent Aesop retail experience across Travel Retail APAC.
* Translate Aesop’s service philosophy into practical retail standards appropriate to the travel environment.
* Elevate consultation quality, storytelling and sensorial experience to build meaningful and lasting customer connections.
* Balance global brand principles with local and traveller relevance.
* Education & Capability Building
* Lead TRAPAC Retail Education team for Aesop and define the regional education strategy.
* Build scalable learning programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultation capability, confidence and leadership skills.
* Evolve education from training delivery towards a strategic capability-building function directly connected to retail performance.
* Establish clear learning journeys for Retail Consultants, Store Managers and field leadership.
* Develop and coach market trainers and retail leaders, creating strong capability within local teams.
* Measure the effectiveness of education through both capability and business outcomes.
* People Leadership
* Lead, inspire and develop the regional Retail and Education teams.
* Build a high-performing community of retail leaders across APAC, encouraging exchange of best practices and collective problem solving.
* Coach teams combine strong commercial acumen with considered customer experience.
* Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Cross-functional & Partner Leadership
* Act as the regional voice of Retail, bringing frontline and customer perspectives into commercial, marketing and business decisions.
* Partner closely with Business Development, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Operations and market teams to ensure integrated execution.
* Connect regional priorities with global Retail and Education direction while representing APAC Travel Retail needs and opportunities.
* Financial Stewardship & Resource Management
* A&P Governance: Oversee Retail & Education and Retail A&P budgets, ensuring strategic allocation of resources across training, stock, promoters, and incentives.
* Commercial Review: Partner with leadership on strategic financial reviews to maximize return on investment.

What We Are Looking For
  

* Significant leadership experience in Retail, Retail Excellence, Education or Commercial functions within luxury, beauty or premium consumer brands.
* Strong understanding of multi-market retail environments; Travel Retail experience is highly valued.
* Proven ability to lead both retail performance and people capability agendas.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate KPIs and consumer insights into practical retail actions.
* Demonstrated experience building and developing high-performing teams across different markets and cultures.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability, including experience working with external retail partners.
* Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Passionate about customer experience, service, education and developing people.
* Comfortable navigating complexity and building simple, scalable solutions across a diverse regional network.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success in this role means creating a Travel Retail organization where Retail and Education operate as one engine: stronger people create stronger experiences, and stronger experiences translate into sustainable commercial performance.
  
  
The Head of Retail will ultimately ensure that wherever travellers encounter Aesop across APAC, they experience the same depth of knowledge, generosity of consultation and distinctive sense of place that define the brand.

description:
About YY Circle
  
  
YY Circle is Singapore's leading AI-driven workforce and lifestyle ecosystem, connecting businesses with a large network of flexible workers through technology-enabled staffing solutions. As part of YY Force Inc. (NASDAQ: YFOR), we leverage AI, automation, and workforce technology to help businesses address labor shortages while creating income opportunities for workers.
  
  
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Head of Operations (F&B) to lead and scale our Singapore operations.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This is a rare executive leadership opportunity for a high-performing operator who thrives in fast-growth environments. You will have full ownership of Singapore's business performance, including revenue growth, operational excellence, enterprise sales, marketplace expansion, and profitability.
  
  
Reporting directly to the Group Board, you will play a critical role in shaping the future of one of Singapore's leading workforce technology platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  
Strategic Leadership & P&L Management
  
  

* Take full ownership of the Singapore business unit's profit and loss performance.
* Develop and execute strategic growth initiatives to drive revenue, market share, and profitability.
* Identify new business opportunities and expansion strategies within the workforce and staffing ecosystem.
* Build and manage annual business plans, budgets, and growth forecasts.

Enterprise Sales & Business Development
  
  

* Lead enterprise client acquisition efforts across hospitality, F&B, retail, events, logistics, and other key sectors.
* Secure long-term strategic partnerships and high-volume staffing contracts.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior corporate stakeholders and decision-makers.
* Improve fulfilment rates, service quality, and operational efficiency.
* Drive worker acquisition, retention, and engagement initiatives.
* Leverage data analytics to improve marketplace liquidity and customer experience.

Compliance & Governance
  
  

* Ensure compliance with Singapore employment regulations, MOM requirements, CPF obligations, and labor laws.
* Implement strong operational controls and governance frameworks.
* Oversee risk management, reporting, and regulatory compliance activities.

Product & Ecosystem Expansion
  
  

* Support adoption of new platform services and monetization initiatives.
* Collaborate with technology and product teams to improve platform capabilities.
* Drive growth of AI-enabled workforce solutions and emerging digital service offerings.

**Requirements:**  
**Experience:**  

* Minimum 7 years of leadership experience in high-growth technology, staffing, marketplace, logistics, or platform-based business.
* Proven experience managing P&L responsibility and scaling business operations.
* Track record of driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational excellence.

**Industry Knowledge:**  

* Strong understanding of Singapore's workforce, staffing, hospitality, retail, or platform economy sectors.

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong commercial acumen.
* Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capability.
* Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills.
* Strong analytical, operational, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.

* Executive leadership role with significant autonomy and decision-making authority.
* Opportunity to lead and scale a market-leading technology platform.
* Competitive executive compensation package.
* Performance-based profit-sharing incentives.
* Long-term equity participation linked to business performance milestones.

title: Head of Regional Security, APAC
description:
At AIG, our business spans the globe. To achieve our objectives, we must be able to navigate complex and rapidly changing landscapes with confidence.

The Senior Manager - Head of Regional Security, Asia Pacific, is based in Singapore and reports to the Director, Global Security Operations in United States. This role provides the leadership, structure, partnerships, processes, and technology needed to protect AIG employees, facilities, operations, and reputation across the region.

The role leads physical security operations and investigations across 14 countries supporting approximately 4,600 colleagues. This role serves as the senior regional security advisor, translates global security strategy and standards into effective regional execution, and ensures that emerging risks are identified, communicated, and mitigated.

The ideal candidate will bring substantial multi-country security leadership experience, strong program and people-management capability, sound business judgment, and a highly collaborative approach. AIG is seeking a leader who embraces teamwork, change, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead AIG's physical security and protective-risk program across Asia Pacific, establishing regional priorities, operating objectives, and long-term capabilities that protect employees, facilities, operations, and corporate reputation.
* Serve as the principal regional security advisor to APAC business leadership and Global Security, providing strategic counsel regarding geopolitical developments, emerging threats, security incidents, and organizational risk and exposure.
* Translate global security strategy, standards, and policies into consistent regional execution while adapting controls to local threat, regulatory, cultural, and operating environments.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a geographically dispersed regional team, establishing clear accountabilities, succession capability, and a culture of operational excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators, operational metrics, risk trends, remediation activity, project delivery, and program maturity measures to evaluate effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
* Manage regional security budgets, vendors, guard-force arrangements, contracts, service-level expectations, and capital investments to ensure effective resource allocation and measurable value.
* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with internal stakeholders, including Human Resources, Legal, Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, Communications, Technology, Resiliency, Procurement, and business leadership.
* Represent Global Security in regional enterprise initiatives, cross-functional projects, and external industry engagements, and maintain strong relationships with government, diplomatic, military, law-enforcement, and industry partners.

**Regional Security Operations & Risk Management**

* Oversee regional physical security operations, including site risk assessments, corrective-action planning, office security, guard-force delivery, and consistent application of Global Security standards.
* Maintain awareness of geopolitical, economic, social, environmental, and security developments across APAC and translate relevant intelligence into timely, actionable advice for business leaders and security stakeholders.
* Establish and maintain regional security procedures, escalation pathways, and site security profiles that support effective risk-based decision-making.
* Partner with Corporate Real Estate and Facilities on new offices, relocations, renovations, and other capital projects to embed appropriate physical security controls from design through commissioning.

**Investigations & Workplace Risk**

* Support the Global Investigations Department by leading / overseeing investigations involving theft, fraud-related physical-security matters, vandalism, burglary, workplace violence, extortion, threats, vendor misconduct, and other incidents affecting employees, clients, assets, or operations.
* Ensure investigations are supported by appropriate fact-finding, evidence gathering, interviews, case documentation, reporting, escalation, corrective actions, and lessons learned.
* Analyze incident and investigation trends to identify vulnerabilities, recurring risks, and control gaps, and recommend practical measures to reduce future losses and employee concerns.
* Partner with Human Resources, Legal, and business leadership on workplace violence prevention, sensitive employee-risk matters, and security support for workforce reductions, terminations, suspensions, and other elevated-risk actions.
* Provide Security oversight and subject-matter expertise for relevant personnel and third-party risk processes in accordance with applicable law and AIG requirements.

**Executive Protection, Travel Risk & Event Security**

* Provide regional leadership for executive protection, high-risk travel, journey management, and traveler incident response, including risk assessments, briefings, advance work, monitoring, and escalation.
* Plan and oversee proportionate security support for major corporate events, Board and executive meetings, conferences, and other elevated-risk business activities.
* Deliver concise, intelligence-led risk assessments and mitigation options that enable informed travel and business decisions without unnecessarily impeding operations.

**Security Technology & Asset Protection**

* Oversee security technology projects and lifecycle activities, including design, integration, installation, testing, maintenance, repair, and remediation.
* Partner with adjacent departments within Global Security and Corporate Real Estate, Facilities, and Information Technology teams to ensure solutions are resilient, supportable, appropriately standardized, and aligned with AIG requirements.
* Conduct or oversee site security assessments and support applicable assurance and compliance reviews, including PCI DSS-related physical security requirements where assigned.

**Training & Security Culture**

* Develop and deliver regional security awareness, crisis-readiness, workplace-violence, travel-risk, and role-specific training for employees, managers, Human Resources, incident-management teams, and local security partners.
* Promote shared ownership of security risk and ensure employees and stakeholders understand relevant procedures, reporting channels, and response expectations.

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience required; advanced degree is preferred.
* 10+ years of progressively responsible corporate, government, military, law-enforcement, intelligence, or private-sector security experience, including substantial leadership responsibility across multiple countries or jurisdictions.
* Strong drive and desire to develop and motivate teams.
* Results oriented – positive attitude – problem solver – team oriented.
* Demonstrated experience leading physical security operations, investigations, crisis management, executive protection or travel risk, security technology, and security-related projects.
* Proven ability to lead and develop geographically dispersed teams and to influence effectively in a complex matrix organization.
* Strong knowledge of the APAC geopolitical, regulatory, cultural, and security environment, with experience translating risk information into practical business decisions.
* Strong familiarity with physical security technology, including access-control systems, security video, intrusion detection, sensors, and integrated security platforms.
* Business acumen, financial discipline, vendor-management experience, and the ability to develop risk-based investment recommendations.
* Well-developed written, verbal, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including the ability to provide clear executive briefings and incident updates.
* Fluency in English is required; additional APAC language capabilities are desirable.

**Key Relationships**

**Internal Interactions**

* APAC business and functional leadership
* Corporate Functions - HR, Enterprise Resiliency, Real Estate, Facilities, Legal, Communications, Global Sourcing/Procurement
* Security Operations, Security Technology, Security Investigations, Executive Protection

**External Interactions**

* Government, diplomatic, military, law-enforcement, and emergency-management organizations
* Security Industry Community (ACGS, ASIS, OSAC, DSAC, etc.)
* Security/Crisis response vendors
* Guard-force providers, security-technology integrators, intelligence providers, crisis-response partners, and other security vendors

**Job Challenges**

* Ability to operate both strategically and operationally across a large, diverse, and rapidly changing region.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization and influence stakeholders not directly under the job holder's control.
* Ability to balance global standards with local legal, cultural, threat, and business requirements.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and communicate clearly during fast-moving incidents.
* Ability to lead across multiple time zones and maintain effective regional coverage during significant security events.

**Other Dimensions**

* This role requires periodic travel across Asia Pacific and occasional travel outside the region.
* In addition to normal office hours, the job holder will need to be flexible to work outside of core office hours (e.g. during operational support activities, conference calls with people in countries on other time zones or run with major security events as they develop

title: Operator
description:
About Us
  
  
Livestock Express is the global leader in safe livestock transportation. Our modern, purpose-built fleet of 13 vessels carries approximately 600,000 head of cattle every year for clients worldwide, with Australia our largest export market. We are committed to the highest international standards of animal welfare. From our Singapore office, we manage every aspect of our vessels in-house, including chartering, operations, ship management and QHSE.
  
  
The Role
  
  
As an Operator, you will be at the heart of our business, coordinating the daily operations of our vessels with clients, vessel command and colleagues across the company. You will manage assigned commercial contracts from start to finish, helping every voyage deliver the best possible operational and financial result.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Manage the day-to-day execution of assigned time and spot charters, making sure vessels perform in line with Charter Party terms
  
  
Stay in daily contact with vessels and key stakeholders, supporting them with operational matters and giving guidance to masters where needed
  
  
Appoint agents, plan and coordinate bunkers and give voyage instructions in line with operating procedures
  
  
Keep voyage records up to date in our operational system, including vessel positions, performance, expenses and claims, working closely with accounting team
  
  
Ensure hire and freight invoices are issued and paid correctly, prepare laytime calculations and any other receivables under the Charter Party terms.
  
  
Analyse vessel performance, voyage costs, time charter equivalents and share clear reports and recommendations with the Operations Manager and Chartering Department.
  
  
Build strong customer relationships, handle feedback and complaints promptly, and help prepare annual operational reviews with customers
  
  
Build trusted working relationships with captains and vessel teams through regular day-to-day contact
  
  
Contribute to officers’ dialogues and take on other tasks as the business requires
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
Bachelor’s degree or higher vocational qualification (preferably marine-related) or equivalent
  
  
1–2years of relevant experience in maritime operations or commercial shipping, or seagoing experience as a deck officer
  
  
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong reporting skills
  
  
Proficient in MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  
  
A proactive, organised team player who communicates clearly and stays calm under pressure
  
  
Experience with voyage administration systems is an advantage
  
  
Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Singapore
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
Join a global market leader with a clear purpose and a collaborative Singapore-based team. You will gain broad exposure across chartering, operations and ship management, with the opportunity to develop your shipping career.
  
  
Livestock Express is the global leader in safe livestock transportation. Our modern, purpose-built fleet of 13 vessels carries approximately 600,000 head of cattle every year for clients worldwide, with Australia our largest export market. We are committed to the highest international standards of animal welfare. From our Singapore office, we manage every aspect of our vessels in-house, including chartering, operations, ship management and QHSE.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
About NexGen
  
  
NexGen Concepts Pte Ltd is a Singapore based, full service digital marketing and creative agency. We deliver integrated campaigns, creative and video production, events, SEM, SEO, AEO, social media, web development and AI solutions for brands in Singapore and the region.
  
  
We also build our own products, including NexPulse (unified marketing analytics) and GiftLab (corporate gifting). We expect every team member to use AI tools to work faster and better.
  
  
The role
  
  
At NexGen, Customer Success means project management. The Customer Success Executiveturns signed work into delivered work: on time, on budget and to the brief. You plan projects, coordinate our internal teams and suppliers, keep clients updated and resolve issues before they escalate.
  
  
Our Director of Business Development and Account Manager lead the client relationship and new proposals. You own delivery.

Customer Success Lead
  
  
**Location:**  
Singapore

Full time, permanent

Turn approved scopes and quotations into project plans with milestones, owners, budgets and deadlines.
  
  
Brief department heads on each project's requirements; they assign team members, you track progress against the plan.
  
  
Run several concurrent projects across traditional work (events, print, video production) and digital work (campaigns, social, SEO, websites, AI builds).
  
  
Track timelines and budgets; flag risks early and escalate with options, not just problems.
  
  
Check deliverables against the brief before they reach the client.
  
  
Manage revision rounds within scope, approve one extra round where justified, and route anything beyond that for requoting.
  
  
Close each project with a short review of timeline, cost and client feedback.
  
  
**Responsibilities:** client communication, costing and suppliers
  
  
Be the client's day to day contact for project updates, approvals and issues.
  
  
Run status calls and send clear written updates; log every decision and change.
  
  
Resolve client issues quickly, and escalate to the Director when the relationship or revenue is at risk.
  
  
Prepare RFQs, source and compare suppliers, and agree markups with Business Development.
  
  
Manage suppliers on brief, timeline, quality and cost against the quotation.
  
  
Document change requests and pass out of scope work to Business Development for requoting.
  
  
Keep project records, files and trackers current in our project management tools.
  
  
Use AI tools for status reports, meeting notes and documentation, while checking accuracy and protecting client confidentiality.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Must have
  
  
2 to 5 years of project management or client servicing at a marketing, creative, digital or events agency.
  
  
Hands on management of several concurrent projects from brief to delivery.
  
  
Experience preparing RFQs, comparing supplier quotes and working to a project budget.
  
  
Enough understanding of how creative, digital and production work gets made to plan realistic timelines and spot problems early.
  
  
Calm, firm client communication, including saying no to out of scope requests.
  
  
Strong written English and organised documentation.
  
  
Comfort with project management tools (Asana, Monday.com or similar) and spreadsheets.
  
  
Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.
  
  
Nice to have
  
  
Experience across both traditional (events, print, video) and digital projects.
  
  
Website or app development project experience.
  
  
Agile, Scrum, PMP or PRINCE2 training.
  
  
Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin, useful for working with our regional team and clients.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
Ownership of delivery across a varied client portfolio.
  
  
Base salary of S$3500 to S$4,200 per month, depending on experience.
  
  
Work across creative, digital, events, tech and AI projects, and NexGen's own products.
  
  
Structured training in AI tools and workflows.
  
  
Leave and medical benefits in line with company policy.

title: Head of Commercial Operations, APAC

The right candidate will be as comfortable in a quarterly performance review as they are shaping a three-year automation roadmap and credible with underwriters, technology teams, and senior regional leadership alike.

Drive productivity, quality, and cost-to-serve targets.
  
  
Lead and develop a distributed team of operations managers and senior specialists, including in CBS hub teams in Philippines and KL.

Maintain clear performance frameworks that give senior stakeholders timely and accurate visibility of ops health — reporting cadences, KPIs, escalation paths

Establish baseline measurement and benefits tracking frameworks so transformation impact can be reported with confidence.

Qualifications
  
  
Essential

Strong commercial acumen; able to build, defend, and track business cases for investment.

Highly Regarded

The initial priority will be to establish a sustainable and scalable ocean freight business platform, with a clear roadmap towards commercial growth and profitability.

Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in international freight forwarding or integrated logistics, with substantial ocean freight commercial and management experience.
  
  
Proven experience in establishing, launching or significantly expanding an ocean freight business, business unit, branch or new market.
  
  
Strong end-to-end understanding of ocean freight business operations, including FCL/LCL products, carrier procurement, pricing, business development, operations and financial management.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop business strategies, build commercial and operational capabilities, establish industry partnerships and recruit high-performing teams.
  
  
Strong knowledge of the Singapore ocean freight market and regional trade lanes, with established industry relationships.
  
  
Entrepreneurial, commercially driven and hands-on, with the ability to operate effectively in a business-building environment.
  
  
Strong professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin Chinese, written and spoken, is mandatory for communication with local and international customers, business partners and SF's China headquarters.
  
  
Initial Priorities – First 12 Months

Build carrier, co-loader, overseas agent and service-provider partnerships.
  
  
Design the appropriate operating model, SOPs, pricing framework and service delivery processes.
  
  
Propose and progressively build the ocean freight team in line with approved business plans.
  
  
Establish initial customer development channels and commercial capabilities.
  
  
Define key business performance indicators and build the foundation for sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

description:
**Role Overview**

* Lead a team of Scam & Fraud Resolution Specialists with full accountability for people leadership, service delivery, operational discipline and customer outcomes across complex scam and fraud cases.
* Operate as a frontline leader who sets high standards, makes sound decisions under pressure and ensures the team delivers consistently against performance, service, regulatory and risk expectations.
Provide leadership for difficult and sensitive customer situations, including tough conversations and escalations, while driving practical solutions and partnering stakeholders to improve the end-to-end scam and fraud journey.  

**Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities**

**1. Leadership, People & Performance**

* Translate PCU priorities into measurable team and individual outcomes, with clear ownership, accountability and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach and develop the team to deliver strong customer service, quality and productivity; manage performance and succession consistently and fairly.
* Build a resilient, collaborative culture that learns from feedback, supports employee wellbeing and maintains composure in demanding situations.

**2. Operational Leadership, Governance & Risk**

* Own team KPIs and service levels, including scam transfer rate, dispute turnaround time, quality, productivity and customer outcomes; identify gaps early and drive recovery actions.
* Manage workforce deployment, shift coverage and operational readiness, including weekends and non-standard hours where required.
* Oversee complex, high-risk and sensitive cases within delegated authority, ensuring accurate handling, timely escalation and clear ownership through resolution.
* Maintain regulatory, compliance, confidentiality and operational-risk discipline, ensuring controls are applied consistently and gaps are addressed promptly.
* Use management information, customer insights and root-cause analysis to improve processes, controls and customer journeys.

**3. Customer & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Champion empathetic servicing and fair, consistent outcomes for scam and fraud victims, including vulnerable customers, ensuring they are supported with sensitivity throughout the resolution journey.
* Lead difficult customer conversations and escalated cases with composure, balancing customer needs, policy, risk considerations and the Bank’s decision framework.
* Partner Operations, Fraud, Disputes, Risk, Compliance and other business units to resolve systemic issues and deliver sustainable improvements.
Represent the team in governance forums, projects and stakeholder discussions, providing clear updates on performance, risks, decisions and follow-through.  

**Working Relationship**

* Directly reporting to Head of Scam & Fraud Relations.
* Directly leads and remains accountable for the performance, development, conduct and wellbeing of PCU – Scam & Fraud Resolution Specialists.
Works closely with Operations, Risk, Legal & Compliance, Product, Technology and other business units to manage escalations, strengthen controls and improve customer and operational outcomes.

* Tertiary Education with minimum Diploma/ Degree Holder from recognized polytechnics/ University.

* Proven ability to lead people, manage performance, handle demanding customer situations, solve problems and deliver consistently high service standards in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience in scam and fraud operations, banking products, regulatory requirements or operational risk is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.
* Must be prepared for the operational demands of the role, including shift work, weekends and non- standard working hours where rostered or business needs require. The role offers competitive compensation package commensurate with its responsibilities.
We welcome accomplished professionals seeking a career transition into banking who bring strong leadership, customer and people management, operational or service experience and are committed to learning and excelling in banking.

* Learning agility – adapts quickly and builds knowledge of banking, scam, fraud and regulatory requirements.
Collaboration and influence – works constructively across teams and communicates credibly with stakeholders at all levels.  

**Technical Competencies**

Customer Service

Regular
