title: Head of Growth Operations
description:
**First Circle** is an SME credit-centric, multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is **fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising** soon. We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve **delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses** anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.

Over the past two years we’ve **expanded our product range** to include business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.

**Our excellent track record results from our people & culture**. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we raise the bar with every hire.

### **About the Role**

We’re hiring a **Head of Growth Operations** to lead operations for our new products. This means **taking ownership** for doing whatever it takes to make these products successful. **The portfolio is growing** and responsibilities may expand over time. To start with the portfolio of new products may include corporate cards, invoice financing, business accounts and payments, and employee salary loans and payroll.

**A successful product is one that delivers great value for our customers and grows as a result**. You will be responsible for taking these new products from v1 and building them into something that our customers love and value. You will have an intimate focus on the user experience, working closely with our tech team to build and enhance our products. You will **define the processes and systems** that allow us to operate the product, trying to automate as much as possible. You will **work out the strategy to distribute the products**, working closely with our sales force. You will **build and shape a team of excellent operators**, taking on more responsibility and a broader portfolio of products as we launch more and more solutions for our customers.

The ideal candidate has **strong problem solving and analytical skills,** is a **proven operator** who knows how to make things happen, and knows what it is to build and manage a team of exceptional talent. You will be **comfortable working with data,** eager to tackle tricky problems in ambiguous circumstances, and able to partner with other people and work with senior stakeholders.

First Circle is changing small business banking in the Philippines. The sky is the limit for someone who wants to get stuck in and make a difference.

### **Role and responsibilities**

* You will **lead operations for “new products”**, including corporate cards, invoices, and payroll. More products may come under your ownership in the future. These are critical priorities for the business
* You will be the **ultimate owner for these products**, singularly focused on their successful growth. You will be responsible for delivering a great user experience, managing the day to day operations for the products, defining and executing the strategy for growth, and taking accountability for P&L
* You will **work closely with our tech and product teams,** and with all our other teams who can be a part of what it takes to grow your products (sales, marketing, finance, legal etc).
* The role will **ideally be located in the Philippines. Relocation and sponsorship is available. International remote setup is also possible**
* You will have a **high degree of exposure to leadership**, reporting directly to the Vice President of Operations

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in **Business, Economics, Management, STEM or similar field**
* Ideal candidate likely has **5-10 years experience** - but we are much more interested in trajectory and potential than years of work experience.
* The candidate will know what it is to **operate inside a business** (ideally a tech company in a fast-paced environment). Ideally the candidate will have prior experience in consulting or finance.

### **Skills**

* **Ownership mindset.** Takes accountability for business objectives and does whatever it takes to get there.
* **Strong problem-solving** and analytical skills. Ideally has experience with data and analytics tools (e.g. SQL, Python). If you don’t already have experience with SQL then you are happy and eager to learn and you are the sort of analytical individual for whom this will be easy
* **Highly practical.** Can take a problem, find a solution, and then make things happen. Able to design efficient systems and processes, with a bias for automation where possible
* Ability to **manage multiple projects** and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
* **Leadership**. Can build and shape a team, setting the bar for excellence and helping juniors grow and develop

  
**Benefits**  

* Work at a fast-growing fintech on **meaningful products** that reshape SME finance in Southeast Asia with plenty of growth opportunities
* Join a team with a **deeply collaborative culture**! Learn more here: https://www.firstcircle.ph/careers
* **Hybrid work set-up**: at least 2 days per week in our BGC (central Manila) office; remote the rest of the time.
* **Additional perks & benefits** including HMO coverage from month one, free catered lunches, MacBook Air provided, monthly fitness allowance, transportation & accommodation allowance, and more.

title: Director of Food & Beverage
description:
We are in the luxury hotel business in central Singapore; offering business and leisure travelers contemporary rooms and suites filled with opulent amenities and elegant furnishings, alongside first-rate facilities, exquisite French and local cuisines in our all-day dining restaurant, bar and a huge convention space with meeting rooms and 2 ballrooms to cater to corporate, meeting guests as well as leisure function events including weddings & dinner & dances. We represent the renowned French living and Sofitel hospitality in Singapore.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**  
Ensuring guest and employee satisfaction, while maintaining market competitiveness and exceptional financial performance.
  
  
Ensuring appropriate hiring, training, motivating, coaching, and developing of department’s team members.
  
  
Responsible for ensuring the smooth daily operation of the Food and Beverage Department.
  
  
Develop and administer the F&B budget, action plan and promotional activities of the department to stimulate sales and profit while controlling operating expenses.
  
  
Surveying, reviewing and analyzing competition, market trends, customer needs and comments in order to be proactive and adapt with business intelligence.
  
  
Evaluating changes in guest needs, the guest mix and competitive set, to recommend appropriate product/service and operational changes as necessary.
  
  
Attend and actively participate in weekly Head of Department meetings respecting the confidentiality of issues which may be discussed formally or informally.
  
  
Manage the service of food and beverage within the restaurant, café, bar, and in room dining.
  
  
Ensure cleaning and maintenance of outlets, work areas, tableware, utensils and other materials and equipment used by restaurant, bar, room service and conference areas.
  
  
Regular liaison with the Engineering Department ensuring that maintenance requests are completed quickly focusing on guest needs as a priority.
  
  
Coordinate between Conference and Events, Food & Beverage and Front Office to ensure that preparations for conference events involving Front Office/ Housekeeping have been made.
  
  
Assist in the preparation monthly restaurant, bar, and cafe reports, commenting on key performance indicators and action taken to keep on target.
  
  
Management and guidance of outlet staff under control, namely Managers, Food & Beverage Supervisors/ Team Leaders and Food and Beverage Attendants.
  
  
Prepare weekly and monthly forecasts for restaurant, bar room service and cafe areas.
  
  
Be knowledgeable of and operate within appropriate outlets and hotel liquor licensing guidelines and House Management Policies.
  
  
Any other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Position Requirements:**  
Minimum 5 - 8 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in a five star luxury setting.
  
  
Proven experience in meeting budgeted and forecasted for costs for payroll/wage costs and department costs.
  
  
Experience in managing and developing a team, including performance management, performance reviews, disciplinary procedures, creating learning and development plans, coaching etc.
  
  
Has a good understanding of luxury guest expectations and desire to meet these expectations.
  
  
Hold legislative qualifications to be eligible for the position.
  
  
Good understanding of Micros, Opera, and other relevant applications.
  
  
Project professional image at all times through personal presentation/ interpersonal skills.
  
  
Desire and ability to mentor, train and develop staff.
  
  
Has awareness of industry trends in service, product and presentation.
  
  
Initiates contacts and establishes rapport easily.
  
  
Ability to assert point of view directly yet tactfully.
  
  
Organize time and work efficiently.
  
  
Excellent numeracy, verbal and written communication skills, English essential
  
  
Appreciates and maintains an effective outlet for stress.
  
  
Aptitude for developing promotions and marketing.
  
  
Willingness to work weekends and public holidays as part of the job role.
  
  
A passion for food, wine and the culinary arts that is knowledgeable and effusive.
  
  
Has the aptitude and willingness to undertake further development with Sofitel.
  
  
Nestled amidst historic shop houses and towering skyscrapers, Sofitel Singapore City Centre is an elegantly designed 223-room luxury hotel reflecting Singapore’s rich cultural heritage with undeniable French flair.
  
  
An oasis at the heart of Tanjong Pagar, the hotel is conveniently situated just 20 minutes from Singapore’s Changi Airport, and offers gastronomic dining options including Racines, an all-day dining restaurant serving Authentic French and Local cuisine, as well as 1864, serving up cocktails and exquisite afternoon tea. The hotel boasts close to 20,000 square feet of meeting spaces across 10 flexible venues including the 600 sqm Wallich Ballroom, presenting a strategic venue of choice for MICE, business meetings, seamless soirees and the finest celebrations and weddings banquets.

title: Head of Desk
description:

If you're a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we'd love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

**Head of Desk / FX Sales Manager**

**Ebury Singapore - Office based**

**\*Exceptional on target earnings potential\***

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated and resilient leader to manage the critical operations of our domestic digital payment channels. In this fast-paced, high-impact role, you will be responsible for ensuring the seamless, 24/7 operation of vital payment ecosystems—including FAST/PayNow, GIRO, EFTPOS/NETS, and PayLah!—and driving continuous improvement to maintain DBS's operational excellence.

  

**The Commitment**

This role requires a high level of dedication to ensure the stability and reliability of our payment services. Candidates must be prepared to manage high-pressure situations, provide oversight for critical incidents, and be available to resolve operational escalations outside of standard working hours to ensure uninterrupted service for our customers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Operational Leadership:** Direct and mentor high-performing teams overseeing daily operations, settlements, and support for FAST/PayNow, GIRO, EFTPOS (including NETS Scan & Pay), Bill Payment refunds, Fund Transfers, and PayLah!.
* **Incident & Resilience Management:** Lead the response to system issues and operational disruptions. Proactively identify and mitigate risks to ensure system resilience, addressing control gaps with urgency.
* **Performance & Efficiency:** Drive process automation and improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, reduce operational costs, and optimize transaction processing.
* **SLA & Stakeholder Management:** Ensure strict adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Collaborate across cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and consistent service delivery.
* **Strategy & Documentation:** Maintain rigorous, up-to-date documentation for all processes and contribute to strategic initiatives aimed at elevating the customer experience.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Banking, Finance, Business, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

* **Payments Operations Experience:** Substantial experience in banking operations, including direct responsibility for high-volume domestic payment services such as FAST/PayNow, GIRO, EFTPOS/NETS, bill payments, fund transfers, or mobile-wallet operations.

* **People Leadership:** Proven experience leading operations teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, developing talent, and maintaining effective coverage for business-critical services.

* **Incident & Service Management:** Demonstrated ability to lead major incident response, coordinate timely escalation and recovery, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable remediation in a time-sensitive environment.

* **Risk & Controls:** Strong working knowledge of operational risk, internal controls, reconciliation, settlement, audit readiness, business continuity, and regulatory expectations relevant to payment operations.

* **Operational Performance:** Experience managing SLAs, service availability, transaction exceptions, operational capacity, and performance indicators, with a track record of improving reliability, productivity, and customer outcomes.

* **Change & Continuous Improvement:** Proven ability to deliver process improvement, automation, or transformation initiatives while maintaining operational stability and appropriate governance.

* **Stakeholder Management:** Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with technology, product, risk, compliance, finance, vendors, and senior management.

* **Availability:** Willingness and ability to provide leadership oversight for critical incidents and operational escalations outside standard working hours when required.

  

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* Experience managing sizeable or multi-disciplinary teams across operations, service management, or payment support functions.

* In-depth knowledge of Singapore’s domestic payment ecosystem, including clearing and settlement flows, scheme rules, and industry developments.

* Experience partnering with technology teams on system enhancements, production change, platform migration, or resilience improvements.

* Working knowledge of data analytics, workflow tools, or automation technologies used to monitor and improve operational performance.

title: Senior Member of Technical Staff – RRAM Technology and Architecture
description:
**About** **GlobalFoundries**

GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com .

**Introduction:**  
We are seeking a Senior Member of Technical Staff to serve as the technical authority for advanced RRAM (Resistive RAM) technology development. This role provides end ‑ to ‑ end leadership across RRAM device physics, stack engineering, bitcell and macro architecture, and test methodology optimization. The SMTS will define the long ‑ term technical roadmap for RRAM platforms and ensure successful translation from research concepts to manufacturable, high ‑ quality memory solutions for embedded and standalone applications.

This position requires deep hands ‑ on expertise combined with system ‑ level thinking, strong technical judgment, and the ability to influence cross ‑ functional teams and senior stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

***RRAM Architecture and Design Leadership***

* Define and own RRAM bitcell and macro architecture, including scaling strategies, array topology, sensing schemes, redundancy, and robustness margins.

* Lead architecture trade ‑ offs balancing performance, power, area, variability, endurance, and retention for product ‑ level requirements.

* Partner with circuit and SoC (design) teams to ensure seamless macro integration into customer designs.

***RRAM Stack and Device Technology***

* Set technical direction for RRAM stack layer optimization, including material selection, interface control, thickness scaling, and variability reduction.

* Drive deep understanding of RRAM switching physics, forming mechanisms, defect engineering, and reliability failure modes.

* Work closely with process integration teams to ensure compatibility with advanced BEOL/FEOL flows and cost ‑ effective manufacturing.

***Test, Characterization, and Reliability***

* Own definition and optimization of electrical test conditions, including forming, set/reset algorithms, read methodologies, and stress conditions.

* Define the associated RRAM ET parameters target and specification.

* Lead comprehensive DC/AC characterization, array ‑ level analysis, and qualification strategies to meet product and customer reliability requirements.

* Drive silicon learning, root ‑ cause analysis, and yield/reliability improvement based on statistical data and failure analysis.

***Program and Technical Leadership***

* Act as the primary technical decision ‑ maker for RRAM programs, resolving complex cross ‑ disciplinary trade ‑ offs.

* Guide multiple project teams from early concept through silicon validation, product qualification, and technology transfer.

* Represent RRAM technology in executive reviews, customer engagements, and technical forums.

***Talent and Knowledge Development***

* Mentor and junior engineers, building long ‑ term RRAM technical depth within the organization.

* Establish best practices, design guidelines, and institutional knowledge for scalable RRAM development.

**Required Qualifications**

* PhD or MS in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or related field with 12+ years of RRAM or emerging NVM development experience.

* Recognized expert in RRAM device physics, stack engineering, bitcell /macro design, and reliability characterization.

* Proven track record of driving RRAM technologies into silicon platforms or products.

* Strong leadership, communication, and cross ‑ functional influence skills.

As an affirmative employer, all qualified applicants are considered for employment regardless of age, ethnicity, marital status, citizenship, race, religion, political affiliation, gender, sexual orientation and medical and/or physical abilities.

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

title: Security Operations Associate, Vulnerability Management
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Vulnerability Management Operations is responsible for the firm-wide impact analysis, overall risk assessment, and coordination/communication of critical vulnerabilities identified as impacting JPMorgan Chase applications and/or infrastructure components. This function is performed globally and at the scale of which JPMC operates by coordinating a response that could be firm-wide or application specific. The team's actions are performed using a risk-based approach considering the criticality of the vulnerability and the ability for our Line of Business partners to service their clients and customers globally.
  
  
As a Security Operations Associate in Cybersecurity & Tech Controls, Vulnerabilities Management Team, you will be a key member of the Singapore team, as part of a follow-the-sun global team. You will work directly with Line of Business Application Teams, Subject Matter Experts, Production Management Teams, Product Owners, Senior Technology Management, External Vendors and Risk and Control functions. You'll be on the front lines of managing vulnerabilities by making critical decisions on the inherent risk to the infrastructure or the application itself and thus the risk to the firm clients & customers. You will be working with a highly-motivated team laser-focused on analyzing, scoping, developing and delivering solutions built to stop adversaries and strengthen our security posture. Your research and work will ensure stability and resiliency of our current technology products, emerging technology and our vast application estate. Working in tandem with various internal teams both in Cyber and various Line of Business partners, as well as technologists and innovators across our global network, by leading the positive actions that will stop adversaries and strengthen customer's confidence.  
  
**Job responsibilities**

* Review new vulnerabilities published from multiple sources and identify those that may pose risk to the firm.
* Define an accurate risk rating in line with proprietary and industry standard risk rating methodologies.
* Uses enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to accelerate security investigation triage and incident reporting, validating outputs and handling operational data according to sensitivity and security requirements.
* Document impacted assets and/or application(s) providing a detailed write up on the risk and exposure posed by vulnerabilities.
* Assess threat actor intelligence, exploit code, and/or conceptual code to determine attack vectors.
* Recommend any risk mitigation factors and define the remediation activity if known.
* Assess security researcher identified vulnerabilities to provide recommendations on remediation and identify additional risk
* Leverage AI tools to accelerate the triage and assessment of vulnerabilities, as well as improve the process workflow and documentation quality.
* Applies reuse-first, AI-assisted approaches to enhance threat detection and response playbooks, ensuring changes are validated and aligned to security and resiliency expectations.
* Drive global teams' daily workflows through case-load analysis and prioritization, while serving as the technical lead and representative on major incidents impacting the Vulnerability Management space.
* Demonstrate the ability to develop and form strong working relationships with the partnering Cybersecurity Operations functions and key technology leaders in the region.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or related disciplines
* 2+ years' experience in a Cyber Operations/Vulnerability Management role with a strong knowledge of operational processes supporting Vulnerability Management and the wider Security Operations Centre; with the ability to demonstrate comprehension of the end-to-end Vulnerability Management workflow (to include industry standards such as CVE, CPE, CVSS).
* Demonstrated experience coordinating Incident Management and/or cyber incident response, including cross-team alignment and clear stakeholder communications.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted investigation summaries and recommendations before use, escalating when uncertain and following security and data handling requirements.
* Strong and broad understanding of Cyber Security Controls (Physical, Logical, Processes and Procedures).
* Strong and broad understanding of leading vendor products/applications e.g., Oracle [Java], VMWare, F5, Citrix, Microsoft; to include product lifecycle & release schedules.
* Strong understanding of open-source software deployment, public and private cloud environments, and cyber vulnerability detection and scanning tools within large-scale technology estates.
* Experience working with data sources using SQL, JSON, APIs, and Splunk, alongside Agile practices, including managing remediation actions through an active backlog and Jira.
* Demonstrated experience using enterprise-authorized AI capabilities within the work environment to support security operations workflows with strong validation habits and awareness of data sensitivity.
* Ability to review and validate AI-assisted investigation findings and recommendations before implementation, escalating when uncertain and ensuring outcomes align to security and auditability expectations.
* Previous 24 x 7 operations experience.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Have an aptitude for Vulnerability Research and Exploit Development (either from a professional background or by demonstrating an aptitude e.g. through capture the flag challenges).
* Experience with frontier AI models and the ability to conduct AI assisted vulnerability research.
* Be operationally focused and enjoy working in a dynamic environment, with the day-to-day focus on quick and timely risk reduction activities.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**Why Join**
============

Imagine a role where you can make a tangible impact on the bank's operations and the environment. As a Corporate Real Estate professional at OCBC, you'll be responsible for ensuring our premises are safe, sustainable, and efficient. You'll be part of a team that's passionate about creating a better future for our customers, employees, and the community.

**How You Succeed**
===================

To excel in this role, you'll need to lead and manage the Bank’s office security system and infrastructure across corporate offices and branches, ensuring a secure working environment through effective deployment, operation and continuous enhancement of electronic access control and video surveillance system. This role will oversee security technology, system performance, security monitoring, analytics, and incident management while supporting CRE risk management, security governance, and operational resilience.

**What You Do**
===============

Electronic Access Control Systems (EACS)

* Oversee the management, administration, and operational effectiveness of EACS across the bank’s corporate offices and branches.
* Ensure effective management of access rights, user profiles, security zones, access privileges, and periodic access reviews.
* Establish and maintain access control procedures and governance including joiner, leaver processes.
* Monitor system performance, access exceptions, unauthorised entry attempts, and potential security breaches.
Oversee system upgrades, integration, maintenance and enhancements for critical areas, restricted zones, network equipment room, trading floors, and other sensitive facilities.  

CCTV and Video Surveillance Systems

* Lead the management and oversight of CCTV and video surveillance infrastructure across CRE-managed premises.
* Ensure appropriate camera coverage, positioning, recording quality, retention period, and system availability.
* Review surveillance effectiveness and identify blind spots or areas requiring enhanced security coverage.
* Establish protocols for video footage retrieval, review, preservation, and disclosure in accordance with internal procedures and applicable PDPA requirements
* Oversee system maintenance, upgrades integration and technology enhancements, including intelligent video analytics where appropriate.
Coordinate with internal stakeholders and relevant authorities on security investigations and footage requests.  

Security Analytics and Performance Management

* Perform regular analytics on access and CCTV data to identify access patterns, suspicious activities, recurring incidents, and potential security vulnerabilities.
* Develop security dashboard and management reports covering access exceptions, security incidents, system availability, and operational performance.
* Leverage data analytics and technology to identify emerging security risks and recommend preventive measures.
* Monitor security system performance through defined KPIs, service levels and vendor performance indicators
Drive continuous improvements through automation, intelligent monitoring, and integration of security systems.  

Security Operation and Stakeholder Management

* Establish and maintain office security operating procedures, incident escalation protocols, and response frameworks.
* Investigate and coordinate responses to security incidents, unauthorised access, break-ins, and other security related occurrences.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders including Group Risk, Group Property Management, Technology, Compliance, Data Protection, and business units.
* To provide 24/7 support when necessary.
* Manage security system vendors and service providers, including contract management, maintenance programs, service levels, and cost optimization.
* Provide technical and operational advice on security requirements for new offices, renovation projects, office relocations, and building enhancements
Ensure security by design principles are incorporated into CRE projects and workplace developments.  

CRE Risk Management and Governance

* Support CRE risk management activities, including identification, assessment, mitigation, and monitoring of operational and physical security risks.
* Maintain CRE risk registers, control documentation, include logs and relevant governance records
* Support risk and control self-assessment (RCSA), control testing, internal audits, and regulatory reviews.
* Monitor and follow up on audit findings, control gaps and remediation actions relating to CRE operations and office security.
* Support business continuity and operational resilience planning for CRE managed premises
* Review relevant procedures and control frameworks to ensure compliance with internal governance and regulatory requirements.

**Who you are**
===============

* Degree in Security Management, Engineering, Information Technology, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in office security, electronic security systems, facilities management, or security technology.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of EACS, CCTV surveillance systems and associated security technologies.
* Experience managing enterprise-level security platforms, system integrations, and security technology vendors.
* Good understanding of security analytics, incident investigation, and security risk management.
* Familiarity with PDPA requirements, information security principles, and physical security governance.
* Experience in banking or financial services industry would be an advantage.

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

OCBC’s Central Procurement Office (CPO) offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of strategic sourcing, regulatory governance, and enterprise transformation within one of Asia’s leading financial institutions.

* Lead and execute sourcing activities, including RFPs, vendor evaluations, negotiations, and contract reviews in collaboration with internal stakeholders and Legal.

* Partner with internal stakeholders to manage vendor relationships and ensure contracts are effectively leveraged across the Group.
* Lead contract negotiations and support contract lifecycle management to maximize value and minimize risk.
* Track and report sourcing outcomes, including cost savings and performance metrics, to senior management.
* Collaborate with the team to identify and implement process improvements that enhance sourcing efficiency and effectiveness.
* Proactively engage stakeholders early to align sourcing strategies with business needs and manage supply chain risks.
* Support ad-hoc procurement initiatives and cross-functional projects as required.

**Who you are**
===============

* Degree holder with more than 8 years of relevant experience in Sourcing, Vendor Management, or related fields.
* Direct experience in IT Professional Services is highly advantageous.
* Professional certifications (e.g., CIPS, CPSM) are a plus.
* Proficient in e-Procurement systems.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and resolve conflicts effectively.
* Confident in presenting to senior management and cross-functional teams.
* Strategic thinker with a process-oriented mindset and strong analytical skills.
* Skilled negotiator with a track record of delivering value through vendor engagements.
* Able to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint); experience with procurement tools is a plus.

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

This is a hybrid sales role combining **account management** of an existing book of business with **new logo acquisition** across the Japan and Korea markets. You will bring a "hunter" mindset-identifying, qualifying, and closing opportunities-while also deepening relationships within existing accounts to ensure retention and expansion. This role is central to driving CreditSights' growth engine in two of our most strategically important markets.

**Account Management**

* Manage and grow an existing book of business, working closely with Client Success Managers, product specialists, and fellow account managers to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* Drive company revenue growth while maximizing client value and embedding CreditSights into clients' workflows.

**New Business Acquisition**

* Identify and engage prospective clients across Banks, Insurers, Private Wealth, Hedge Funds, and Asset Managers.
* Develop and execute business development strategies targeting both greenspace (new logos) and whitespace (expansion within existing accounts) opportunities.
* Build and maintain a robust, well-qualified sales pipeline.

**Market Outreach & Strategy**

* Design and execute market outreach programs aligned with regional strategic priorities.
* Partner with the market development team and senior management to identify and cultivate emerging market opportunities.
* Expand your professional network through industry associations, relevant forums, and close collaboration with Marketing.

**Sales Process Management**

* Source leads, progress opportunities, and maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all sales activity and client interactions in the CRM.
* Continuously uncover new business opportunities within existing accounts across all CreditSights service lines.

title: Senior Manager, Group internal audit
description:
Be a Part of Something BIG!
  
  
The Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit – Technology is a senior specialist role within Singtel Group Internal Audit, reporting directly to the Audit director, and is responsible for providing independent, objective, and risk-based assurance over Singtel’s technology, cybersecurity, and digital environments. The Senior Manager leads and delivers complex technology and cybersecurity audits, engagements, overseeing audit planning, execution and reporting, and providing robust and evidence-based challenge to key stakeholders. The role contributes to the development of the technology audit plan and ensures audit outcomes are high quality, actionable, and support effective risk management and control improvement. Audit outputs contribute directly to management assurance, Audit Committee reporting, and regulatory disclosures. Group Internal Audit operates as a key pillar of Singtel’s corporate governance framework and reports functionally to the Singtel Group Audit Committee.
  
  
Make an Impact by
  
  
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, risk-based technology and cybersecurity audits across Singtel Group.
  
  
Develop Audit Planning Memorandums (APMs), defining audit objectives, scope, risks, and audit approach.
  
  
Design and implement audit programs and procedures aligned to Group Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
  
  
Assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls, application controls, cybersecurity controls, and technology governance frameworks.
  
  
Evaluate major technology initiatives and systems under development to ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and security-by-design.
  
  
Provide independent assurance over cybersecurity risk management, including protection of networks, cloud environments, systems, and sensitive data.
  
  
Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and Singtel policies (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, technology risk).
  
  
Identify emerging technology risks and assess Singtel’s control maturity and risk posture.
  
  
Perform control advisory reviews for significant in-flight programs and strategic initiatives where required.
  
  
Identify root causes of control deficiencies and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations.
  
  
Prepare high-quality audit reports with minimal supervision and ensure alignment and agreement of findings with senior management.
  
  
Lead audit kick-off and closing meetings with senior executives, ensuring clear communication of objectives, scope, findings, and risk implications.
  
  
Provide clear, credible challenge to senior stakeholders while maintaining strong professional relationships and audit independence.
  
  
Escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Audit Director and support Audit Committee reporting.
  
  
Coach, train, and review the work of less experienced auditors, embedding audit methodology, quality standards, and professional judgement.
  
  
Provide technical leadership in technology and cybersecurity auditing across the function.
  
  
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technology audit methodology, tools, and practices.
  
  
Oversee tracking and validation of management action plans and perform follow-up reviews to ensure timely and effective remediation.
  
  
Support annual audit planning, resource management, and prioritisation of technology audit coverage.
  
  
Contribute to ad-hoc assignments, investigations, and Audit Committee-related matters as required.
  
  
Stay current on emerging technology, cybersecurity threats, and industry developments, applying insights to strengthen audit coverage and impact.
  
  
Skills for Success
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  
  
Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CIA.
  
  
Extensive experience in technology audit, IT risk, cybersecurity, or internal audit, preferably within large, complex organisations.
  
  
Strong understanding of telecommunications, digital platforms, and large-scale technology environments.
  
  
Hands-on experience auditing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures.
  
  
Proven ability to lead complex audits and engage credibly with senior management.
  
  
Excellent analytical, report writing, and influencing skills.
  
  
Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?
  
  
Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!
  
  
The Singtel Group is Asia's leading communications group, providing a wide spectrum of multimedia and infocomms technology (ICT) solutions across 3 global business units.
  
  
Group Consumer focuses on next-generation communication, infotainment and technology services to consumers and small businesses. Group Enterprise provides innovative and comprehensive ICT solutions, i.e. satellite services, international data and managed services, cloud computing, enterprise mobility services, and end-to-end solutions. Group Digital L!fe strives to bring people together with a cutting edge mix of digital services such as NextGen TV, e-books, music, digital concierge, cloud-based gaming and hyperlocal content.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, Singtel’s 130 years of operating experience has played a pivotal role in the country’s transformation into a major communications hub. Our Australian arm, Optus is an innovative leader in integrated telecommunications. Through our strategic investments in five regional mobile operators, Telkomsel, Globe Telecom, Advanced Info Service, PBTL, and Bharti Airtel, we are a major communications player in Asia and Africa.
  
  
Singtel is the largest listed company on the Singapore Exchange by market capitalisation. We have a vast network of offices in countries and territories throughout Asia Pacific, in Europe, USA and Australia. The Group employs more than 21,000 staff worldwide and has served 468 million mobile customers globally as of 31 March 2013.

title: Director of Sales & Marketing
description:
JOB SUMMARY
  
  
Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives. Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.
  
  
CANDIDATE PROFILE
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
**Required:**  

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR
  
  

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

**Preferred:**  

* 4 year college degree.
* Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
* Lodging sales experience.
* Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

* Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.
* Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.

* Implements a seamless turnover from sales to operations and back to sales while consistently delivering high level of service.

* Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.
* Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
* Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through.

Building Successful Relationships
  
  

* Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase brand/product awareness.
* Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
* Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.
* Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
* Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
* Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Leadership
  
  

* Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue.
* Develops sales goals and strategies and verifies alignment with the brand business strategy.

title: Financial Lines Underwriting Executive
description:
About Delta
  
  
Delta Underwriting Singapore is part of Delta Insurance Group, an independent specialist Managing General Agent (MGA) founded in New Zealand in 2014. Today the Group operates across APAC.
  
  
Delta was created to meet the need for insurance in emerging and specialised areas, with risk management strategies tailored to local markets. We’re known as a specialist underwriter in Cyber, Technology and Financial Lines, and known for our thought leadership and smarter ways of underwriting.
  
  
Our Singapore team is growing, and we’re looking for an experienced underwriter to grow with us. You’ll get the agility of a close-knit local team, backed by the expertise and support of the wider Group. If you’re ready to step away from rigid hierarchies, work closely with decision-makers, see your ideas put into practice quickly and have a direct hand in shaping the business, this is the role for you.
  
  
About the role
  
  
As our Financial Lines Underwriting Executive, you’ll report to the Singapore Head of Financial Lines with a dotted reporting line to the Managing Director of Delta Underwriting Singapore.
  
  
This role suits someone who enjoys the technical side of underwriting and also wants to help grow a portfolio by building strong broker relationships and contributing new product ideas. You’ll have broad visibility across the business and real influence over how we grow.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Underwrite Financial Lines risks within delegated authority under our Lloyd’s binding authority
  
  
Analyse risk and exposure data to make sound underwriting decisions
  
  
Help shape our underwriting strategy and drive process innovation
  
  
Build and manage strong relationships with brokers and intermediaries to drive profitable growth
  
  
Support our relationships with capacity partners
  
  
Monitor portfolio performance closely
  
  
Keep systems, processes, guidelines and controls working well so we select the right risks
  
  
Promote our products with a customer-focused approach
  
  
Bring ideas for new products and improvements to our existing range
  
  
Stay ahead of legal and regulatory changes so our underwriting keeps pace
  
  
Deliver great service through fast quote turnaround and strong policy administration
  
  
Gain regional exposure across markets beyond Singapore
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
2+ years underwriting experience in Financial Lines, ideally in a Lloyd’s, MGA or insurer setting
  
  
Good knowledge of the Singapore and/or Asian Financial Lines market
  
  
An established broker network, or the drive to build one
  
  
Strong analytical skills and sound commercial judgement
  
  
Clear written and spoken communication, with confidence in negotiating
  
  
A relevant degree and/or professional qualification
  
  
About Us
  
  
Established in 2017, Delta Underwriting is the leading locally owned specialist underwriting firm and the first Financial Lines Lloyd’s Coverholder based in Singapore. We challenge the status quo by reshaping our approach to insurance through product, technology and service innovation. We currently provide insurance solutions to more than ten countries in the Asia Pacific region with Delta Insurance Group offices headquartered in New Zealand.

title: Client Account Service Executive
description:
About NexGen
  
  
NexGen Concepts Pte Ltd is a Singapore based, full service digital marketing and creative agency. We deliver integrated campaigns, creative production, SEM, SEO, AEO, social media, events, web development and AI solutions for brands in Singapore and the region.
  
  
The role
  
  
The Account Executive works directly with our Director of Business Development on NexGen's key client accounts. You prepare the insights, decks and proposals that drive client meetings, and you learn to lead parts of those meetings yourself.
  
  
This is a client facing role with a path to Account Manager. Our Customer Success team runs project timelines and day to day issues; you focus on the thinking, the materials and the client relationship.
  
  
**Reports to:**  
Director of Business Development
  
  
**Location:**  
Singapore
  
  
**Employment type:**  
Full time, permanent
  
  
**Responsibilities:** client meetings and insights
  
  
Prepare agendas, decks and briefing notes for client meetings, and attend alongside the Director.
  
  
Pull campaign data from our reporting tools and draft insight summaries: what is working, what is not, and what to try next.
  
  
Research each client's market, competitors and trends ahead of reviews.
  
  
Take clear meeting notes, and send follow ups and action points within one working day.
  
  
Present selected sections of client meetings as you grow, such as performance updates.
  
  
Use AI tools to speed up research, drafting and reporting, while checking every figure and protecting client confidentiality.
  
  
**Responsibilities:** proposals and account growth
  
  
Draft proposals, credentials decks and pitch materials based on the Director's direction.
  
  
Spot upsell opportunities in client conversations and data, and flag them to the Director.
  
  
Keep the CRM, pipeline and account plans accurate and current.
  
  
Build good working relationships with each client's day to day contacts.
  
  
Pass delivery issues and timeline requests to Customer Success, and keep the Director informed.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Must have
  
  
A diploma or degree in marketing, business, communications or a related field.
  
  
0 to 2 years in an agency, marketing or client facing role; fresh graduates welcome.
  
  
**Strong written English:** you can turn messy information into a clear slide or email.
  
  
**Comfort with numbers:** you can read a campaign report and explain what changed and why.
  
  
Good working knowledge of PowerPoint or Google Slides, and Excel or Google Sheets.
  
  
A basic understanding of paid ads, social media, SEO and websites.
  
  
Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.
  
  
Organised and reliable, with follow through on every action point.
  
  
Nice to have
  
  
An internship or role at a marketing, creative or digital agency.
  
  
Hands on experience with GA4, Meta Ads Manager or Google Ads.
  
  
Canva or similar tools for quick visual work.
  
  
Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin, useful for working with our regional team and clients.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
Direct mentorship from the Director of Business Development, in real client meetings from your first month.
  
  
Base salary of S$2,800 to S$3,200 per month, depending on experience.
  
  
A path to Account Manager as your client skills grow.
  
  
Varied work across creative, digital, tech and AI projects, and NexGen's own products.
  
  
Structured training in AI tools and workflows.
  
  
Leave and medical benefits in line with company policy.

Reporting to the Commercial Director, the successful candidate will lead technical service and application support across India, ASEAN and ANZ, working with customers in Home Care, Industrial & Institutional (I&I) Cleaning and adjacent Personal Care markets.
  
  
This is a customer-facing regional role for a Technical Service or Application Manager who can turn formulation know-how into commercial wins, working closely with sales and marketing teams to grow the business across the region.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Regional Technical Leadership: Lead technical service and application support for Home Care and I&I Cleaning customers across India, ASEAN and ANZ.
* Customer Technical Support: Partner with customers on product selection, formulation development, optimisation and troubleshooting for detergents, surface care, fabric care and cleaning applications.
* Application Development: Drive application and formulation work, lab evaluations, performance testing and customer trials to support new business and product launches.
* Commercial Partnership: Work alongside the commercial team to identify opportunities, support key accounts and convert technical projects into revenue.

description:

**Starting date:** 5 January 2027
  
  
From Tuesday to Saturday 9.30 to 18.30
  
  
Apply by 6 December 2026
  
  
**To Executive Director:** aude-emeline.loriot@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
**Barbara Chan:** finance-HR@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
**Virgile Prodhomme :** directorofstudies@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
Alliance Française de Singapour was founded in 1949. It is a non-profit educational and cultural organization, affiliated to the international network of Alliance Française. With more than 800 locations in 132 countries, the Alliance Française is undoubtedly the world’s largest network of any cultural association; it serves and gathers worldwide a multilingual and multicultural community of Francophiles.
  
  
Each year, Alliance Française de Singapour welcomes around 4,000 members of all ages (from 1 year old onwards) eager to learn the French language and explore French culture. It is also hosting the General Delegation of the Alliance Française in South East Asia, making it the flagship of the region.
  
  
For many years, Alliance Française de Singapour has offered a great array of cinema and performing arts events in its theatre as well as various visual art exhibitions in
  
  
la galerie
  
  
becoming a renowned cultural destination.
  
  
In the buzzing evolving Singaporean cultural landscape, Alliance Française continues to contribute in its modest fashion to the regional influence of the cultural scene of the City-State by positioning itself as a place of cultural expression for emerging artists of all disciplines. It articulates its cultural programming around five major events: the Francophonie Festival in March, the French Animation Film Festival in May, the International Music Day in June, the French Film Festival in November and the Fashion Artisan Week in December. Added to these major events are many other regular cultural
  
  
rendez-vous
  
  
: the Ciné-Club, the Ciné-Kids, the Ciné-Plus and the storytelling in
  
  
la médiathèque
  
  
. Alliance Française also organizes social events (Bastille Day, French Friday) where our students and public can enjoy a taste of French flavors while using the French language.
  
  
Most of our events are organized in partnership with the unfailing support of the French Embassy/Institut Français Singapour and local partners.
  
  
Alliance Française cultural and educational programming is extremely rich and coherent in achieving its goal: to create a desire of France (and French) to an everlasting greater community of people whose strength is built from crosscultural understanding which is at the heart of all dialogue.

title: Engineering Director, APAC
description:
Global Switch are recruiting for an Engineering Director, based in Singapore, who will set the strategic direction and provide accountable leadership for engineering delivery across Global Switch’s data centre portfolio across Asia Pacific. This is an exciting time within Global Switch as we expand our presence in Asia Pacific with new data centres planned in Johor, Malaysia and Bangkok, Thailand. These will sit alongside our existing best-in-class data centres in Singapore and Hong Kong. You will ensure our engineering designs, standards and practices deliver resilient, cost-effective and sustainable infrastructure that supports our business objectives and evolving customer needs. Working closely with Operations, Projects and external partners, you will translate complex engineering challenges into clear, commercially sound decisions, optimise total cost of ownership and embed innovation across power, cooling and critical infrastructure systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic and technical oversight of engineering designs, client briefs and infrastructure assessments, ensuring risks, defects and Single Points of Failure are identified and effectively addressed.
* Partner with Operations, Projects, OEMs and external specialists to improve resilience, maintenance outcomes and procurement, with a strong focus on whole-life cost, technical quality and operational performance.
* Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing engineering team, creating clear accountability and a collaborative culture that can deliver confidently through change, complexity and ambiguity.
* Drive sustainability, innovation and continuous improvement across power, cooling and critical infrastructure, improving energy and water efficiency, strengthening engineering governance and embedding lessons learned across future projects.

**About you**  
  
You are an accomplished engineering leader with the technical credibility, commercial judgement and strategic perspective to influence at senior level. You can balance long-term engineering strategy with practical delivery, bringing clarity to complex technical issues and building strong relationships across functions, regions and cultures. You take ownership, remain composed under pressure and create an environment in which people are encouraged to collaborate, innovate and continuously improve.  
  
**Key Requirements:**

* Significant senior engineering leadership experience within data centres, mission-critical infrastructure or another complex, highly regulated engineering environment.
* Deep technical understanding of critical infrastructure design, power and cooling systems, infrastructure resilience, defect remediation and engineering risk management.
* A strong track record of leading and developing engineering teams, setting clear standards and driving performance, accountability and cultural change.
* Strong commercial awareness, including experience of procurement, OEM and supplier relationships, capital investment decisions and total cost of ownership.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly, influence without formal authority and align regional delivery with global strategy.

**About Global Switch**  
Global Switch is a trusted name in the industry, with over 25 years of experience and a commitment to long-term partnerships and sustainability.  
  
We value excellence and teamwork, and we always strive to deliver the best customer service and satisfaction. We are a team of skilled and passionate professionals, proud of who we are and what we do. Joining us means becoming part of a team that values learning and growth.  
  
**As an equal-opportunity employer, Global Switch is committed to providing a working culture that values diversity and inclusion and is committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a barrier-free recruitment process and working environment.**

title: Response Operations Manager
description:
**About Blackpanda**

Somewhere in Singapore tonight, a server room is on fire. Not literally, though sometimes it might as well be. A ransomware note is blinking on a managing director's screen in a tower above Raffles Place. A family office in Paya Lebar is locked out of its own ledgers. A trading desk in MBFC is running orders on paper. Somewhere a CIO is staring at the ceiling at three in the morning, wondering who to call.

That call comes to us.

Blackpanda is Asia's premier cyber crisis response firm: Lloyd's of London-accredited, regionally headquartered, and built for one purpose, to walk in when the worst has already happened and walk out leaving the company still on its feet. We do incident response and digital forensics. We are pure IR, and we like it that way.

**Three channels, one operating force.** We reach the market in three ways, and every channel feeds the same unit.

* **Consulting.** Hourly, senior-led engagements for enterprises and board-level matters where complexity, sensitivity, or scale demand our most experienced operators.
* **IR-1.** Our proprietary fixed-cost subscription, sold through IT channels and underwritten on our own insurance paper. IR-1 puts a real response solution in the hands of mid-market and small companies, paid up front, before the breach, with our team on the other end of every activation.
* **Traditional cyber insurance.** Full-stack policies for the mature, board-level buyer, with our response practice on the inside of every claim. Not a panel. Not a vendor. Our own people.
  

**The Cyber In-Extremis Force.** At the centre of everything is the CIF. In extremis describes the moment a situation has moved beyond the tolerance of conventional units. In-extremis forces are the no-fail option. Blackpanda was founded by three former operators of the Commander's In-Extremis Force, and they are building the cyber equivalent the only way they know how: same standards, same discipline, same refusal to compromise on who gets to wear the patch.

Every responder on the CIF roster holds, or is actively earning, multiple SANS Institute certifications. The company pays for the coursework and the certifications. By the end of 2026, Blackpanda expects to field 25 full-time incident responders, by a wide margin the largest pure-IR team in Asia-Pacific and Japan.

**Our Core Values**

  

* **Sincerity:** If we say we'll do it, it's as good as done. In combat, you have to know your right flank will be there at 0200 when they said they would. The work is the same.
* **Unity:** Debate fiercely, then commit fully. We all row in the same direction.
* **Efficiency:** Timing beats speed, precision beats power, leverage beats strength.
* **Humility:** Humility forms the basis of honor. We listen, then we act, then we listen again.
* **Grit:** We don't sugarcoat setbacks or bad news. We face challenges head-on and we don't quit when it gets hard.

**Our Mission:** To provide digital emergency response to everyone.

**Our Vision:** Accessing cyber incident response is as universally accessible as dialing 9-1-1.

  

**What we are looking for**

The Response Operations Manager is the operational nexus of the Cyber In-Extremis Force. Reporting to the VP of Response and working hand-in-hand with the Executive Director of Response, you take every piece of administration, scheduling, reporting and cross-functional coordination off the shoulders of Response leadership and the responders, so they can spend their hours where they matter: on the keyboard, in front of clients, and in the war room.

Work reaches Response from every direction: IR-1 activations, ODIR consulting engagements, insurance claims, and IRR proactive readiness consulting. You make sure each piece of that work is received, staffed, tracked, handed off and closed cleanly, and that every other function in the company (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Technology, Insurance, People & Culture and Finance) has one reliable point of contact into Response.

You own the operating rhythm of the unit. You prepare the agendas, data and reporting packs for the weekly Response Operations sync with the C-Suite, the Directors' Weekly Meeting, and every internal operational meeting Response runs. You run the triage rotations, leave plans and overtime records. You keep the CIF training pipeline moving, from Immersive rotations through to SANS certifications, and you make sure performance reviews happen on time and to standard.

This is not a responder role, and you will not be expected to run investigations. You need to understand how incident response works well enough to know what a responder needs, when, and from whom. If you have run operations for a consulting, DFIR, MSSP or other high-tempo professional services team and want to build the operating backbone of the largest pure-IR team in APJ, we want to talk.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**

**Engagement Intake and Response Operations**

  

* Act as the single intake and tracking point for all work entering Response: IR-1 activations, ODIR engagements, insurance claim activations, and IRR readiness consulting.
* Maintain the Response engagement tracker: case numbering, client, contract type, entitlements, assigned responders, status, hours and SLA clocks.
* Confirm, before work starts, what the contract entitles the client to (IR-1 tier, retainer hours, insurance policy limits, statement of work), and flag scope or entitlement gaps to Response leadership.
* Track IR-1 activation and response SLAs and escalate early when a clock is at risk.
* Run case closure: deliverables issued, hours finalised, evidence retention and disposal logged, lessons learned captured, and client feedback requested.

**Reporting, Metrics and Operating Rhythm**

  

* Own the agenda, pre-reads, data pack and action log for the weekly Response Operations sync with the C-Suite, the Directors' Weekly Meeting, and all internal Response operational meetings.
* Build and maintain Response metrics: engagement volume by channel, SLA adherence, utilisation, billable versus non-billable hours, overtime, subcontractor usage, training progress and review completion.
* Track decisions and due-outs from each meeting and chase them to closure.
* Turn raw data into clear reporting the C-Suite can act on, and flag trends (capacity strain, margin leakage, SLA risk) before they become problems.

**Scheduling, Capacity and Rotations**

  

* Build and publish the triage and on-call rotation across Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, the Philippines and Malaysia, covering time zones and public holidays.
* Maintain the Response leave plan and make sure coverage holds before leave is approved.
* Record overtime and out-of-hours work, and track time-in-lieu and fatigue across the team so workloads stay sustainable.
* Forecast capacity against pipeline and contracted demand, and give Response leadership the data to decide when to hire, when to use subcontractors, and when to push back on new work.

**Training, Certification and CIF Readiness**

  

* Own each responder's training plan, scheduling Immersive Labs rotations and tracking progress toward their SANS certification pathway.
* Coordinate SANS course enrolment, exam scheduling and training budget usage, including the 12-month retention requirement.
* Maintain the CIF certification register (who holds what, expiry and renewal dates) for internal planning, client proposals, insurance panels and audits.
* Report training progress to Response leadership and flag anyone falling behind their pathway.

**Performance and People Administration**

  

* Run the performance review calendar for Response with People & Culture: reminders, templates, deadlines and completion tracking.
* Check that reviews are completed to standard, on time, and catalogued correctly in the HR system.
* Coordinate responder onboarding and offboarding with People & Culture and IT, including equipment, tool access, training enrolment and access revocation.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

  

You are Response's one point of contact for every other function.

* Sales  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder triage schedules and availability; scheduling responders for pre-sales calls, scoping and proposal support
* Legal  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Collaborate with the Legal department to facilitate Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and Master Services Agreements (MSAs) tailored to response engagements. Document and oversee contractual obligations and stipulations that impact service delivery protocols per agreement.
* Marketing  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder input for thought leadership articles, technical review of marketing materials, event and speaking engagements, and case study pipeline from closed engagements
* Customer Success  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Which work is coming into Response under which contract; clean operational handoff by connecting the right responders with the right Customer Success owner
* Technology  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Response tooling requirements; contracting, onboarding and licence renewals for tools and platforms, including Immersive Labs and other training requirements
* Insurance  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Readiness consulting services that support Insurance; activation of insurance claims and the Response work they require
* People & Culture  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder time for interviews and hiring; JD creation and approvals; IR subcontractor rotation and usage; onboarding responders with IT and into the company
* Finance  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Billable hours, timesheet compliance, and the metrics Finance needs for invoicing, WIP and margin reporting

**Subcontractors, Vendors and Tools**

  

* Maintain the IR subcontractor bench: onboarding, NDAs, rates, purchase orders, timesheets and quality feedback.
* Rotate subcontractor usage fairly and in line with what Response leadership approves, and track subcontractor spend against budget.
* Track Response tool licences, renewals and costs, and support procurement with Technology and Finance.
* Coordinate deployment logistics for on-site work: travel, visas, forensic kit and hardware inventory.

**Process, Compliance and Continuous Improvement**

  

* Document and maintain Response operating procedures and runbooks in Confluence.
* Support client and regulatory audit requests for Response (evidence handling records, staff vetting, certifications, on-premise requirements).
* Look for administrative work that can be automated, and use Blackpanda's approved AI tools to remove it.
  

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Minimum Requirements**

  

* 5+ years in operations, PMO, resource management or business operations, with at least 2 years supporting a consulting, DFIR, MSSP, legal, or other client-facing professional services team.
* Proven experience running scheduling, rotations and capacity planning for a team of 15 or more billable professionals.
* Strong reporting skills: able to build metrics, dashboards and leadership packs from raw data in spreadsheets and business systems.
* Experience running a leadership operating rhythm: agendas, pre-reads, action logs and follow-through.
* Working understanding of cybersecurity and incident response, enough to speak the language of responders and judge urgency, without needing to be a practitioner.
* Comfortable working across many functions at once, and able to say no, escalate, and hold people to deadlines, including senior stakeholders.
* Hands-on with modern work tools (Jira, Confluence, a CRM such as HubSpot, an HRIS such as BambooHR, Google Workspace), and keen to automate repetitive work with AI.
* Precise, organised communicator in written and spoken English.
* Calm under pressure, with the discretion to handle confidential client and incident information.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in a 24/7 or on-call operations environment (incident response, SOC, emergency services, military operations or similar) at company-level size leadership levels (100+ personnel).
* Exposure to cyber insurance claims workflows, MSP channels, or subscription service delivery.
* Experience managing subcontractors or vendor rosters, including rates, POs and timesheets.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma.
* Mandarin, Japanese, Cantonese, Tagalog or Malay, in addition to English.
  

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days**

  

* One engagement tracker covering every IR-1, ODIR, insurance and IRR engagement, owned by you and trusted by Response leadership.
* Weekly Response Operations and Directors' meeting packs issued on time, every week, with a live action log.
* Triage rotation, leave plan and overtime records published and current.
* Training plan and certification register in place for every responder.

**First 12 months**

  

* 100% of performance reviews in Response completed on time and catalogued with People & Culture.
* Every responder on track against their Immersive and SANS pathway, with exceptions flagged early.
* Timesheet compliance and billable hours data that Finance can invoice from without rework.
* Response leadership spending measurably less time on scheduling, admin and internal coordination.
* Documented Response operating procedures in Confluence, and at least two administrative workflows automated.
  

**What we offer**

* 40 days paid leave per year inclusive of public holidays, which may be taken at the discretion of the employee subject to compliance with our Leave Policy and the approval of their manager.
* Limited Work From Anywhere policy allotment, allowing for work from alternate locations contingent upon coverage provided by teammates and approved by manager for 5 days per quarter.
* Enrolment in the company's comprehensive corporate health plan that includes a large direct billing network for medical and dental coverage.
* Opportunities for inter-office travel, including a required annual week-long Tribe Onsite meet-up.
* $5,000 USD/year professional training budget, contingent on approval from manager, with a 12-month retention requirement.
* Competitive base salary with performance-based variable compensation, plus equity participation in Blackpanda's growth.
  

**Declamation**

Candidates who successfully pass the Interview stage may be required to complete a Case Study, used to evaluate their knowledge and application of their skills in practical scenarios relevant to the role.

Blackpanda is committed to building a culturally diverse company, and we value a broad set of opinions in our team. As we grow, we are looking to build a team with a range of viewpoints at its core, and we encourage applications from minority candidates and all genders however you identify (X/F/M).

Blackpanda does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. We will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited candidates submitted by recruiters with whom we have not established explicit, written agreements for our job vacancies. By submitting any candidate information, recruiters agree to forfeit any claim to fees should their candidate be hired without an established agreement with Blackpanda.

title: Project Procurement Manager, Process Excellence
description:
Bring more to life.
  
  
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Leica Microsystems, one of

which makes everything possible.

The role ensures that sourcing requirements are integrated early into product development while strengthening standardized, scalable, and compliant ways of working across Global Sourcing.
  
  
Acting as a cross-functional interface across R&D, Project Management, Operations, Quality, Commodity Management, Finance, Legal, IT, Audit, and DBS, the role combines hands-on project procurement execution with global process ownership and continuous improvement.
