title: Director, Field Sales Operations
description:
Enterprise AI is moving from pilots to production, and the constraint is no longer the model — it's the data. Agents are only as good as what they can sense, trust, and act on in the moment, and real-time, event-driven data is becoming the foundation every serious AI system runs on.

  

Solace is the leading real-time data platform for the enterprise AI era. Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

**About the Role**

As our Director of Sales Operations, you will drive processes and insights that help our sales team grow revenue and productivity. You will lead Field sales operations and partner closely with sales, marketing, finance and other members of the global sales operations team.

This role reports to the global leader for Business Operations who is based in Ottawa with business guidance from the CRO who is based in Singapore.

  

This role is based in Singapore where we have a large regional office.

**The Ideal Candidate**

* You know how to turn data-based insights into executable sales actions.
* You are a problem solver.
* You have built sales operations at a growing technology company and know how to handle change as the business scales.
* Your cross-functional colleagues see you as a trusted partner, not a gatekeeper.

  

**What You’ll Bring to the Role**

You will focus on a number of priorities with sales leadership.

  

* **Sales Territory Planning and Execution:** you will work with sales leadership on — sales territory design and implementation along with territory goals. You will automate the biannual Plan to Make Plan process - track next steps and key territory actions. Derive insights for account coverage, net new contacts and sales activity.
* **Sales Productivity:** you will help instrument and institutionalise Sales dashboards, and other productivity tools, and the use of them at the sales territory level with HQ team. Coach leaders and AMs, SEs, SDRs on the use of these tools.
* **Sales Outcomes and Pipeline creation and progression:** you will help execute, and instrument, our Sales / Industry Plays management system and sales pipeline outcomes. You will work with sakes leadership on sales progression actions and initiatives.
* **Sales Onboarding:** you will work with our field leadership team to accelerate onboarding and productivity for Sales, SE and SDR hiring progression with a focus on speeding up the onboarding process including “Buddy” program outcomes.
* **Sales Enablement:** you will be a team member of the central team driving our global Enablement agenda so that new sales team members ran quickly.
* **Pipeline Initiatives:** you will be a Field “central” gearbox for all key initiatives launched by other Solace teams such as Solace Ambassador, Product updates, Developer Workshops and others.
* **Sales Management calendar:** you will run the regular sales management calendar which includes the sales forecasting process and pipeline reviews to the weekly and quarterly forecast. You will help define the metrics that matter most, such as pipeline coverage, conversion, activity levels, and turn them into dashboards and clear recommendations.

  

**Required Skills**

* 8 or more years in sales operations, revenue operations or a related field, including at least 3 years leading a team, ideally at a growth-stage technology company.
* Hands-on expertise with a major CRM such as Salesforce, plus experience with sales engagement, forecasting and business intelligence tools.
* A track record of running forecasting, territory and quota planning, and sales compensation processes.
* Good knowledge of MEDDPICC sales process.
* Strong analytical skills: you are comfortable building models, finding the story in the data and presenting it to executives.
* Experience designing scalable processes and rolling out change across sales teams without slowing them down.
* Excellent communication and relationship skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and work across departments.
* Experience supporting sales teams in more than one country
* A bachelor's degree in business, finance, analytics or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  

**Desired Skills**

* Experience in the software or high-tech industry, including subscription and recurring revenue models.
* Experience with a revenue operations function that spans sales, marketing and customer success.
* Familiarity with CPQ, deal desk and contract management processes.
* An MBA or relevant certification, such as in Salesforce administration or revenue operations.

  

**Why You’ll Love Working at Solace**

At Solace, we’re all about smart people, meaningful work, and good vibes.

* **Work with brilliance** – Our team is packed with some of the sharpest minds in the industry.
* **Balance matters** – We believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around.
* **Hybrid-first** – Flexibility is built into how we work, so everyone feels included and empowered.
* **Values-driven** – We live and breathe our core values: craftsmanship, trust, courage, freedom, momentum, humility, and human experience.
* **Growth mindset** – Our training programs are designed to help you level up, fast.
* **Customer Obsessed** – We’re proud of our world-class customer lineup (we’re not shy about it).
* **Keep it fun** – We’re social, we keep things simple, and we know how to have a good time.
* **Creative culture** – We’ve got a great sense of humour and we make cool videos on topics like MITT and this (check them out!).

  

**At Solace, we are committed to a fair, inclusive, and transparent recruitment process.**  
To help identify candidates whose qualifications best align with the role, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools during the initial stage of resume screening. These tools compare submitted resumes to the job description, focusing on education, experience, and skills.

  

Importantly, all decisions beyond this initial screening—including interviews and final hiring—are made by our human recruitment team. AI is never used to make final hiring decisions.

  

**Let’s Talk**

Not sure you meet every requirement? That’s okay — we’re more interested in your potential and passion. If this role excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

  

Need accommodations during the hiring process? Just let us know — we’re here to support you.

  

Thanks to everyone who applies! While we wish we could connect with every candidate, only those selected to move forward will be contacted.

  

At Solace, we believe that diversity and inclusion drive innovation and growth, both in business and in life. We strive to create an enriching and safe workplace where you can be who you are. If you want to do the best work of your career and feel supported every step of the way, we encourage you to join us!

Posting Start Date: 19/11/2026

Posting End Date: 30/11/2026

Division: BT International

Job Location: Marina One East Tower

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**About the role**
------------------

The role holder is responsible for driving substantial sales growth across strategic and high-potential customers in the South East Asia region. This includes both MNCs headquartered in Singapore (A-Ends) and inbound MNCs (B-Ends).

  

ASEAN is the world’s fifth-largest economy, and is on track to become the fourth-largest by 2030. Singapore sits at the heart of this growth, home to over 5,000 multinational corporations that use it as a base for their regional and global operations. These MNCs are undergoing rapid digital transformation - driven by rapid advancements in AI, infrastructure upgrades, and sustainability priorities - creating both disruption and opportunity for innovative solutions.

  

Against this backdrop, Singapore has been identified to be a Key Market for BT International, and is home to key strategic customers, as well as HiPo accounts, across industries such as BFSI, Manufacturing, FMCG.

  

The role holder will: (1) lead client engagement across existing strategic customers to retain and grow our Share of Wallet with the customer, and (2) lead the pursuit of acquisition customers. All activities will need to be strongly underpinned by BT International’s GTM Strategy and the associated sales initiatives (e.g. HiPo Program, Account Growth Plans, etc.).

  

Why join this role? Make your mark by opening new enterprise relationships in Singapore and turning customer transformation priorities into business wins. The opportunity combines prospecting, relationship-building and complex solution selling, with Secure Connectivity and Digital Workplace at the heart of the customer conversation. It is a role for someone who wants to create opportunities, shape the pursuit and see the deal through—not simply inherit a portfolio.

  

Success will be measured through incremental sales margin (ICGM), revenue growth, and other key metrics such as recurring revenue and profit, in line with the Financial Year Payplan Structure.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

This role is all about building and growing pipeline across the direct channel in Singapore, through a two-pronged approach:

  

**Existing Strategic Customers**

* Hunt for growth within existing accounts, driving year-on-year expansion through upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned to BT’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and HiPo criteria, with a sharp focus on Secure Connectivity and Digital Workplace.
* Deepen client engagement and build trusted relationships that deliver measurable satisfaction, reflected in strong NPS scores and Gartner Peer Insight reviews.
* Partner across teams and with external stakeholders to deliver winning, profitable outcomes for customers and BT.
* Take full ownership of your accounts in Salesforce - keeping data accurate, forecasts reliable, and visibility strong on Revenue and EBITDA.
* Shape and execute proactive account plans that unlock new opportunities, expand services, and strengthen BT’s footprint.
* Build influence across key networks and use innovative approaches to spark fresh conversations and introduce new services.
  

**Acquisition Customers**

* Hunt for new growth by identifying high-potential target accounts aligned to BT’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
* Research prospects in depth to uncover their IT and business priorities, assess existing BT touchpoints and map the decision-making landscape. Qualify opportunities against a clear customer need, a credible sponsor, the funding path, the buying process and timing, and BT’s ability to compete and deliver.

* Build and nurture long-term relationships with decision-makers, confidently handling objections and articulating compelling use cases.
* Develop targeted hunting plans that map out priority deals to pursue, the competitive landscape, key decision-maker contacts, and clear next actions.
* Own the end-to-end acquisition sales cycle - from lead generation through to deal closure.
  

Success in this role means consistently growing revenue and margin across both strategic and new acquisition accounts, while building a healthy, sustainable pipeline aligned to BT’s ICP and HiPo criteria. You’ll be recognised for strengthening BT’s position in the market by delivering value-led solutions, expanding our customer footprint, and forging trusted, long-term partnerships. Above all, success is about driving measurable outcomes for customers while achieving ambitious sales targets for BT.

* Interpersonal Skills: Possesses strong communication and active listening skills to build rapport and trust with prospects. This includes verbal and written skills (e.g. storytelling, creative emails, etc.)
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt and iterate on the prospecting approach in a fast-paced high growth sales environment
* Growth Mindset; Open and willing to be coached and to learn from others and grow positively

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Proven experience in relationship management and direct sales, ideally with a mix of strategic account management and new business acquisition.
* Prior experience in the Singapore region, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics and enterprise customer landscapes.
* Proven experience in strategic thinking, influencing decisions, and shaping adoption of complex solutions.
* Proven ability to craft creative solutions to complex business challenges, including navigating cross-geography and cross-cultural environments.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth sales environment, demonstrating adaptability, resilience, and a results-driven mindset.

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll turn Hupo’s commercial commitments and customer goals into successful, scalable deployments.
  
  
You’ll own the implementation journey from discovery through launch, working closely with customers, Account Directors, Solutions Architects, Product and Engineering. You’ll bring structure to complex deployments, manage risks and dependencies, and make sure customers can move from signed contract to live product as quickly and smoothly as possible.
  
  
This role is especially important as Hupo scales its enterprise customer base and looks to make deployments more predictable, repeatable and efficient.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Own enterprise deployments:**  
Lead implementations from kickoff through configuration, testing, go-live and post-launch stabilisation.
  
  
**Build the deployment plan:**  
Translate customer goals, contracted scope and technical requirements into clear milestones, workstreams, dependencies and success criteria.

title: Senior Director, Program Management PMO – Network Operations IT
description:
**DHL Express - a company that connects people!**
=================================================

What makes DHL great? Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world.

DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our corporate culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. **Start YOUR career with DHL today.**

**Job Purpose**  
The Senior Director, Program Management PMO – Network Operations IT is accountable for leading the end-to-end program management, strategic planning, and governance across the Network Operations technology landscape. Reporting directly to the VP, Global Head of Network Operations IT, this role ensures that all technology initiatives and portfolios are aligned with strategic priorities, operational needs, and long-term transformation objectives.
  
  
This role owns the integrated planning framework across key Network Operations domains, including Sort Automation, First Mile, Middle Mile, Last Mile, Customs Solution Design & Delivery, and Life Sciences & Healthcare / Cold Chain Express. It ensures cohesive portfolio management, clear prioritization, and effective execution across a complex, interdependent ecosystem.
  
  
This role establishes and continuously enhances governance, planning, and delivery standards to drive transparency, predictability, and performance across all initiatives. It provides a unified view of the technology portfolio, proactively managing dependencies, risks, and investment trade-offs, and enabling data-driven decision-making at the senior leadership level.
  
  
Working closely with domain leaders, product and engineering teams, and the central PMO, this role bridges strategy and execution—translating enterprise objectives into actionable roadmaps and ensuring consistent delivery of committed outcomes. Ultimately, it enables scalable, resilient, and future-ready operations across the global network.

**How will you contribute to the success of DHL?**
==================================================

**1. Enterprise Portfolio Leadership**  

* Define, own, and continuously evolve the end-to-end program and portfolio management framework across Network Operations IT.
* Provide strategic, operational, and financial oversight, including governance of the domain portfolio, budget management, and alignment of investments with enterprise priorities.
* Lead the integrated technology portfolio, ensuring all products, programs, and investments are aligned with strategic priorities and enterprise transformation objectives.
* Establish a unified planning and prioritization model that enables clear visibility, effective trade-off decisions, and optimal allocation of resources across Sort Automation, First, Middle, and Last Mile, Customs, and Life Sciences & Healthcare domains.
* Drive portfolio performance through proactive oversight of delivery health (financials, scope, timelines, and value realization), ensuring early identification and resolution of risks, dependencies, and execution gaps.
* Institutionalize standardized reporting, tooling, and governance artifacts to enable consistency, transparency, and comparability across all programs and domains.

  
**2. Executive & Administrative Support**  
  

* Act as the primary enabler to the VP, managing priorities, time, and access.

• Manage complex calendar management, including cross-time-zone scheduling and coordination of leadership forums. • Prepare agendas, take minutes, track decisions, and follow up on action items.
  

* Team structure
* Direct Reports: 2 PMOs (Customs & Life Science)
* Indirect reports: 5-6 team members

  
**3. Executive Governance & Strategic Steering**  
  

* Design and lead a robust governance ecosystem, ensuring effective decision-making, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Orchestrate executive-level reporting and communications, delivering clear, insight-driven narratives and SMT/board-level materials to support strategic discussions and decisions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the Head of Network Operations IT and domain leaders.
* Facilitate complex, cross-functional workshops to align divergent priorities and to resolve conflicts and drive consensus on strategic priorities.
* Ensure disciplined follow-through on governance actions, decisions, and commitments, maintaining accountability across all levels of the organization.

  
**4. Performance & Value Management**  
  

* Define and implement a comprehensive performance management framework across the portfolio, including KPIs, OKRs, and value-based success metrics aligned to customer outcomes and business impact.
* Lead the development of executive dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide real-time visibility into portfolio performance, risks, and outcomes.
* Drive a culture of accountability and continuous improvement through performance tracking and corrective actions.
* Ensure alignment between strategic objectives, program execution, and measurable business value, reinforcing a results-driven delivery culture.

  
**5. Organizational Leadership & Engagement**  
  

* Lead employee engagement and communication strategy across the Network Operations IT organization.
* Champion effective internal communication, ensuring clarity of vision, priorities, and progress through structured channels and modern collaboration platforms.
* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing PMO and engagement function, empowering team members to operate with ownership, accountability, and impact.
* Drive initiatives that strengthen collaboration, knowledge sharing, and organizational cohesion.
* Foster a culture of recognition, learning, and continuous development.

**Do you have what it takes?**
==============================

* Relevant university degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
* Minimum 15+ years of experience leading large-scale, multi-year business and technology transformation programs in complex, global environments.
* Proven track record of shaping and delivering enterprise transformation agendas and leading large portfolios of organizations.
* Deep expertise in enterprise program and portfolio management, including investment governance, benefits realization, and integrated delivery across business, IT, operations, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated success leading distributed teams through complex transformations, cross-functional teams in regulated or mission-critical environments (e.g., Customs, Network Operations).
* Strong strategic thinking and ability to translate strategy into execution.
* Results-oriented mindset with focus on value delivery and continuous improvement.
* Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to balance competing priorities and manage trade-offs.
* High resilience and adaptability in dynamic, high-pressure environments.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with a proven ability to engage, challenge, and align executive leadership teams.
* Forward-looking transformation perspective, with hands-on experience driving process automation, delivery modernisation, and continuous improvement.
* Experience leveraging digital tools, analytics, and AI to enhance portfolio performance.

**Please submit your application along with your CV in English and a copy of your highest educational degree (e.g., Bachelor’s, Master’s, or MBA certificate).**

Monitor supplier PDN/EOL notices, score risk, plan last-time buys (LTBs) and funding, request alternate-part qualification and plan product discontinuation with Sales.
  
  
•
  
  
**Parts and portfolio transfers:**  
Validate and release all internal and external part transfers within XP Power’s global operations footprint.
  
  
•
  
  
**Process and data ownership:**  
Act as process owner for Operations PLM workflows and business owner of PLM/ERP Operations data (item master, BOM, change workflow),maintaining one integrated lifecycle pipeline and dashboard.
  
  
•
  
  
**Financial and compliance control:**  
Manage the E&O, scrap and LTB financial impact of lifecycle events, and ensure ISO 9001 / ISO 13485 and customer change-control compliance, including copy-exact and formal PCN notice periods.
  
  
•
  
  
**Decision rights and governance:**  
Decide effectivity dates, cut-in, stock disposition and prototype build priorities; recommend LTB quantities and funding and NPI manufacturing go/no-go; escalate cost above threshold and customer-impacting conflicts to the VP Operations. Chair or co-chair the weekly Ops Change Control Board, NPI gate reviews, and the monthly EOL & LTB board, life cycle pipeline review (S&OP input) and parts transfer review.
  
  
•
  
  
**Stakeholder partnership:**  
Provide one voice on lifecycle topics to Engineering and Product Management (with Engineering retaining design authority and no ECO released without Operations sign-off), Sales and customers, manufacturing sites, Supply Chain and Quality & Compliance, escalating to the COO and CTO where required.
  
  
•
  
  
**Team leadership and capability:**  
Build four capabilities – NPI Program Management, Change & Configuration,EOL/Obsolescence & Components, and Parts/Portfolio Transfers – initially by redeploying existing roles and sizing the team after the 90-day baseline; lead a network of site PLM champions (dotted line); and close gaps in competencies,methods and data.
  
  
Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* Engineering degree; MBA or PMP is advantageous.
* 5+ years in operations, NPI or PLM in electronics manufacturing.
* 5+ years leading teams across several sites and countries; power electronics or regulated markets (semi cap, medical) preferred.
* Strong knowledge of PLM/ERP change workflows, BOM and item master, and configuration management(CMII a plus).
* Working knowledge of obsolescence tools, LTB/E&O costing, PPAP/FAI, IPC, ISO 9001and ISO 13485.
* Proven ability to build data-system architecture (eg Claude level 6), modern cross-functional workflow management and visual PLM boards.
* Able to influence Engineering and Sales without direct authority, and to remain calm and credible with customers during escalations.
* Balances process discipline with pragmatism; builds and coaches teams across cultures.

XP Power is a designer and manufacturer of electronic power conversion products which it supplies to the electronics industry. It serves the Industrial, Healthcare, Semiconductor Equipment Manufacturing and Technology markets. It has sales and marketing operations in North America, Europe and Asia and manufacturing in China, Vietnam and North America. The Company is listed on the London Stock Exchange.
  
  
The Company has a history of consistently growing revenues (18% CAGR over the last 4 years) and profits (16% CAGR over the last 4 years) and is highly cash generative. Revenues in 2019 were in excess of US$250 million. The company has ambitious growth plans to enter the FTSE250 within the next 3 years. XP Power has been consistently profitable and cash generative.
  
  
Current situation
  
  
Over the last 10 years XP Power has transformed its business from that of a distributor to a designer and then manufacturer of its own product. The Company has also expanded its addressable market through acquisitions of businesses that allow it to access the profitable areas of high voltage and radio frequency power. This strategy has enabled the Company to penetrate a significant number of blue-chip customers in its target market sectors and has resulted in a significant increase in earnings. With this expansion the business has become progressively more complex and many new exciting roles with good career development opportunities are being recruited.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are looking for self-motivated professionals who thrive in fast paced dynamic environments to join our team. We are proud of and committed to our culture that values Customer Focus, Flexibility, Knowledge, Speed, and Integrity. Joining our team means you will work in a high performing global company where employees collaborate and strive for excellence and can make a difference.
  
  
XP Power is an equal opportunities employer

title: VP of Quality
description:
**About Lumilens**

At Lumilens we are building the critical photonics infrastructure that powers tomorrow’s AI supercomputing. From chip-to-chip optical interconnects to scalable photonic engines, Lumilens is unlocking a new era of computing - faster, cooler, and massively more efficient.

We’re a well-funded startup backed by Mayfield and led by veterans who’ve built and scaled some of the most transformative technologies in the industry. At Lumilens, we’re developing high-speed photonics products purpose-built to power the future of AI infrastructure and high-performance computing.

This isn’t incremental innovation, it’s a ground-floor opportunity to rethink the optical layer from the silicon up. You’ll work alongside a team of world-class engineers solving some of the hardest challenges in scaling optical systems. Every line of code, every design decision, every breakthrough you help deliver will shape the infrastructure of tomorrow.

If you're looking for mission, momentum, and the chance to make an outsized impact, jump on the rocket ship. We’re just getting started.

**About the role**

We are looking for a VP of Quality to build and lead Lumilens' global quality and reliability organization as we scale our optical interconnect products, including 800G/1.6T pluggable transceivers, near-package optics, and co-packaged optics, from qualification to high-volume production for hyperscale data center customers. You will own quality end to end, from design and suppliers through manufacturing, customer qualification, and field performance, and you will be the company's quality voice with our most demanding customers. This is a senior leadership role that partners closely with Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, and Sales, and reports to executive leadership.

**Responsibilities**

* Define the quality and reliability strategy for Lumilens, and grow and lead a high-performing team spanning quality engineering, reliability engineering, supplier quality, customer quality, and quality management systems.
* Establish and scale a Quality Management System (QMS) certified to ISO 9001, including document control, change management, internal and external audits, and quarterly business reviews for our own sites and our contract manufacturing and OSAT partners.
* Own product reliability and qualification for lasers, photonic integrated circuits (PICs), and optical modules, including test strategy aligned with Telcordia GR-468, JEDEC, and customer-specific requirements (e.g., HTOL, damp heat, temperature cycling, accelerated aging, storage), reliability modeling (FIT rates, wear-out, MTTF), and ongoing reliability testing (ORT).
* Serve as the primary quality interface for hyperscaler and OEM customers. Lead customer qualifications, audits, and quality agreements, and own quality scorecards, RMAs, and 8D corrective action responses within committed timelines.
* Build a supplier quality program for critical components, including lasers, PICs, DSPs, optics, substrates, fiber array units, etc. Partner with contract manufacturers and OSATs to meet our corporate quality standards.
* Embed quality into our new product introduction (NPI) process: Partner with Engineering on DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, control plans, and phase-gate exit criteria to ensure products are designed for reliability and manufacturability.
* Drive manufacturing quality through the production ramp: set and achieve DPPM, yield, and outgoing quality targets, and deploy SPC, process capability (Cpk), test coverage, and containment practices.
* Build failure analysis (FA) capabilities for optical, electrical, and materials analysis, in-house and with external labs, to drive fast and rigorous root-cause analysis.
* Implement quality data systems and end-to-end traceability (serial- and lot-level, integrated with MES and test data) to provide early warning of yield, reliability, and field issues.
* Monitor field performance of deployed products in customer data centers, and lead escalations, containment, and corrective actions when issues arise.
* Ensure compliance with relevant standards and regulations, including ESD control (ANSI/ESD S20.20), cleanroom and contamination control, laser safety (IEC 60825-1), and environmental requirements (RoHS, REACH, conflict minerals).
* Report quality KPIs and cost of quality to the executive team and Board, and build a culture of continuous improvement, data-driven decision making, and ownership of quality across the company.
* Lead quality across multiple sites and regions, including manufacturing operations and partners in Asia.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in quality and reliability for optical, photonics, or semiconductor hardware, including at least 5 years leading quality organizations at Director or VP level.
* Proven track record of taking products from NPI to high-volume production, ideally for transceiver, hyperscale data center or major networking OEM customers.
* Deep expertise in optoelectronic reliability and qualification and in failure mechanisms of lasers, PICs, and optical packaging.
* Experience building or scaling an ISO 9001 QMS, and leading customer and third-party audits.
* Strong supplier quality experience with contract manufacturers and OSATs, particularly in Asia.
* Strong command of statistical and quality methods. Six Sigma Black Belt or ASQ CQE/CRE certification is a plus.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work under pressure in customer escalations and to influence across Engineering, Operations, and leadership.
* Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Supply Chain, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Optics, Materials Science, or a related field. Master's or PhD preferred.
* A builder's mindset suited to a fast-scaling startup, and willingness to travel internationally to sites, suppliers, and customers.

Overview

A Facility Agent (FA) acts as the Administrative Agent and is the central coordinator and administrator of a syndicated loan facility on behalf of the lenders. This role involves managing the loan’s lifecycle, ensuring compliance with the loan agreement, facilitating communication between borrowers and lenders, and handling administrative and operational tasks.

* Payment processing: Receive payments from the borrower and distribute proceeds to lenders according to their participation

* Documentation management: Maintain loan documents, amendments, waivers, and related records

* Facilitate lender coordination: Organize lender meetings, votes on amendments or waivers, and manage lender instructions

* Issue resolution: Address operational or contractual issues arising during the loan term.

* Reporting: Provide regular updates and reports to lenders on loan status, borrower performance, and any material events

* Familiarity with risk management frameworks and controls

* Collaborates: build partnerships and work collectively with others to meet shared objectives

* Courage: step up to address difficult issues and say what needs to be said (speak-up)

* Relationship Focus: build strong business and customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions

* Instills Trust: gain confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity

* Nimble Learning: active learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learnings

* Develop Talent: mentor, coach, and develop people to meet both their career goals

* Drives Vision & Purpose: paint a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action

title: VP, People & Performance
description:
Reporting directly to the CEO of Pave, you, as our VP, People & Performance, will be responsible for partnering with the CEO and leadership team to shape how we organize, hire, develop and retain the talent that will carry Pave through its next stage of growth.
  
  
Performance system
  
  
**Design and run a quarterly performance cycle:** objectives set at the start, scored at the end, calibrated across functions and hubs so a rating means the same thing everywhere.
  
  
Ensure the rating distribution reflects how the Group actually performed, not how comfortable managers are; publish the distribution to the CEO each cycle.
  
  
Ensure underperformance is identified within one cycle and resolved within the next, through a documented improvement plan or an exit; track time to decision as a metric.
  
  
Equip managers to hold direct performance conversations, and sit in on them where a manager cannot yet hold them alone.
  
  
Talent density
  
  
**Own the hiring bar:** define it by level, enforce it through structured interviews and calibrated scorecards, and audit outcomes so that each hire raises the average of the team it joins.
  
  
Run a talent review twice a year that names the top decile, a successor for every critical role and the bottom decile, with an action for each person in it.
  
  
Measure attrition in two columns, regretted and unregretted, and manage each to its own target: drive the first down and do not suppress the second.
  
  
**Keep the organisation flat:** set spans and layers, and approve a new role only against a defined output.
  
  
Reward
  
  
**Build a compensation framework that pays for performance:** increases, bonus and equity differentiated by rating and concentrated at the top of the distribution.
  
  
Own the Group remuneration policy and its regulatory compliance: NBG requirements today, and the PRA remuneration rules on deferral, malus and clawback for material risk-takers as part of the UK application.
  
  
Run the annual compensation review end to end with the CEO.
  
  
Organisation, conduct and people operations
  
  
**Own fitness and propriety:** screening, certification and ongoing assessment of senior managers and certified staff under NBG rules and, on authorisation, the UK Senior Managers and Certification Regime.
  
  
Run people operations across Singapore, Georgia and the UK (contracts, payroll, policies, onboarding and offboarding, HR systems) to a standard that passes audit without exception.
  
  
Build one source of truth for headcount, performance, compensation, tenure and the hiring funnel, reported to the CEO weekly.

title: Fraud and Risk Manager
description:
### **About Us**

First Circle is an SME-focused, credit-centric, and multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising soon.

We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.

Over the past two years we’ve expanded our product range to include business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.

Our track record and our future both result from our people & culture. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we raise the bar with every hire.

We are hiring for a Fraud and Risk manager to lead strategy and execution across all these domains. You are familiar with the risk landscape for fintechs, you can spot problems before they arise, and you can design and implement the very solutions that protect us against them. At First Circle, you will work closely with product, engineering, operations, legal and compliance, and executive leadership to build a highly resilient business — while supporting our continued growth.

First Circle is changing financial services for small businesses in the Philippines. The sky is the limit for someone who wants to get stuck in and make a difference.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Fraud:** Own the end-to-end fraud strategy including detection, investigation, and recovery. Oversee transaction monitoring, ATO prevention, and fraud modes relevant to the Philippine market (e.g. SIM swaps, document fraud, mule accounts).
* **Risk Management**: Work closely with compliance and internal audit to identify and understand our biggest risks. Partner with product, engineering and operations teams to implement solutions to protect against those risks. Where relevant you will also work closely with our engineering head of cybersecurity on data privacy and security.
* The role will be located in the Philippines and will report to the VP of Operations. Relocation and sponsorship will be considered.

  
**Requirements**

* **3+ years of experience** across fraud and operational risk, in a tech company.
* In an ideal case, you will have **worked for a fintech company** and you are familiar with the risk and regulatory landscape for non-bank financial institutions. You don’t need to have direct experience with the Philippines regulatory landscape specifically, but it is an added bonus if you do.
* Ability to work **cross-functionally**. Experience partnering with engineering, product, operations and compliance teams.
* **Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.** Ideally has experience with data and analytics tools (e.g. SQL, Python).
* This is an **individual contributor** role to start with, with the opportunity to build out a small team in the future. We are looking for someone who is comfortable doing a lot of the work themselves, not just directing others.
* Ability to **roll up your sleeves and get things done**. You are not just a layer of oversight - you are used to actually implementing solutions to solve critical problems. You will be expected to be hands-on, in the details, and executing to high standards.

  
  
**Benefits**  

* Join a team with a deeply collaborative culture! Learn more here: https://www.firstcircle.ph/careers
* Hybrid work set-up: at least 2 days per week in our BGC (central Manila) office; your choice to work in office or remote the rest of the time.
* Benefits: HMO coverage from week one, life and accidental insurance, free catered lunches, monthly fitness, transportation, and accommodation allowance, and more.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
**About Sentient**
------------------

Sentient is building the future of open-source AI. Our mission is to ensure that the most powerful AI systems remain open, accessible, and beneficial to everyone.

Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera Capital, Sentient brings together world-class AI researchers, engineers, and builders to develop cutting-edge open-source AI technologies.

Our work spans AI agents, model verification, AI benchmarking, and self-improving AI systems. We're focused on turning frontier research into useful, widely adopted products that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source AI.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're looking for a highly technical, entrepreneurial Product Manager to help shape and build the next generation of AI products at Sentient.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and product development, identifying promising research breakthroughs and turning them into products that developers and businesses actually want to use.

This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to take ideas from early exploration through launch and adoption. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable exploring new technologies, prototyping solutions, engaging with users, and working alongside researchers and engineers.

You'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and leadership teams to determine what we should build, why it matters, and how to bring it to market. The role reports to the VP of Product and works alongside the team’s PM Lead, who will set overall product direction.

**Location:** Remote. The team is spread across Singapore, Hong Kong, and UAE, so you'll need regular overlap with Asia/Middle East working hours, with flexibility across timezones as we are a global team.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Find product opportunities where our research, emerging technology, and market need meet, then set the vision, priorities, and roadmap.
* Lead products from first concept through prototype, launch, and adoption, working with engineering, research, and go-to-market teams.
* Work with AI researchers to spot promising breakthroughs and turn them into product requirements, user experiences, and technical specifications.
* Evaluate technical approaches and make architectural trade-offs alongside engineering.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, using code, APIs, and current AI tooling: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, and developer infrastructure.
* Design experiments and evaluations to test product hypotheses, and move quickly from idea to working demo to user feedback.
* Talk directly with developers, design partners, and customers. Define and track adoption, engagement, performance, and retention, and feed what you learn back into product and research priorities.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Required Qualifications**

* You have taken a technical product from concept to launch, and you can show us the product and its usage numbers.
* You have worked as a software or ML engineer, or have equivalent hands-on technical depth.
* You write Python well enough to build a working agent prototype against LLM APIs on your own.
* You have designed and run evaluations for an LLM or agent system, and can explain why a given eval does or does not predict real-world performance.
* You can point to a time you killed or reshaped a technically promising idea because users did not need it.
* You have driven an initiative from start to finish without a defined brief or someone else setting the scope.
* You can explain a research result to a customer and a customer problem to a researcher, clearly and in writing.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a founder, founding product manager, early-stage engineer, or technical product lead.
* Experience building AI developer tools, AI agents, ML infrastructure, model evaluation systems, or open-source products.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and modern AI development workflows.
* Experience collaborating with research scientists or bringing emerging AI technologies to market.
* Contributions to open-source AI projects or active involvement in developer communities.
* Experience working with design partners to validate and refine new products.

**Why Join Sentient?**
----------------------

### **Why open source**

At a closed lab, the product is access to a model. Here, the product is something developers can run, inspect, and build on themselves. That changes the job in three ways.

* **Your work is public.** Most of what you ship lives in the open, where anyone can read it, fork it, and challenge it. Your track record is visible to the whole field, not locked inside one company.
* **Your users are your collaborators.** Developers file issues, send pull requests, and tell you what is broken within days. You learn faster than any private beta allows.
* **You build for adoption, not lock-in.** A product wins here because developers choose it, not because they have no alternative. That is a harder bar and a more honest one.

### **What else you get**

* **Work at the frontier of AI:** Collaborate with leading researchers and engineers on technologies shaping the future of artificial intelligence.
* **Meaningful ownership:** Have a direct impact on product strategy, technical direction, and execution.
* **Research meets real-world impact:** Translate innovative AI research into practical products used by developers and organizations.
* **Builder-driven culture:** Work with an ambitious team that values experimentation, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results.

If you're passionate about AI, enjoy building products from the ground up, and want to shape the future of open-source AI, we'd love to hear from you.

Product Stewardship and Influence

* Advise business' chief product owners on AI product vision, roadmap, and success metrics from ideation to production.

Balance rapid experimentation with long‑term scalability and sustainability.  

Rapid Prototyping

* Build and iterate AI prototypes quickly by making use of modern AI and automation tools and work closely with each Data Science squad to validate ideas and accelerate delivery.
* Validate ideas through working solutions that demonstrate clear business value.
Stay current with emerging technologies and apply them pragmatically.  

Engineering & Delivery

* Design prototypes with production deployment in mind.
* Work with engineering and platform squads to transition solutions into production.
Ensure alignment with enterprise standards on security, reliability, and maintainability.  

Collaboration

* Partner closely with data scientists, engineers, designers, and business stakeholders.

Accountability for vendor evaluation, RFP/procurement support, SLA tracking, and technical acceptance of vendor deliverables

Experience

* Strong hands‑on background in **Data Science** or **applied AI** .
* At least 7–10 years of **product management and cross-functional program delivery experience** , driving feature ownership, roadmap execution, and end-to-end solution lifecycle management.
Proven track record managing cross-functional delivery timelines, budgets, and stakeholders to take solutions from concept to prototype and production deployment.  

Skills

* Solid programming and solution‑building experience (e.g. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript).
* Working knowledge of modern AI/ML systems and intelligent workflows.
* Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals and APIs.
Ability to build quick prototypes with vibe coding tools to drive product roadmap  

Mindset

* Passionate about new and emerging technologies with a strong builder mindset.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and moving quickly from idea to execution.
* Strong product thinking and communication skills.
* Self‑driven and motivated to operate in a **business‑facing role** , partnering closely with senior stakeholders and Business CPOs on long‑term AI product roadmaps.

SUCCESS IN FIRST 12 MONTHS

* Deliver **1–2 AI products or major capabilities** from concept through to squad‑led production deployment.
* Establish a clear product roadmap with defined success metrics and realized business impact.
* Successfully onboard and govern external vendor deliveries while passing all internal IT, security, and risk review gates.

title: IT Support Engineer
description:
Meraki Group, which operates SPGS (Singapore), believes every member of staff has a real hand in the school’s success, and that what a person contributes shouldn’t stop where their job title ends.

Meraki Group and SPGS (Singapore) are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people. We expect all teaching staff, non-teaching staff and volunteers to share that commitment and act on it.

**Purpose of the Role**

The IT Support Engineer provides first-line (L1) technical support across the school, keeping staff and students productive on their devices, applications and core systems.

The role owns day-to-day issue resolution through the service desk, supports the device and classroom technology estate, and escalates anything beyond L1 to the Network Engineer or IT Manager.

The IT Support Engineer is responsible for supporting and facilitating the use of ICT equipment and applications by school members (staff and students).

The IT Support Engineer will be quick to learn about the organisation and begin to interact with various key stakeholders.

**ICT Helpdesk Support**

* Maintaining, installing and supporting the use of computer equipment and peripherals for curriculum and administrative use within the school. Keep all computers and printers in good condition.
* Install and configure a wide variety of software including Apple and Microsoft applications, Adobe products and specialist applications necessary for those students with additional learning requirements.
* Provide day-to-day ICT support including the first and second level support of the school’s web-based applications.
* Communicate to staff/users through a series of actions either face to face or over the telephone to help set up systems or resolve issues.
* Checking the operation of the school systems and reporting any equipment in need of repair or upgrade.
* To document and test all installations or alterations to hardware or software, and to ensure that the inventory is current at all times.
* To document problems and steps to resolve them using the school ICT Helpdesk system.
* Ensure an accurate record of software licenses used by the school and report infringements to the ICT Manager.
* If competent to do so, to make repairs to Desktops, laptops and add cabling etc.
* Liaising with external contractor/or equipment suppliers in the event of technical issues which require specialist inventory

**Mobile Device Management**

* Configures, tests and provides service support of mobile device solutions including laptops and tablets.
* Ensures that all mobile devices and activations are in compliance with the school ICT policies and procedures.
* Supports the school in the planning and deployment for mobile devices.

**Management of ICT Equipment & Consumables**

* Need to have a strong Mac and Windows OS background.
* Provide initial troubleshooting for Mac and iOS devices.
* Troubleshoot and repair laptops and desktops as required.
* Support regular backup and updates and install new software.
* Fault handling; administer the lending/returning of IT equipment for Staff.
* Check and update inventory of ICT property regularly.
* Additional installation/collection after counting necessary quantities.
* Accident prevention.

**Maintenance of ICT Equipment in Classrooms**

* Maintain the IWBs (Interactive White Board), Projectors, Audio systems.
* Manage the booking system of iPads and iPad trolley.
* Manage software at the Director Commercial Operations’ request.
* Check and fix the Wi-Fi signals and AP issues and liaise with the Managed Service Provider for fault reporting.
* Maintain the classroom devices to ensure they remain in excellent condition.

**Maintenance of MFP (Multi-function Printer)**

* Troubleshooting and repairs of various faults.
* Inventory check.
* Configuration management and firmware updates. Liaise with vendors e.g. troubleshooting and service delivery.

**Management of IP Phone**

* Install and Maintenance of IP Phone devices and IP Phone switchboard system.
* Building numbering plan and repairing.
* Making an extension and network of emergency contacts.

**Administration Duties**

* Maintain equipment/system manuals.
* Obtaining comparative estimates for purchasing ICT and reports.
* Sharing of work process data for improving business efficiency.

**Infrastructure First-Line (L1) Support**

* Provide first-line (L1) support across the infrastructure — the HPE SimpliVity and VMware environment, the HP DL380 and HP DL320 servers, and Active Directory, DNS and DHCP — escalating anything beyond L1 to the Network Engineer or ICT Manager.
* Provide L1 support for the Aruba core, distribution and floor access switches, the Wi-Fi access-point estate and ClearPass onboarding, including basic checks, port status and fault reporting.
* Hold L1 awareness of the FortiGate firewall HA pair and FortiAnalyzer, HPE Morpheus, Microsoft Hyper-V and the HPE StoreOnce appliance, raising issues to the right team.
* Carry out L1 monitoring of Veeam backup jobs, reporting any failed or missed jobs.
* Administer devices through JAMF and support the endpoint estate — staff MacBooks, support Lenovo laptops, student iPads and MacBook trolleys, and computer suite iMacs.
* Support Apple Mac OS devices alongside Windows, including setup, updates and everyday troubleshooting.
* Support classroom technology — smartboards and displays — and the photocopier and printer estate with Y-Soft printing.
* Support day-to-day use of Google Suites and the school’s core applications, logging and tracking issues through the Freshdesk service desk and keeping asset records current in SnipeIT.
* Understand the basics of the OSI layer model and use it to describe and narrow down common network problems.

**Systems and Environment Familiarity**

* Good to have someone who has worked on the majority of the school’s day-to-day systems, in particular:
* Google Suites and the teaching and admin applications — iSAMS, Firefly, ManageBac, SeeSaw, MyConcern, SOCS, Evolve, Carousel Learning, OpenApply, School Post, National College, Twinkl and Pluto.
* Device and asset management — JAMF, SnipeIT and Wonde integration.
* The Freshdesk service desk and Y-Soft printing.
* The endpoint and classroom estate — staff MacBooks, Lenovo laptops, student iPads and iMacs, photocopiers and printers, and smartboards and displays.

**Other Duties**

* Providing support for school functions and events, on a rota basis, which may, very occasionally, involve weekend coverage.
* Providing cover and assistance for other parts of the school as required.
* Any other reasonable duties as assigned from time to time.
* Be willing to engage in ongoing professional development to support the needs of the ICT department and school.

**Safeguarding:**

* Abide by the school safeguarding policy and keep abreast of any changes.

  
**Requirements**  

* Have worked in a first-line (L1) IT support or service desk role for at least 3 years.
* Have supported endpoints through an MDM platform for a minimum of 2 years.
* Have hands-on experience supporting Apple macOS devices alongside Windows.
* Have hands-on experience on Google Workspace.
* Have experience managing Microsoft Active Directory for at least 2 years.

title: Sourcing Engineer (Regional Category Management)
description:
**Your Job**

You will be the key Regional Category Management connection for assigned business segments and projects. You will support early sourcing engagement and successful product launches by aligning sourcing priorities, driving material readiness, coordinating activities across procurement categories, and enabling timely decisions and risk escalation.

You will work closely with Business Units, NPD Sourcing, Buyers, Quality, Project Management, Engineering, Global Category Managers and Directors, and Quality Program Management. You will also collaborate with external suppliers to support sourcing execution, material readiness, project milestones, and product launches.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead Clear-to-Build reviews, material-readiness checks, and launch-readiness assessments.

title: Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC
description:
Singapore - Singapore

JOB ID: R-262307 LOCATION: Singapore - Singapore ; Thailand - Bangkok WORK LOCATION TYPE: Remote DATE POSTED: Nov. 20, 2026 CATEGORY: Supply Chain

**Defying Imagination at Amgen**

At Amgen, every team member contributes to a mission that extends beyond individual roles: serving patients worldwide. This shared commitment drives our pursuit of excellence and innovation and supports Amgen’s position as a global biotechnology leader. Our collaborative culture enables us to research, manufacture, and deliver products that reach more than 10 million patients around the world. If you are seeking a career with purpose, Amgen offers an opportunity to make a meaningful difference.

**Live**

**What you will do**

Amgen is one of the world’s leading independent biotechnology companies. For over 4 decades, Amgen has pioneered biotechnology breakthroughs, to bring state-of-the-art medicines from laboratory to the patient. Amgen has not only discovered and developed innovative human therapeutics, but has invested in cutting edge manufacturing capability and support services to deliver these exciting therapies to medical teams around the world. Japan and Asia Pacific (JAPAC) is the fastest growing region in Amgen. Now we are hiring a **Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC** based out of **Singapore or Malaysia or Thailand.**

**Live**

**What you will do**

**Accountabilities:**

Reporting to the Senior Director, Product Security, within Global Security (GS), the Senior Manager, Illicit Trade, Theft, Risk & Supplier Assurance – JAPAC will execute on regional efforts to protect patients and Amgen products from external threats across the regulated supply chain and illicit markets.

The role covers supply chain security, illicit trade, and brand protection, with a focus on threats such as diversion, theft, counterfeiting, and unauthorized marketing of Amgen products. The Senior Manager will direct regional incident response, investigations, and remediation for the region, while coordinating with global Product Security colleagues and partners across Amgen.

The role will develop and implement regional strategies, policies, procedures, and standards in partnership with key stakeholders. It will also work with industry groups, government agencies, law enforcement, health authorities, suppliers, and other external partners to strengthen product security and patient safety across APAC.

**Responsibilities:**

* Support Product Security efforts across APAC to protect Amgen’s product portfolio from external threats, including counterfeiting, diversion, theft, illicit generics, and unauthorized marketing.
* Provide support for regional supply chain security initiatives in partnership with Supply Chain Security and Operations.
* Support and facilitate cross-functional governance with representatives from Global Security, Legal, Operations, Supply Chain, Legal, Corporate Audit, and other relevant functions.
* Define and implement regional strategies for threat monitoring, incident reporting and response, counterfeit deterrence and authentication, enforcement, and remediation.
* Collaborate with the Product Security Intelligence team to monitor physical and online markets for suspicious activity involving Amgen products.
* Investigate suspected or confirmed illicit activity affecting Amgen products, working with internal stakeholders and, as appropriate, law enforcement, health authorities, and industry partners.
* Assess threats and vulnerabilities affecting active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), materials, finished products, returns, sites, and the regulated supply chain; develop and implement mitigation plans.
* Support the development and use of tools, systems, and security technologies to monitor threats and strengthen protection across the supply chain.
* Provide Amgen leaders with metrics, key performance indicators, and reports on emerging and ongoing threats in the region.
* Develop and deliver education and awareness initiatives for internal and external audiences.
* Represent Amgen in relevant industry and government working groups, task forces, and committees, and advocate for the company’s interests.
* Coordinate the regional supply chain security audit framework and program in partnership with internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate proactive, for-cause, and pre-contract security audits of vendors, suppliers, and business partners.
* Build and maintain relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, health authorities, and other relevant agencies to support effective communication and response.
* Coordinate with regional and functional directorates across Global Security and with global Product Security colleagues to align efforts.
* Select, train, and manage contract workers and consultants, as needed. This may include drafting requests for proposals, making recommendations, negotiating contracts, providing direction, and reviewing deliverables and invoices.
* Conduct and manage internal and external investigations as needed, maintaining appropriate chain of custody and evidence management.

**Win**

**What we expect of you**

**Qualifications and Expectations**

* Extensive knowledge of illicit supply chains, supply chain security, and effective investigation and remediation practices.
* Demonstrated experience conducting or managing investigations involving organized criminal activity.
* Expertise in chain of custody and evidence management.
* Strong working knowledge of GxP environments, including GMP and GDP.
* Experience with supply chain security standards and programs, such as TAPA and CTPAT.
* Experience conducting or supporting supply chain security audits and assessments, identifying control gaps, and recommending corrective actions.
* Proficiency with security systems and the ability to assess their effectiveness, recognize limitations, and recommend improvements.
* Sound judgment and the ability to act swiftly in a dynamic threat environment.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to gather and evaluate information and prepare clear, concise reports.
* Ability to prioritize multiple tasks, work well under pressure, and communicate effectively with leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including consensus-building, presentation, and professional writing abilities.
* Ability to influence, engage, and inspire teams, and to build effective relationships across all levels of the organization.
* Experience working with key partners as part of an Incident Management Team.
* Self-motivated and able to work independently while collaborating across a complex organization.
* Commitment to the highest standards of integrity, compliance, and confidentiality.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and seven to nine years of experience in private-sector global or corporate supply chain security, enforcement, investigations, or related program management; biopharmaceutical industry experience preferred.
* Experience working across APAC markets and with regional law enforcement, health authorities, industry groups, or other relevant partners.
* Supervisory law enforcement and/or military experience desirable but not required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
* Willingness to travel approximately 20% of the time, including overnight and weekend travel.
* Professional security or investigative certifications, such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), preferred but not required.

**Thrive**

**What you can expect of us**

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, so we work to care for our teammates’ professional

and personal growth and well-being.

* Vast opportunities to learn and move up and across our global organization

* Diverse and inclusive community of belonging, where teammates are empowered to bring ideas to the table and act

* Generous Total Rewards Plan comprising health, finance and wealth, work/life balance, and career benefits

The role works closely with Programme Directors, the Office of Admissions, applicants and other stakeholders to ensure timely, accurate and compliant processing, a smooth applicant journey from application to matriculation, and continuous improvement of admissions operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**Admissions Enrolment Coordination**

* Monitor the end-to-end admissions cycle for five MSc coursework programmes, from application review to matriculation
* Pre-screen applications and verify certificates, transcripts and prerequisite documents for completeness and compliance
* Prepare applicant lists and coordinate screening, selection and online interviews with Programme Directors
* Track application outcomes, offer acceptance, admission deposits and outstanding enrolment requirements
* Liaise with applicants and the Office of Admissions to resolve outstanding checks and support smooth matriculation
Maintain accurate applicant records and supporting documents in GCAS, including processing unsuccessful applications  

  

**Student Engagement, Outreach & Events**

* Support admissions outreach, information sessions, student engagement activities and programme events
Coordinate event communications, logistics and engagement with prospective students and relevant stakeholders  

  

**Requirements:**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in any discipline
* At least 2–4 years of relevant experience in programme administration or a similar role, preferably in a tertiary education institution
* Strong organisational and coordination skills, with the ability to manage concurrent timelines, priorities and high application volumes
* Meticulous and analytical, with sound judgement, attention to detail and the ability to resolve operational issues
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently and collaborate with diverse stakeholders
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with admissions or student administration systems such as GCAS is preferred  

  

We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

title: Assistant/Deputy Director, Operational Risk & Assurance (Corporate Services)
description:
At Singapore Children's Society, we are committed to improving the well-being of children, youth and families through services that are responsive, evidence-informed and focused on lasting impact. Strong operational governance helps ensure that our centres and departments translate approved policies, procedures, licensing requirements and risk controls into consistent day-to-day practice.
  
  
The Operational Risk & Assurance function provides independent operational assurance across the Society. If you can combine sound judgement, constructive challenge and disciplined follow-through to strengthen compliance, controls and continuous improvement, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Work Objectives
  
  
Lead the Society’s operational assurance programme, distinct from the Internal Audit programme, to assess whether centres and departments implement approved policies, SOPs, licensing requirements and risk controls effectively and consistently. Establish proportionate disciplines for operational reviews, licensing readiness, SOP governance, RAMS and control-effectiveness testing, continuous-improvement actions and Plan-Act-Track monitoring. Provide objective implementation findings and closure validation while preserving the accountability of Centre Heads, Department Heads and process owners for operations and remediation.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
1. Operational Assurance Strategy and Review Programme
  
  
Develop and maintain a risk-based annual operational assurance plan that is distinct from, and coordinated with, the Internal Audit programme.
  
  
Conduct centre and department operational assurance reviews focused on implementation of approved requirements and operating effectiveness of controls.
  
  
Define proportionate review criteria, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and operational reporting formats.
  
  
Issue evidence-based operational findings and recommendations, and escalate significant, recurring or systemic implementation gaps.
  
  
Avoid duplicating Internal Audit engagements; where an issue falls within an approved audit scope, coordinate the review boundary with AD, Compliance.
  
  
2. Licensing and Operational Regulatory Readiness
  
  
Lead readiness assessments for operational and service licensing requirements and coordinate evidence verification with accountable owners.
  
  
Maintain visibility of readiness milestones, evidence status, dependencies and identified implementation gaps.
  
  
Conduct gap analyses and challenge the adequacy of corrective actions before inspections, renewals or submissions.
  
  
Report material operational-readiness risks and overdue actions through the appropriate management or governance channel.
  
  
Do not assume ownership of corporate statutory submissions retained by AD, Compliance or the relevant corporate owner.
  
  
3. SOP Governance and Standardisation
  
  
Establish and maintain an organisation-wide SOP governance framework covering ownership, approval, version control, review cycles and retirement.
  
  
Oversee the central SOP repository and standardise SOP structures, templates, naming conventions and minimum control requirements.
  
  
Advise teams on translating approved policies and regulatory requirements into clear, practical and auditable procedures.
  
  
Monitor overdue SOP reviews, ownership gaps and exceptions; Centre Heads and Department Heads retain ownership of operational content and implementation.
  
  
Coordinate with AD, Compliance where an SOP issue requires a change to an organisation-level policy or governance requirement.
  
  
4. Operational Risk-Control Assurance
  
  
Provide assurance oversight of RAMS and related operational risk-control documentation.
  
  
Review and test the design, documentation, implementation and operating effectiveness of key operational controls.
  
  
Distinguish control-design gaps from implementation failures, incomplete evidence and ineffective remediation.
  
  
Provide practical recommendations while preserving management ownership of the control and corrective action.
  
  
Escalate material control failures or recurring weaknesses to the appropriate management or governance forum.
  
  
5. Remediation, Continuous Improvement and Plan-Act-Track
  
  
Administer the Plan-Act-Track framework for assigned Internal Audit, operational review, After Action Review, Service Improvement Plan, corrective and preventive actions.
  
  
Maintain visibility of action owners, target dates, dependencies, status and required closure evidence.
  
  
Review evidence and validate whether remediation has been implemented and is operating as intended rather than relying solely on task completion.
  
  
Recommend closure, reopening or escalation; Compliance retains the master Internal Audit status and formal ARC reporting for audit findings.
  
  
Analyse recurring issues and lessons learnt to support prevention, standardisation and sustainable improvement.
  
  
6. Reporting, Partnership and Capability Building
  
  
Provide decision-ready operational reporting on assurance coverage, licensing readiness, SOP governance, control effectiveness and overdue actions.
  
  
Work with AD, Compliance, Centre Heads, Department Heads, Facilities, Safety and Health, IT, Data Protection, Finance, HR and other control owners.
  
  
Maintain independence of operational assurance judgement while engaging teams constructively and respecting management accountability.
  
  
Develop practical tools, templates, checklists and guidance for consistent assurance work and evidence standards.
  
  
Lead assigned staff or project resources and build organisational capability in root-cause analysis, controls and sustainable action closure.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Qualifications and Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Accountancy, Quality Management, Public Administration, Social Sciences or a related discipline.
  
  
At least eight to ten years of relevant experience in operational assurance, quality assurance, compliance, risk management, internal controls or a related governance function.
  
  
Experience planning operational reviews, evaluating evidence, testing control design and operating effectiveness, and following remediation through to validated closure.
  
  
Experience with licensing readiness, SOP governance, corrective/preventive action tracking and multi-site or centre-based operations.
  
  
Relevant professional certification in risk, audit, quality, business continuity, workplace safety and health, process improvement or project management is advantageous.
  
  
Skills and Attributes
  
  
Strong operational risk, internal-control and compliance knowledge, with the ability to translate requirements into practical review criteria.
  
  
Strong assurance and analytical capability in scoping, sampling, evidence evaluation, root-cause analysis, control testing and closure validation.
  
  
Excellent report-writing, facilitation and stakeholder-engagement skills, including constructive challenge.
  
  
Independent, objective, pragmatic and proportionate, with disciplined follow-through and respect for management ownership.
  
  
Competence in Microsoft 365, Copilot and relevant registers, dashboards, repositories and workflow tools used for assurance monitoring.
  
  
About Singapore Children’s Society
  
  
Singapore Children’s Society protects and nurtures children and youth of all races and religions. In 2025, the Society reached out to 22,333 children, youth and families in need. Established in 1952, its services have evolved to meet the changing needs of children.
  
  
Today, Children’s Society operates more than 10 service centres islandwide, offering services in the four categories of: Vulnerable Children and Youth, Children and Youth Services, Family Services, and Research and Advocacy.
  
  
Our Patron-in-Chief is President Tharman Shanmugaratnam.
