title: Youth Worker - Youth Specialist (Residential)
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
  
  
Boys' Town is a non-profit social service agency in Singapore dedicated to supporting children and youth in need. Founded in 1948 by the Montfort Brothers of St. Gabriel, Boys' Town began as a residential home for boys affected by the war and has since expanded to provide a continuum of services for children and youth in need.
  
  
Today, Boys' Town serves both boys and girls, from infants to young adults, many from disadvantaged or disengaged families who have experienced challenges such as neglect, abandonment, or abuse. Boys' Town provides holistic and integrated services including residential care, fostering services, respite care, youth outreach, adventure-based therapy, and clinical intervention.
  
  
As an organisation, Boys' Town is committed to meaningful social impact and professional practice. Staff work within multi-disciplinary teams of trained professionals, united by a shared purpose of making a positive impact in the lives of children and youth.
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Boys' Town Residential Services (RS) is a children and young persons home providing residential care for boys between the ages of 10 to 21 in Singapore. RS is a residential home for disadvantaged and disengaged youths with programmes catered exclusively to male residents only. Children and young persons admitted into the residential home are those who are from dysfunctional families and in need of shelter; abused or neglected; in need of care and protection; under family guidance orders; and in conflict with the Law.
  
  
Job Purpose
  
  
To provide close supervision and accountability of residents, ensuring the residents' well-being is taken care of during the day-to-day interactions.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  
To be attentive and look into the well-being of residents by being available and accountable for the residents' whereabouts when on duty.
  
  
To provide close supervision and maintain the residents' discipline in accordance with the daily programme.
  
  
To motivate and actively engage residents to participate in the BT/daily programme.
  
  
To monitor the sick residents' condition on a regular basis.
  
  
To carry out any administrative work (timely and accurate event as in Duty Officer's reports).
  
  
To ensure that the Operations Centre is operational and ready for the next Duty Officer.
  
  
To maintain the discipline of the boys in consultation with the Executive Director, the Head of Residential Services, and other members of senior management.
  
  
To participate actively and take ownership of primary/secondary portfolios assigned by Head, Residential Services.
  
  
To support the implementation of the relevant model of care/ services in accordance with the needs and profile of the residents.
  
  
Any other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
O level/ Nitec/ Diploma
  
  
Able to work on rotating shifts including weekends and public holidays.
  
  
Able to work independently and in a team, possess good interpersonal, communication and written skills.
  
  
Demonstrate emotional maturity and genuine passion for working with young people.
  
  
To display proactiveness in group discussions in enhancing the services provided to the residents.
  
  
Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - Boys’ Town

title: Assistant Vice President, Commercial (based in Singapore/Vietnam)
description:
**About Sembcorp**

Sembcorp is a leading energy and urban solutions provider headquartered in Singapore. Led by its purpose to drive energy transition, Sembcorp delivers sustainable energy solutions and urban developments by leveraging its sector expertise and global track record.

**Join Integrated Urban Solutions**

Play a role in building smart and sustainable cities! With over 30 years of experience, we transform raw land into thriving developments across Vietnam, Indonesia, and China. As a key growth engine, our Integrated Urban Solutions segment strives to be Asia’s fastest-growing industrial solutions provider. By delivering efficient energy solutions and pioneering innovative water resource management, we enable the growth of vibrant, future-ready communities.

  
  

**Position: Assistant Vice President, Commercial (Based in Singapore/Vietnam)**

Reporting to Head, Commercial, you will lead a dedicated team of in-country marketers to promote our industrial park in Vietnam, China & Indonesia, generate high-value leads, and drive direct outreach to domestic and international investors interested in industrial land acquisition. You will bridge strategic marketing with hands-on B2B sales enablement, positioning our industrial park as the premier destination for manufacturing, logistics, and commercial operations.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

**Team Leadership & Management**

* Team Supervision: Lead, mentor, and manage the daily activities of a team of in-country marketing specialists, ensuring alignment with overall land-sales targets.
* Performance Tracking: Establish clear KPIs for lead generation, investor outreach, and conversion rates, conducting regular performance reviews and coaching sessions.
* Resource Allocation: Assign target sectors, geographic regions, and key accounts to team members to maximize market coverage without overlap.

**Investor Outreach & Lead Generation**

* Strategic Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential industries (e.g., manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, tech, and green energy) seeking land for expansion or relocation.
* Direct Outreach Campaigns: Oversee multi-channel outreach strategies—including cold calling, targeted email campaigns, LinkedIn networking, and direct mail—to engage C-level executives, corporate real estate directors, and site selection consultants.
* Other Sales Channel Management: Development of sales and marketing channels such as key Government relationships, industry associations, business councils, and services providers network to broaden leads generation.
* Pipeline Management: Maintain and optimize the CRM system to track all investor interactions, nurture long-term relationships, and smoothly transition qualified leads to drive eventual closure.
* Business Travel: Conduct frequent travel within key region (e.g. Vietnam, Indonesia, China and other new markets) to build and solidify relationships with potential clients and strategic partners. Host client site visits to industrial parks in the region.

**Marketing Strategy & Collateral**

* Value Proposition Development: Craft compelling pitch decks, site brochures, digital tours, and investment briefs highlighting respective park’s infrastructure, utilities, tax incentives, and strategic location.
* Events & Trade Shows: Plan and represent Sembcorp and/or industrial parks at industry expos, investment forums, events and talks for prospective investors.
* Market Intelligence: Monitor regional real estate trends, competitor pricing, and government industrial policies to continuously refine outreach messaging. Stay updated on global industrial developments and the economic climate to ensure marketing efforts align with market realities.

**Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Key Metrics: Monitor and analyze the performance of all marketing and lead generation activities, tracking KPIs such as lead quality conversion rates, and ROI.
* Management Update: Prepare and present updates to Head of Commercial, providing actionable insights and strategic recommendations for optimization.
  

  

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience: 15 years of experience in B2B marketing, commercial/industrial real estate, economic development, or investment promotion, with at least 2 years in a team lead or supervisory role.
* Industry Knowledge: Strong understanding of industrial real estate, land acquisition processes, supply chain logistics, and corporate site selection criteria.
* Sector Advantage: Familiarity with the semiconductor industry (including ecosystem requirements, supply chain needs, and infrastructure expectations) is an added advantage.
* Communication & Persuasion: Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills capable of engaging high-level corporate decision-makers.
* Data-Driven Mindset: Proficiency in CRM software and lead-tracking analytics to measure campaign ROI.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Real Estate, Economics, or a related field.
  

  

**Our Culture at Sembcorp**

At Sembcorp, our culture is shaped by a strong set of shared behaviours that guide the way we work and uphold our commitment to driving the energy transition.

We foster an institution-first mindset, where the success of Sembcorp takes precedence over individual interests. Collaboration is at the heart of what we do, as we work seamlessly across markets, businesses, and functions to achieve our goals together. Accountability is a core principle, ensuring that we take ownership of our commitments and deliver on them with integrity and excellence. These values define who we are and create a workplace where our people can thrive while making a meaningful impact on driving energy transition.

Join us in making a real impact!

description:
**Job Description**  
  
**Fitch Solutions is currently seeking** **an Executive Assistant to the APAC Head of Commercial** **based out of our** **Singapore** **office. We encourage applications from individuals who hold current, unrestricted work authorisation in Singapore, as we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.**  
  
Fitch Solutions is a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. It informs investment strategies, strengthens risk management capabilities and helps identify strategic opportunities. Its analysts, lawyers, journalists and economists offer in-depth views on credit markets/risk and individual credits, ESG, developed and emerging markets, and industry sectors. Fitch Solutions is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in over 30 countries. Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  
By becoming a part of the Fitch Solutions team, you will join a group of colleagues delivering critical data, insightful research, and comprehensive analytics that empower clients to make informed decisions. You'll work in a dynamic environment where innovation is encouraged, and collaboration is key to developing solutions that address the evolving needs of global markets. With a portfolio of best-in-class, award winning brands, we offer you the opportunity to advance your career while contributing to a company known for its expertise and commitment to excellence.
  
  
**About the Team**  
  
We're looking for a proactive and highly organised Executive Assistant, based in Singapore, to provide full support to the Managing Director, APAC Head of Commercial, covering the responsibilities outlined below. You will also support other Managing Directors in the APAC leadership team, including travel arrangements, expense claims and other administrative support as needed.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* **Manage Complex Calendars:** Proactively manage busy calendars, coordinate meetings across multiple time zones, resolve scheduling conflicts and help prioritise competing demands.
* **Coordinate Travel:** Arrange domestic and international business travel, including flights, accommodation, itineraries, visa requirements where applicable, and changes to travel plans when required.
* **Manage Expenses:** Prepare and submit expense claims, reconcile receipts and follow up on outstanding information in line with company policy.
* **Coordinate Meetings and Leadership Activities:** Organise internal and external meetings, and support leadership meetings, presentations, briefing materials, team events and other APAC leadership activities. Track agreed actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders where required.
* **Support Senior Stakeholders:** Work effectively with senior internal and external stakeholders across APAC and globally, helping coordinate communication and follow-up between executives and relevant teams, while acting with professionalism and discretion.
* **Coordinate Administrative Projects:** Independently manage administrative activities or projects involving multiple stakeholders, ensuring actions are completed accurately and on time.
* **Take Initiative and Solve Problems:** Anticipate executive needs, identify scheduling or administrative issues and take appropriate action to resolve them.
* **Provide Broader EA Support:** Support other Managing Directors in the APAC leadership team, including arranging business travel, managing expense claims and providing other administrative support as needed.
* **Maintain Confidentiality:** Handle sensitive business and employee information with a high level of discretion and professional judgement.

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* At least 5 years of relevant Executive Assistant experience supporting senior executives or multiple senior leaders.
* Proven experience managing complex calendars and international travel across different time zones.
* Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams.

Counterfeiting and illicit trade demand coordinated action across brand owners, logistics providers and enforcement agencies. TAPA APAC brings these stakeholders together—and we are seeking an experienced professional to lead that engagement across Asia Pacific.
  
  
As Regional Brand Protection & Industry Engagement Lead – APAC, you will take ownership of the relationships that drive adoption of TAPA APAC’s established Brand Protection programme and standards. Engage Brand Owners, manufacturers, intellectual property rights holders and corporate Brand Protection, security and investigations teams.
  
  
Drive programme adoption.
  
  
Work with Brand Owners and Logistics Service Providers to identify needs, address adoption barriers and secure participation in the programme.
  
  
Strengthen public-private collaboration.
  
  
Develop relationships with Customs, Law Enforcement Agencies and government stakeholders to support lawful information-sharing, industry dialogue and capacity-building.
  
  
Deliver regional growth.

Technical drafting and standards governance remain with TAPA APAC’s CREATE team. Your focus will be stakeholder leadership, collaboration and programme growth.

You will have
  
  
at least five years of directly relevant experience
  
  
in Brand Protection, corporate or supply-chain security, investigations, Customs, law enforcement or a closely related role.
  
  
**We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:**  
Direct ownership of external stakeholder relationships, with clear examples of sustained engagement and results.
  
  
Credibility with Brand Owners and/or Customs or Law Enforcement Agencies, and the ability to engage logistics and supply-chain stakeholders.
  
  
A working understanding of counterfeiting, illicit trade, product diversion and supply-chain operations.
  
  
The ability to turn stakeholder needs into partnerships, programme participation, adoption or commercial outcomes.
  
  
Strong presentation, negotiation and facilitation skills, supported by disciplined prospecting and follow-up.
  
  
The independence to manage regional priorities and remain accountable for agreed objectives.
  
  
Professional proficiency in English and willingness to travel across Asia Pacific.
  
  
Experience across multiple APAC markets, an established stakeholder network, membership or business development achievements, and additional Asian-language capabilities will be advantageous.
  
  
We welcome relevant backgrounds from
  
  
Brand Owner protection and security teams, Customs and law enforcement, LSP security functions, and specialist investigations or risk consultancies
  
  
. A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience is welcome.
  
  
Why Join TAPA APAC?
  
  
**Regional ownership:**  
Lead a dedicated Brand Protection engagement and adoption agenda across Asia Pacific.
  
  
**Access to leadership:**  
Work directly with the Executive Director and collaborate with industry leaders.
  
  
**Meaningful industry contribution:**  
Bring Brand Owners, logistics providers and authorities together to address counterfeit and illicit supply chains.
  
  
**An established platform:**  
Build on an existing programme, standards and international supply-chain security community.
  
  
Apply
  
  
If you bring the domain experience, stakeholder credibility and drive to move this agenda forward, we would like to hear from you.
  
  
Send your
  
  
CV and a brief summary of your relevant stakeholder engagement and delivery achievements
  
  
to
  
  
secretariat@tapa-apac.org
  
  
.
  
  
**Email subject:**  
Application – Regional Brand Protection & Industry Engagement Lead – APAC
  
  
Please describe your experience and professional relationships without disclosing confidential information.
  
  
Shortlisting will focus on relevant industry experience, stakeholder credibility and demonstrated results.
  
  
The Leading Association for Global Supply Chain Resilience & Sustainability
  
  
The Transported Asset Protection Association (TAPA) is the leading global association that unites supply chain industry leaders and organizations with the common aim of upholding the highest standards of supply chain resilience and sustainability.
  
  
Today, in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), The Americas and Asia Pacific (APAC), TAPA’s membership is at its highest ever level – and growing month-on-month. The Association’s members include many of the world’s leading manufacturing brands as well as their logistics and transport providers with combined annual sales of over US$900 billion.
  
  
At Asia Pacific, TAPA APAC is the fastest growing supply chain community of over 1000 member companies, government agencies and custom partners in the region.
  
  
**TAPA APAC members include:**  
Manufacturers & Shippers;
  
  
Logistic Service Providers;
  
  
Security Service Providers;
  
  
Insurance Providers;
  
  
Parking Place Operators;
  
  
Independent Audit Bodies;
  
  
Law Enforcement Agencies, Government Entities & Customs Partners;
  
  
Academic Partners and others.
  
  
Mission
  
  
To minimize cargo losses from the supply chain. TAPA achieves this through the development and application of global security standards, recognized industry practices, technology, education, benchmarking, regulatory collaboration, and the proactive identification of crime trends and supply chain security threats
  
  
Vision
  
  
TAPA’s vision is an international supply chain where controlled and traceable product can be transported in a cost efficient and secure environment.

title: Sales Director APAC (Singapore-based)
description:
**About Kaiko**

Finance is moving onchain. Stocks, funds, bonds and cash are being tokenized, settlement is getting close to instant, and markets are starting to trade around the clock. That shift only works if every participant can trust the data it runs on.

Kaiko is that trusted data partner. Banks, asset managers, exchanges, market makers, fund administrators and regulators use us to price, trade, value, manage risk and report as markets become digital, global and always on.

**What we do**

* Market data: institutional-grade trade and order-book data from traditional, digital and onchain venues, normalized into one reliable source.
* Analytics: liquidity, market structure, derivatives and onchain insight that turn raw data into decisions.
* Indices and reference rates: transparent, rules-based 24/7 benchmarks and continuous pricing used to value portfolios, mark collateral and build investment products.
* Data infrastructure: resilient, always-on delivery through APIs, cloud, partner channels and AI-ready access, built into the systems our clients already use.

In September 2026, Kaiko extended its Series B to $110M, led by S&P Global, with BNP Paribas, Bpifrance, Broadridge, Canton, Coinbase Ventures, DRW Venture Capital, Nasdaq Ventures, Royal Bank of Canada, Stellar, and Susquehanna. This year we also acquired Amberdata and Cometh, which broadens our analytics, data and onchain capabilities. Kaiko is SOC 1 and SOC 2 certified and MiCA- and DORA-compliant: the standards institutions expect from a critical data provider.

**Who We Are**

We’re a team of over 100 passionate individuals with a deep interest in building data solutions and supporting the growth of the digital finance economy. We’re proud of Kaiko’s talented team and are committed to our international representation and diversity. Our people and their values are the foundation of our continued success.

### **About the Role**

The Sales Director - APAC will execute Kaiko’s APAC GTM strategy, set and track clear KPIs, achieve regional sales targets, and be a leader to the Kaiko APAC team.

The role is based out of Kaiko’s Singapore office, with necessary regional travels.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build a healthy, growing pipeline: generate opportunities (inbound and outbound) by identifying, contacting, qualifying prospects.
* Meet and exceed ARR booking quotas: prospect in a smart way and book qualified meetings with decision-makers, negotiate contracts, work with legal to write agreements, and close deals.
* Participate in events in your region to proactively approach new prospects.
* Execute sales strategies to accelerate growth. Influence and implement the sales playbook, create and execute territory plan, and prepare and drive accurate revenue forecasts.
* Actively participate in closing complex opportunities in collaboration with Kaiko team members and develop an extensive partner network, building effective relationships across the target landscape and across the broader ecosystem.
* Leverage and maintain internal Sales dashboard and tools.
* Effective coordination with the Kaiko global sales team, and operations, product, engineering, and legal teams to execute and meet sales objectives.
* Mentor juniors and lead by example.

  

**Must Haves**

* Background and experience in decentralized finance and blockchains
* Understanding of traditional finance markets and financial concepts (rates, indices, risk management tools such as implied volatility and surface vol, trades and order-book data, etc.)
* Excellent commercial skills with a strategic mindset
* Ability to develop and nurture relationships
* Excellent communication skills
* Fluent English - both written and spoken, with proficiency in at least one additional language (Mandarin, Korean, Japanese)

  

**Nice to have**

* Strong affinity and exposure to the financial data industry, specifically with experience in crypto or similar markets.
* Ability to listen carefully, understand needs and build trusted relationships, including at senior executive level in large complex organisations.
* Have sold to financial institutions and bring strong pattern recognition in this space along with the exposure to broader B2B SaaS.

**What we offer**

* 24 paid holidays
* Great health insurance
* Contribution to your monthly gym subscription
* Remote-friendly position
* Multiple team events (annual retreat, casual drinks, etc.)
* An entrepreneurial environment with a lot of autonomy and responsibilities
  

**Talent Acquisition Process**

* Call with HR
* Call with the Hiring Manager
* Cross team interview with 2-3 team members
* Case study
* Reference Check & Offer

**Interested?**

Write a short letter to tell us why you’d be a good fit for this opportunity and why you’d like to join Kaiko then send it to us along with your CV. We look forward to reading your application.

As our working language is English, we would appreciate it if you send us your application and accompanying documents in English.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

At Kaiko, we believe in the diversity of thought because we appreciate that this makes us stronger. Therefore, we encourage applications from everyone who can offer their unique experience to our collective achievements.

title: Events & Experience Manager
description:
### **ABOUT WORLD TABLE TENNIS**

World Table Tennis is where the sport’s fiercest battles meet bold ideas and creative minds. WTT is powered by a global crew of innovators, storytellers, and game-changers, who bring energy, expertise, and imagination to everything they do.

We’re not your typical workplace; we’re the global engine behind a sport on the rise. So whether it’s staging iconic global events or redefining fan experiences, this is where bold ideas get built, and where every role has impact. At WTT, the arena simply hits different.

### **EVENTS & EXPERIENCE MANAGER**

The Events & Experience Manager will support the successful planning and delivery of WTT events, ensuring consistent operational standards and a high-quality experience for players, officials, spectators, partners and other stakeholders.

Working closely with the Heads of Events, Event Managers, Competition Managers, Event Organisers and relevant WTT departments, the position will coordinate event preparations, operational requirements, branding and event experience initiatives.

The role will also contribute to event bidding processes, the development of operational manuals and the continuous improvement of WTT events.

While reporting to one designated Head of Events, the position may support activities across the wider WTT event portfolio.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Event Planning & Coordination:**

* Support the planning, preparation and delivery of WTT events in accordance with WTT Event Manuals and operational standards.
* Coordinate event timelines, operational requirements and deliverables with Event Organisers and relevant WTT departments.
* Organise and participate in event planning meetings, maintain progress trackers and monitor key deadlines.
* Support event readiness assessments and follow up on outstanding operational requirements.
* Attend assigned events and provide onsite operational support, including issue resolution and escalation where required.

##### **Event Experience & Activation:**

* Support the development and implementation of a consistent, high-quality event experience across the WTT portfolio.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Creative Media & Engagement, Sport Presentation and other departments on event branding, presentation and activations.
* Support initiatives to enhance the experience of players, spectators, partners and other stakeholders.
* Identify creative opportunities to improve event engagement and strengthen the WTT brand.

##### **Event Organiser & Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Maintain effective communication with Event Organisers, host organisations, suppliers and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor operational deliverables and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding requirements.
* Support site inspections, planning meetings and event evaluations.
* Assist Event Managers and Heads of Events in resolving operational and stakeholder-related matters.

##### **Event Bidding & Host Assessment:**

* Support the coordination of event bidding processes and host-city assessments.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing event proposals, operational requirements and supporting documentation.
* Monitor event-related administrative and financial obligations in coordination with relevant departments.
* Support the evaluation of potential host cities, venues and event organisers.

##### **Event Manuals & Operational Standards:**

* Contribute to the development and updating of WTT Event Manuals, operational guidelines, procedures and planning tools.
* Maintain accurate event documentation, progress reports and operational records.
* Support the standardisation of event planning and delivery processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through new procedures, technologies and event management tools.

##### **Cross-Departmental Coordination & Reporting:**

* Work closely with WTT Events, Operations, Commercial, Creative Media & Engagement, Sport Presentation and other relevant departments.
* Ensure event requirements, timelines and operational information are communicated effectively.
* Provide regular progress updates, identify outstanding matters and escalate significant risks or delays.
* Support post-event evaluations and the implementation of lessons learned across the event portfolio.

### **REQUIREMENTS**

##### **Essentials:**

* Degree or equivalent qualification in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* At least three years of relevant experience in sports event management, live events or international event delivery.
* Experience coordinating event delivery with event organisers, venues, suppliers and other stakeholders.
* Understanding of event operations, logistics, branding and stakeholder services.
* Strong organisational, administrative and project management skills, with the attention to detail needed to manage multiple projects, competing deadlines and changing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to communicate clearly, work collaboratively across cultures and take the initiative to resolve problems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and event or project management tools.
* Willingness to travel internationally, work flexible hours during event periods and support different event functions as needed.

##### **Desirables:**

* Experience working in professional sport or delivering international sporting events.
* Experience delivering event activations or supporting host-city bids.
* Experience developing event manuals or operational procedures.
* Creativity and a commitment to improving the event experience for participants and stakeholders.

title: Head, Transformation Execution
description:
**Job Profile Summary:**  
Prudential Singapore is advancing a bold transformation agenda under our Prudential initiatives — reshaping how we execute with discipline, rigor, and strategic foresight to enable sustainable value creation. This demands strong delivery governance, system stewardship, and execution maturity at scale.
  
  
The Strategy & Transformation Office (STO) anchors this transformation —ensuring the company’s most critical initiatives are delivered with speed, integrity, and results. This requires a step-change in how we lead execution across a complex, multi-year portfolio, embedding the capability and rhythm to deliver on ambition.
  
  
Role Purpose and Summary
  
  
As Head of Transformation Execution, you will lead PACS' enterprise delivery engine - ensuring that our strategic transformation portfolio translates strategy into measurable business outcomes. Beyond establishing delivery discipline and transparency, you will work with business leaders to actively shape execution choices, unblock performance, and strengthen the conditions required to realise value across the portfolio.
  
  
You will act as a key counterpart to the CSTO, anchoring cadence forums such as TWG while working closely with business, operations, finance, and technology leaders to improve portfolio performance. You will use health checks, diagnostics, and benefits insights to identify where intervention is needed, influence the movement of key value metrics, and lead special projects or performance recovery efforts where complexity or urgency is high.
  
  
This role is for a strategic operator — someone who can bridge execution muscle with leadership maturity, able to translate complexity into clarity and deliver results at scale.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Transformation Operating Rhythm
  
  

* Lead the Transformation Working Group (TWG), ensuring timely visibility of delivery health, interdependencies, and escalation points
* Shape the cadence of enterprise delivery— linking ambition, initiative health, and decision-making forums
* Translate portfolio insights into action by working with accountable executives and initiative teams to remove delivery barriers, make trade-offs, and improve execution outcomes

Program Governance & Risk Management
  
  

* Steward the enterprise transformation portfolio (High 8 digit value), driving project health checks, portfolio diagnostics, and recovery plans
* Own delivery governance — ensure standards are applied, risks are surfaced early, and decisions are acted upon
* Interface directly with Group Technology, Group Transformation, Group Risk, and Audit

Portfolio Value & Benefits Realisation
  
  

* Lead portfolio-level benefits realisation, ensuring delivery milestones are connected to measurable business outcomes and value metrics through Kiplot, Power BI, or equivalent tools
* Partner with business, Finance, and Strategy leaders to validate benefit assumptions, establish clear baselines and owners, and maintain alignment between initiative impact, strategic priorities, and commercial outcomes
* Work closely with business owners to diagnose why expected benefits or performance metrics are not moving, agree targeted interventions, and influence corrective action across initiatives
* Provide a portfolio-wide view of benefits, including value at risk, cross-initiative dependencies, emerging trade-offs, and opportunities to accelerate or increase value
* Challenge initiative teams constructively on benefit ambition, delivery choices, and outcome evidence, escalating material gaps while retaining clear business accountability for realisation

Execution Uplift & Capability Building
  
  

* Strengthen execution discipline through tools, templates, coaching, and feedback loops
* Partner with project managers, change leads, and business stakeholders to raise the bar of delivery rigor

Special Projects, Health Checks & Execution (COE)
  
  

* Lead initiative and program health checks to assess readiness, risk, and performance gaps
* Stand up and deploy impact teams into high-priority or at-risk initiatives
* Drive special projects or turnaround missions requiring rapid mobilization and leadership
* Represent PACS’ internal execution capability— offering structured support into enterprise-critical issues

**Who we are looking for:**  
Competencies and Behaviours Expected
  
  
·
  
  
Execution Discipline & Leadership Maturity
  
  
: You bring structure, insight, and calm under pressure. You operate with ownership, integrity, and high judgment
  
  
·
  
  
**Business Partnership & Value Influence:**  
You combine commercial judgement, data, and constructive challenge to help business leaders shift performance metrics and realise value, without taking accountability away from benefit owners
  
  
·
  
  
Systems Thinking & Interdependency Navigation
  
  
: You see the whole —connecting across teams, functions, and forums to keep the system aligned and focused
  
  
·
  
  
Strategic & Delivery Fluency
  
  
: You speak both strategy and execution. You elevate enterprise conversations by grounding them in risk, capacity, and cadence
  
  
·
  
  
Performance Uplift & Coaching
  
  
: You model and embed high standards. You’re comfortable giving feedback, growing talent, and building enduring systems
  
  
Role Requirements / What You Bring to the Team
  
  
You are a senior transformation leader with deep experience navigating complex portfolios and operating models. You understand how to lead through systems —balancing stakeholder alignment, governance design, and execution performance. You bring presence, resilience, and sharp delivery instincts.

description:
About Custera
  
  
Custera O&M Pte. Ltd. is an engineering-led infrastructure maintenance and renewal company making urban transport assets safer, smarter and more resilient. About the Role
  
  
We are seeking an organised and dependable Project Admin Executive to provide administrative, workforce and document support to our project teams. The role helps keep daily project operations running smoothly through accurate records, timely coordination and effective follow-up with site and Head Office teams. Fresh graduates with strong administrative skills are welcome to apply.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Project Manager and project team.
* Maintain orderly electronic and hard-copy filing of correspondence, reports, records, forms and project documents.
* Track employee and worker attendance, deployment, leave, time records and other workforce information for timely submission to Head Office.
* Coordinate training, safety-course enrolment, site access, certification and related administrative requirements.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, trackers, presentations, reports and follow-up records.
* Coordinate office supplies, project stationery, fixed-asset records, deliveries and general site-office logistics.
* Support purchase requests, invoice documentation, claims records and other project administrative processes as assigned.
* Liaise with site personnel, subcontractors, suppliers and Head Office departments on administrative and documentation matters.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy when handling employee, commercial and project information.

Qualifications & Requirements
  
  

* Diploma, Higher Nitec or equivalent qualification in Business Administration, Management or a related discipline.
* Fresh graduates may be considered; experience in project, construction or site administration is an advantage.
* Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and electronic filing.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail.
* Able to organise multiple priorities, follow through on deadlines and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional, service-oriented and able to coordinate confidently with employees at different levels.

Work Arrangement
  
  
This role supports both office and project-site operations. The incumbent must be prepared to visit project sites and perform ad hoc shift work outside normal working hours when required. Timing will depend on the assigned project.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  

* Exposure to civil, infrastructure maintenance and asset-renewal projects in Singapore.
* Opportunities to work with engineering, inspection, monitoring and digital solutions in live operating environments.
* A collaborative and professional team culture that values safety, practical problem-solving and continuous improvement.
* Learning and development opportunities to build technical and project-delivery capability.
* Competitive remuneration and employee benefits commensurate with experience and performance.

Custera Pte. Ltd. is an engineering solutions company specialising in the maintenance, renewal, and monitoring of critical infrastructure assets. We combine advanced engineering expertise with intelligent monitoring systems to extend asset life, enhance reliability, and ensure operational safety.
  
  
Our work spans across sectors such as civil infrastructure, delivering sustainable solutions that integrate design innovation, digital technologies, and on-ground execution excellence.
  
  
At Custera, we believe in engineering with foresight- applying data-driven insights and multidisciplinary collaboration to manage infrastructure smarter, safer, and more efficiently.

title: General Manager - Surf Club
description:
P&L & commercial
  
  
**Own the Surf Club P&L in full:** revenue target, pricing, mix, margin.
  
  
**Own utilisation as the core operating metric:** session scheduling, peak/off-peak pricing, throughput planning to materially lift utilisation.
  
  
**Report monthly:** revenue vs target, membership metrics, utilisation, repeat rate.
  
  
Membership & product
  
  
Design, price and improve the Trifecta Surf Club membership and social pack portfolio.
  
  
Own membership sales end to end — tours, trials, walk-in conversion, renewals and win-back — executed through the BU team; there is no dedicated sales executive.
  
  
Own renewal rate and member lifetime value; build referral mechanics with the programming & community IC.
  
  
Own the progression pathway that gives members a reason to stay (levels, coaching, milestones).
  
  
Demand & marketing
  
  
**Partner with the Growth & CRM Lead on funnels:** trial offers, conversion sequences, lapsed-guest win-back.
  
  
Own the offers; brief the shared studio through the Head of Brand for creative execution.
  
  
Own the surf events calendar through the programming & community IC: members' nights, progression events, community sessions.
  
  
Team leadership
  
  
Lead and develop the team; set individual KPIs cascaded from BU priorities.
  
  
Rosters and timesheets run through the central scheduling function; Guest Experience (GX) crew take shift commands from the MOD (Duty Manager).
  
  
Head instructor scope is programs and syllabus
  
  
Operations & standards
  
  
Uphold safety and instruction quality standards with the Facilities lead and MODs; safety authority on the floor is absolute and sits with the MOD.
  
  
Plan arena maintenance windows with Facilities to protect peak revenue.
  
  
Decision Authority
  
  
**Decides:** pricing within bands, session scheduling, BU marketing execution, team hiring within budget, membership product design. Escalates to COO: pricing outside bands, new product lines, anything affecting another BU.
  
  
What Success Looks Like
  
  
**First 90 days:**  
Membership and social packs' sales process running for every tour, trial and walk-in; baseline funnel metrics visible. Team on track to meet targets.
  
  
**12 months:**  
Material recurring membership base with strong renewals; utilisation materially and sustainably higher; revenue tracking to target; repeat rate and NPS improving.
  
  
**Requirements:**  
7+ years commercial leadership in fitness, clubs, hospitality or attractions.
  
  
Built recurring revenue from a low base and carried the sales number personally.
  
  
P&L ownership and team leadership across mixed functions.
  
  
Credibility with surf and board sports culture, or the ability to earn it fast.
  
  
**Good to have:**  
Boutique fitness, country club or premium membership experience in Southeast Asia.
  
  
Working knowledge of booking/CRM platforms.
  
  
Final round includes presenting a 90-day membership growth plan.

title: General Svcs Operations Mgr - C12 - SINGAPORE
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

**Job Purpose**

Support the strategic, operational, and vendor leadership for Global Hospitality Services (GHS) across Singapore and the broader Asia South cluster hub. This role is dedicated to elevating the workplace experience, enhancing senior client and stakeholder perception, driving colleague engagement, and embedding operational resilience across Singapore's campus footprint (supporting 9,000+ colleagues).

As a permanent operational pillar for Singapore GHS operations, this role delivers service excellence, vendor governance, and strict adherence to global standards across high-touch hospitality environments—including Client Centers, Global Wealth Hubs, Executive Dining, colleague dining venues, pantries, automated vending, and event catering. The role provides crucial operational continuity, assists in mitigating single-point-of-failure vulnerabilities, and ensures high-quality, cost-effective service delivery across a critical regional financial hub.

**Job Background / Context**

Colleague and Client Services (CCS) delivers essential core products and tailored local solutions that underpin all of Citi's business lines globally. Singapore represents a profoundly strategic location for Citi, operating as a key regional headquarters and the central Asia South cluster hub supporting over 9,000 colleagues across multiple campus sites, including Asia Square and Changi. The quality of the workplace experience in Singapore is critical to fostering a vibrant, high-performing corporate environment that directly elevates client impression, executive engagement, colleague satisfaction, and overall productivity.

Global Hospitality Services (GHS) is a core strategic function within CCS, dedicated to designing, operating, and delivering high-performance workplace settings and premier hospitality experiences. In Singapore, GHS manages a diverse, high-touch portfolio encompassing:

* Premier client engagement at flagship Client Centers and Global Wealth Hubs
* Reception and executive concierge services
* Executive culinary operations and bespoke event catering
* Multi-venue colleague dining and cafeteria operations
* Campus-wide pantry services and automated micro-market/vending solutions
* Collaborative fitness, wellness, and colleague hospitality amenities

To ensure operational sustainability, vendor accountability, and continuous on-site supervision within this fast-paced hub, this C12 position establishes permanent operational oversight, supports the C13 Operations Manager, and ensures robust governance, financial stewardship, risk management, and service continuity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations Excellence & Site Supervision**

* Drive day-to-day operational excellence across all Singapore hospitality touchpoints, ensuring seamless delivery across Client Centers, Global Wealth Hubs, dining facilities, pantries, and meeting suites.
* Oversee on-site third-party service providers and contractors, conducting regular Quality Assurance (QA) and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) inspections to enforce high service standards and contractual compliance.
* Maintain operational resiliency and business continuity across Singapore premises, serving as on-site operational lead and escalation point during peak operational cycles or managerial vacancies.

**2. Strategic Support & Vendor Governance**

* Manage third-party vendor relationships, monitoring vendor SLAs, performance scorecards, issue resolution, and corporate social responsibility/sustainability initiatives.
* Collaborate closely with Citi country representatives, business unit managers, and cluster leadership to align hospitality provisions with evolving business needs and regional growth strategies.
* Partner with regional GHS management on space planning, new hospitality product rollouts, and facility enhancement projects across Singapore sites.

**3. Service Improvement & Compliance Oversight**

* Champion continuous service improvement initiatives, capturing client and colleague feedback to refine executive catering, daily dining, and concierge operations.
* Ensure comprehensive alignment with Citi’s Global Hospitality standards, brand guidelines, and local statutory regulations across all campus amenities.
* Oversee operational metrics, reporting dashboards, and management information systems to maintain data integrity and support regional cluster reporting.

**4. Financial Management & Reporting Assistance**

* Support the management and monitoring of Singapore GHS operational budgets (OPEX/CAPEX), identifying efficiency and cost-optimization opportunities without compromising service quality.
* Oversee purchase order (PO) workflows, invoice validation, accruals, and expense reconciliation in coordination with Citi Resource Management / Expense Management teams.
* Consolidate statistical reporting, volume metrics, and subsidy/revenue tracking across dining and catering channels.

**5. Regulatory Adherence, Risk Management & Health/Safety**

* Implement and enforce stringent risk control measures and compliance policies, proactively safeguarding Citi against operational and reputational risks.
* Oversee food safety, hygiene standards, and health & safety compliance (HACCP/local regulatory requirements) across all culinary preparation and service areas, maintaining audit readiness at all times.
* Manage confidential operational documentation, third-party staff onboarding clearances, and compliance governance protocols in accordance with Citi’s staffing and security policies.

**Person Specification**

**Knowledge / Experience**

* **Operations & Management Experience:** 5–8 years of proven operations experience with a strong background in hospitality management, corporate food & beverage, executive dining, or multi-service corporate facilities environments.
* **Vendor & Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated track record in managing third-party outsourced service partners, contract governance, SLA enforcement, and senior corporate client liaison.
* **Controls & Governance Acumen:** Solid understanding of corporate operational controls, audit protocols, risk mitigation strategies, and health/food safety compliance.
* **Multi-Site Corporate Exposure:** Proven ability to operate effectively within a large-scale, matrixed financial institution or multinational corporate campus.

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Leadership & Agility:** Strong self-motivation, resilience, and adaptability to manage multiple concurrent priorities in a demanding, fast-paced environment.
* **Communication & Relationship Building:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the confidence to interact with senior executive leadership, corporate clients, and external suppliers.
* **Analytical & Financial Literacy:** Proficient in budget monitoring, data analytics, KPI scorecard tracking, and MS Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
* **Problem Solving & Decision Making:** Sound analytical capabilities to assess complex operational bottlenecks, implement corrective actions, and escalate appropriately.

**Qualifications**

* **Education:** University degree (Bachelor’s or Master’s) in Hospitality Management, Hotel/Restaurant Administration, Business Administration, Facility Management, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of relevant working experience in high-standard hospitality or corporate client services operations.

title: Senior Operational Resilience Specialist - Singapore & Hong Kong
description:
**General information**
  
  
**Country:** Singapore
  
  
**Creation Date:** 19-Nov-2026
  
  
**Employment Type:** Permanent
  
  
**Employment Type:** Full time
  
  
**Ref #:** 1234573751
  
  
**Description & Requirements**
  
  
The Senior Operational Resilience Specialist, TPRM & BC will provide guidance and oversight to enable the business to effectively execute an appropriate balance between managing operational resilience, service provider risk management and business continuity obligations, while supporting strategy, commercial outcomes and regulatory compliance.
  
  
The role is responsible for supporting the development, implementation and oversight of Liberty's operational resilience, service provider risk management and business continuity frameworks, plans, registers and related controls. This includes ensuring business adherence to relevant policies and compliance obligations under applicable standards and regulations of the market throughout the service provider management lifecycle and broader resilience program.
  
  
The Senior Operational Resilience Specialist works closely with cross-functional stakeholders to identify, assess and manage operational resilience, service provider and business continuity risks. These include Procurement, Business Owners, Risk and Compliance, Information Technology, Legal, Audit, Operations and Crisis Management teams, as well as regional and global stakeholders where required.
  
  
This role supports Singapore and Hong Kong's operational resilience framework, business continuity obligations and service provider management requirements, including those organisations that deliver critical operations on Liberty's behalf, aligned to Liberty Mutual principles and guidelines.
  
  
The role is responsible for advising on and ensuring adequate business adherence to the Service Provider Management Policy and the compliance obligations under applicable Prudential Standards, throughout the Service Provider Management Lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
  

* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure compliance with requirements for operational resilience, business continuity and all Service Providers, including materiality and due diligence assessments, risk assessments, reporting, incident and breach management, service provider monitoring, performance exceptions and business continuity planning.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure compliance with requirements for Material Service Providers (MSPs) where required, and critical operations, including regulatory notifications and submissions, contract clauses, process mapping, tolerance setting, audit engagement, and regulatory and governance reporting. Maintain relevant registers, plans and resilience artefacts.
* Provide advisory and consultation on contingency, transition and recovery planning for material service providers, critical operations and broader business continuity arrangements.
* Support business / relationship owners to monitor resilience, service provider and business continuity data health, identify exceptions, vulnerabilities and gaps, and coordinate remediation activities and action plans with stakeholders.
* Support the development, implementation, change management and administration of operational resilience, business continuity and service provider risk assessment tools, frameworks and associated procedures.
* Assist with the development, implementation and maintenance of policies, frameworks, standards, plans, playbooks and procedures supporting operational resilience and business continuity.
* Embed operational resilience, business continuity and service provider risk management into the culture of the organisation by increasing awareness through coaching, forums, training and stakeholder engagement.
* Provide subject matter expertise, support and consultation to the business in managing operational resilience, business continuity and service provider risk across operations, projects and change initiatives.
* Coordinate and conduct regular testing activities, including critical operations simulations, company-wide scenario tests, business continuity exercises and drills.
* Support the Crisis Management team during disruptions, including coordination activities, monitoring tolerances, providing advice, reporting, escalation, post-incident reporting and follow-up activities.
* Work with stakeholders and support Line 2 to prepare regulatory notifications, consultations and incident reporting related to resilience and business continuity obligations.
* Support relationship owners to identify and monitor risks relating to operational disruption and resilience vulnerabilities and liaise with relevant stakeholders on remediation activities.
* Identify areas for improvement and solutions to streamline processes and further enhance resilience outcomes and service to all stakeholders.
* Demonstrate behaviour at all times in line with the Liberty core values.
* Take responsibility and show initiative in the development of your technical and soft skills.
* Perform other related duties as assigned by your manager or other appropriate officer.

  
**Experience & Qualification Requirements:**  
  
  

* At least 6-8 years' demonstrated experience in operational resilience, business continuity, risk management or compliance, preferably within the insurance industry. Additional experience in insurance operations is desirable.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Commerce, Business Administration, IT, Law or another relevant field highly desirable.
* Professional industry memberships, qualifications or certifications in operational resilience, business continuity, risk management, compliance or governance are desirable.
* Proven strong knowledge of industry processes and regulations, including Singapore/Hong Kong prudential standards, and experience in regulatory-driven change programmes and initiatives.
* Experience in Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) applications, resilience tooling or other systems supporting compliance and continuity management is desirable.
* Experience producing operational, executive, committee or regulatory reporting, including incident, disruption or post-incident reporting.

description:
Secretlab is an international gaming chair brand seating over three million users worldwide, with our key markets in the United States, Europe and Singapore, where we are headquartered.

The Head of Information Security (HoIS) is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously maturing the enterprise-wide information security, data protection, and cyber risk management program. This role provides strategic direction and executive oversight to ensure the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets while enabling business growth, regulatory compliance, and market trust.

Reporting to the General Counsel, the HoIS serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership, translating cyber and data risks into business and legal impact, and ensuring security-by-design is embedded across technology, product development, and operations. The role balances governance and risk leadership with pragmatic execution through strong delegation to specialist security managers.

**Responsibilities**

* Implement secure architecture, cloud security, and ensure secure development practices are embedded across the organization
* Lead complex incident response, threat containment, and crisis management strategies—including technical root-cause analysis, advanced tabletop simulations, data breach mitigation, and regulatory forensics—requiring extensive hands-on technical IR expertise and deep tactical experience
* Oversee data protection and privacy-by-design practices in collaboration with Legal, Compliance, Data and business stakeholders
* Direct and mentor Information Security Managers across application security, security operations, GRC, and privacy domains, leveraging advanced technical depth to drive engineering skill set enhancements and operational maturity
* Conduct periodic vulnerability assessments and penetration testing across infrastructure, developing actionable remediation roadmaps and infrastructure hardening plans
* Own third-party and supply-chain security risk management, ensuring vendors meet contractual, regulatory, and security requirements
* Build and promote a strong security culture through awareness, training, and executive and technical engagement
* Define and execute the enterprise information security and cyber risk strategy aligned with business objectives, legal obligations, and regulatory expectations
* Establish and oversee security governance, policies, standards, and metrics aligned with recognized frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, PCI-DSS)

title: Trading Operator, Fuel Oil and Bunkers (External)
description:
### **Contexte et environnement**

Ready for your next challenge in Trading Operations?

  
  

We are looking for a **Trading Operator, Fuel Oil and Bunkers** to join our Singapore team. At the heart of the trading activity, you will work closely with traders and counterparties to manage the end-to-end execution of physical transactions, coordinate complex logistics and find solutions when operational challenges arise.

  
  

This is a great opportunity to deepen your knowledge of **Fuel Oil and Bunkers**, strengthen your commercial and operational expertise, and gain broad exposure across Trading, Shipping, Credit, Treasury, Finance and other key functions.

  

The Trading Operator is based in Singapore and reports directly to a Trading Operations Manager in the Singapore office. This role also operates under the local supervision of the Trading Operations General Manager.

  
  

### **Activités**

**What You Will Do:**

  
  

* Coordinate logistics for all loading/discharging by sea and/or overland, avoiding and mitigating any potential hazardous situations.
* Follow up on vessels chartered by the company (spot, COA, or T/C) and optimize rotations and loading plans.
* Nominate essential service providers (independent inspectors, loss controllers, additive suppliers, etc.) and ensure the accuracy and consistency of the results obtained.
* Diligently manage storage and process contracts (quantities, qualities, financial exposure, customs, etc.).
* Identify the cause of any operational problems encountered and ensure resolution through coordination with all affected stakeholders, mitigating costs and consequences for the company.
* Obtain financial guarantees from counterparties, control and/or amend them before cargo loading/unloading, in conjunction with the Credit department.
* Evaluate all costs derived from transactions and communicate all operational data having a financial impact on trading results (prices, hedges, freight, currency, etc.).
* Verify the coherence and feasibility of trading negotiations and formalize commercial contracts.
* Submit damage reports to insurers and compile and follow claim files.
* Ensure compliance with all regulatory aspects (REACH, Customs, VAT, etc.) in collaboration with respective support departments.
* Ensure compliance with vetting procedures for seagoing vessels and barges.
* Adhere to HSE, Code of Conduct, Business Integrity, and all other applicable company policies and procedures at all times.
* Manage the invoicing and payment process and recovery of funds when applicable.
* Where applicable to the role, manage and optimize equity lifting by having an in-depth understanding of Lifting Agreements and Terminal Procedures, including Availabilities, Payment Quantities, etc.

### **Profil du candidat**

* You hold a Bachelor’s degree and have at least 3 years of experience in trading operations.

* You have proven experience managing end-to-end trade execution with a high level of autonomy.
* You have knowledge, interest, and curiosity in the energy/trading business and are willing to learn.
* You enjoy facing challenges and have a strong sense of commitment and flexibility.
* You have a good commercial instinct, a solution-oriented attitude, and demonstrate a genuine team spirit.
* Rigorous in your approach, you meticulously plan and organize your work, enabling you to thrive in a complex and fast-paced environment and work under time pressure.
* You proactively look for areas of development and do not hesitate to initiate new ideas or ways of doing things.
* You have strong learning agility, particularly in adapting to new systems and processes.
* You have excellent proficiency in English and preferably Mandarin.
  

  

We encourage motivated and curious individuals to apply and take part in shaping the future of trading operations at TotalEnergies.

Vous évoluez au sein d’une compagnie multi-énergies internationale où chaque talent compte. Vous contribuez à des projets ambitieux et apportez des solutions concrètes aux défis énergétiques.

Tout au long de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de missions variées et de formations sur mesure. Vous développez pleinement votre potentiel dans un environnement qui encourage l’innovation et l’excellence. Intégrez des équipes engagées et solidaires, où la réussite se construit ensemble.

title: Trade Compliance Specialist
description:
**Position:**  
Trade Compliance Specialist
  
  
**Job Description:**  
What You’ll Be Doing
  

* This position ensures compliance with applicable regional, local, and U.S. export and import control laws and regulations concerning the movement of goods and services across borders, in order to protect Arrow from fines, penalties and publicity resulting from violations. The position acts as a liaison among several internal groups across Arrow businesses such as IT, legal, sales, logistics, asset management, operations and others in an effort to ensure proper adherence to trade management and trade control laws and regulations. The position provides import and export clearance support for inbound and outbound shipments and may direct external freight forwarders, brokers, and couriers and internal shipping/transportation staff on clearance instructions.
* Determine and assign local export/import country and U.S. license requirements to orders blocked within trade compliance software for trade control reasons, and to orders processed outside of compliance software or Arrow systems. When necessary, escalate orders to regional department Manager or Program Manager, or regional department leader for guidance.
* Process global supply chain partners review, including reviews of current government restricted / denied parties list matches to confirm decision for partner release or block within trade compliance software, Customer End Use And Export Compliance Certifications (EUC), End User Statements, etc. When necessary, escalate partners to regional department Manager or Program Manager, or regional department leader for guidance.
* Provide shipment clearance instructions on import and export transactions to internal and external contacts. When necessary, engage regional department Manager or Program Manager, or regional department leader for guidance, or shipping department representatives for support.
* Prepare low complexity government license applications when required for select export and import transactions. Process government licenses following local regulations (including reporting for import/export licenses, General Licenses, record keeping, etc.).
* Has no discretion to vary from established procedures

title: Sr Assistant Manager / Manager (IMH), Patient Experience Office
description:
Family Group: Administration

Position: **Sr Assistant Manager /** **Manager**

Department: **Patient Experience Office**

  

*Join us in Adding Years of Healthy Life Through Life-Changing Careers, Where Passion Meets Purpose. Make a meaningful difference whilst growing in a supportive environment that nurtures your wellbeing and career aspirations*

  

**Job Description:**

We are looking for a passionate individual who is committed to improving patient and caregiver experiences, using feedback and insights to drive meaningful change, enhance service delivery and shape the future of mental healthcare.

  

The incumbent will support the HOD and oversee the day-to-day operations of the Patient Experience Office. She/he will play a key role in strengthening patient experience across the organisation by leading the management of patient feedback, identifying issues and opportunities for improvement, and partnering stakeholders to implement service enhancements across the organisation.

  

The role requires a strong passion for understanding patients' and caregivers' experiences, analysing feedback and operational workflows, and translating insights into actionable improvements that enhance care delivery and service excellence. The incumbent will work closely with clinical, operational and corporate departments to advocate for a patient-centric culture and drive quality improvements and support organisational patient experience initiatives.

  

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Oversee the team and daily management/operations of the Patient Experience Office, ensuring timely and appropriate resolution and closure in accordance with organisational service standards and key performance indicators.

* Handle escalated and/or complex feedback to senior management.

* Serve as a key liaison between feedback providers which includes patients and caregivers, Ministries and MPs, or public and hospital stakeholders, facilitating communication and supporting service recovery efforts where necessary. This will include professional, empathetic and patient-centric communication via phone, face-to-face or emails.

* Partner clinical and non-clinical departments to facilitate the resolution of feedback cases and drive sustainable improvements.

* Prepare and/or review monthly data reporting and analysis with data analytics tools such as Excel or MS PowerBI

* Review, monitor and report departmental performance metrics, risks and key initiatives to senior management, and relevant committees/workgroups and work with stakeholders to implement corrective actions where necessary.

* Lead cross-functional patient experience projects, service improvement initiatives and organisational programmes aimed at enhancing patients' and caregivers' experiences across their care journey. This may include the implementation of patient experience surveys, focus groups, in-depth interviews, service redesign initiatives and staff capability-building efforts.

* Develop and manage the team, including performance management, staff development and learning needs planning, regular feedback and coaching, and capability building within the team.

* Oversee departmental resource allocation, budgeting and duty and manpower rostering to ensure efficient and sustainable operations.

* Represent the department in internal and external workgroups, committees, taskforces and organisational projects, contributing subject matter expertise in patient experience and service excellence.

* Keep abreast of developments, trends, regulatory requirements and best practices in healthcare, patient experience, service quality and feedback management, and assess their implications for the organisation.

* Oversee departmental administration and processes, including the maintenance and review of departmental records, standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions (WIs), policies and other relevant documentation.

**Requirements:**

**Competency**

* Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal), interpersonal skills, conflict resolution ability to diffuse situations.

* Good analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to identify root causes and systemic issues from qualitative and quantitative data.

* Experienced in stakeholder management, with the ability to work effectively across multidisciplinary clinical and non-clinical teams.

* Ability to work well under pressure and maintain a positive attitude.

* Self-driven, proactive and able to independently lead improvement initiatives.

* Passionate about patient advocacy and mental health.

**Educational and Professional Requirements**

* General degree, with at least 5-8 years of related working experience.

* Experience in feedback management especially complex case management is essential.

* Healthcare background will be an advantage.

**About IMH:**

The Institute of Mental Health (IMH) in Singapore, established in 1928, is a premier 2,000-bed psychiatric hospital nestled in Buangkok Green Medical Park, providing comprehensive mental health services across 50 inpatient wards and 7 outpatient clinics, while also playing a pivotal role in training the next generation of mental health professionals through the NHG-AHPL Residency Programme and collaborations with local academic institutions.

description:

Leads and supports cavAsia technical operations in Singapore, overseeing projects ranging from medium to large-scale greenfield and retrofit projects primarily within the Pharmaceutical, Semiconductor, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, and Advanced Manufacturing industries.
  
  
The role has overall responsibility for the successful delivery of complex engineering and construction projects, including cleanroom facilities and controlled environments, ensuring compliance with client specifications, industry standards, quality requirements, project schedules, and budget objectives.
  
  
How You Will Do It
  
  
Holds full responsibility and accountability for all technical matters, including engineering, design, construction, commissioning, qualification, project manpower planning, and project schedules across multiple engineering disciplines.
  
  
Leads and oversees the engineering, construction, commissioning, qualification, validation support, and handover of cleanroom facilities and controlled environments, ensuring compliance with applicable industry standards, GMP requirements, client specifications, and operational performance criteria.
  
  
Collaborates with various project teams and Project Managers (PMs) to ensure sufficient project manpower, effective resource allocation, and continuity of project execution across multiple projects.
  
  
Resolves technical, construction, environmental, health and safety (EHS), and operational issues on-site through coordination with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and clients.
  
  
Provides technical leadership and guidance on cleanroom design, contamination control strategies, HVAC systems, pressurization concepts, airflow management, exhaust abatement systems, environmental monitoring, and controlled environment requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
Regularly monitors project progress against construction schedules, variation order (VO) works, commissioning activities, qualification milestones, and contractual deliverables.
  
  
Monitors project manpower requirements to ensure adequate project support and continuity during planned absences and peak project activities.
  
  
Works closely with the Tender Team on project costing, value engineering initiatives, and technical risk assessments during the bidding phase.
  
  
Provides technical support and design review during the tender stage, ensuring practical and cost-effective solutions that meet client and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Coordinates multidisciplinary engineering, construction, commissioning, and qualification teams to achieve project objectives related to safety, quality, schedule, and budget.
  
  
Maintains and enhances positive relationships with clients, contractors, consultants, suppliers, regulatory authorities, and other project stakeholders.
  
  
In Addition to the Above Responsibilities, You Will Also Be Responsible For
  
  
Reviewing and ensuring that PMs develop and maintain detailed project schedules, work plans, resource plans, qualification schedules, and cost controls to achieve project milestones and deliverables.
  
  
Providing technical advice, mentorship, and leadership to project teams on engineering, construction, commissioning, cleanroom operations, and qualification activities.
  
  
Reviewing cleanroom design packages, HVAC system designs, construction methodologies, commissioning strategies, qualification protocols, and handover plans to ensure compliance with project requirements and industry standards.
  
  
Implementing and maintaining effective project governance, risk management, and contingency planning processes across all projects.
  
  
Identifying, reporting, and escalating project risks to Management while developing practical mitigation and recovery plans.
  
  
Managing risks associated with cleanroom construction activities, including contamination control, environmental compliance, facility readiness, validation support, system integration, and operational handover.
  
  
Leading internal functional management activities, including workforce planning, recruitment support, performance management, talent development, succession planning, and employee career progression.
  
  
Conducting employee performance assessments and developing personal development plans to strengthen organizational capability and leadership succession.
  
  
What We Look For
  
  
University degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical, Process, Chemical, Building Services, or related Engineering disciplines.
  
  
Minimum 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in the construction and engineering sector, specifically within Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or Advanced Manufacturing industries.
  
  
Demonstrated experience in the successful delivery of cleanroom facilities and controlled environments, including greenfield and brownfield projects.
  
  
Strong practical experience in cleanroom design and construction, HVAC systems, contamination control, process utilities, environmental control systems, and exhaust abatement systems.
  
  
Experience in overall system design, tendering, value engineering, commissioning, qualification, and project execution processes.
  
  
Sound knowledge of cleanroom classifications (ISO 14644), GMP requirements, commissioning, qualification, validation processes, and facility handover requirements.
  
  
Knowledge of international engineering design codes, construction standards, and industry best practices.
  
  
Strong business partnering, communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead and work effectively within a multicultural and cross-functional environment.
  
  
Proven track record in leading multidisciplinary engineering and project teams while successfully managing safety, quality, schedule, commercial, and client satisfaction objectives.
  
  
Preferred Experience
  
  
Experience leading mission-critical cleanroom and controlled environment projects within Semiconductor, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, Life Sciences, or High-Tech Manufacturing sectors.
  
  
Experience in managing projects involving HVAC systems, cleanroom infrastructure, process utilities, environmental monitoring systems, contamination control strategies, commissioning, qualification, and operational readiness.
  
  
Comprehensive understanding of the full project lifecycle from conceptual design through construction, commissioning, qualification, validation support, and final client handover.

cavAsia is as system and solution provider, we have good engineering know-how to design technically complex systems, have experience project execution team on site to execute and meet fast-track project schedules without compromising quality, as well as assertive safety personnel to ensure all aspect of safety are complied with.
