* Support organizational change initiatives, culture transformation projects, and employee engagement strategies.
* Conduct learning and development needs analyses to address capability gaps and future business requirements.
* Facilitate interventions that improve team effectiveness, collaboration, and workplace culture.

Departmental Training Excellence & Train-the-Trainer Programme
  
  

* Develop, implement, formalize, and continuously enhance a comprehensive Cluster Train-the-Trainer (TTT) Programme across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
* Establish a structured departmental trainer framework to ensure every department maintains qualified and certified trainers who support ongoing learning and capability development.
* Partner with Department Heads to identify, appoint, and develop Departmental Trainers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
* Facilitate Train-the-Trainer certification programmes focusing on adult learning principles, facilitation skills, coaching techniques, presentation effectiveness, and learning evaluation.

* Conduct regular trainer calibration sessions to ensure consistency in learning delivery and alignment with Conrad Brand Standards and Hilton learning philosophies.
* Create and maintain a training governance framework that drives accountability for learning delivery within every department.
* Recognize and celebrate training champions who demonstrate excellence in developing Team Members and fostering a learning culture.

Training Planning & Coordination
  
  

* Lead the annual and quarterly learning planning process across both hotels, ensuring training initiatives are strategically aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.
* Develop comprehensive learning calendars and training schedules that maximize participation while minimizing operational disruption.
* Prioritize learning activities effectively across multiple stakeholders, locations, and business demands.

Operational Partnership
  
  

* Build strong partnerships with General Managers, Executive Committee Members, and Department Heads to align learning initiatives with business needs.
* Conduct regular training reviews and learning effectiveness discussions with department leaders.
* Support operational departments with coaching, facilitation, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Ensure learning interventions support key commercial, operational, guest experience, and people metrics.

Learning Administration & Compliance
  
  

* Manage Hilton learning systems and ensure compliance with all required training and certification programmes.
* Maintain accurate training records, training reports, and compliance documentation.
* Monitor completion rates and effectiveness of mandatory, brand, safety, and compliance training.
* Ensure all learning activities meet company, legislative, and operational requirements.

Internship, Education & External Partnerships
  
  

* Develop strategic partnerships with educational institutions, hospitality schools, and training providers.
* Manage internship programmes, management trainee programmes, and industry attachment opportunities.
* Represent both hotels at learning, talent, and employer branding initiatives.
* Maintain active relationships with relevant government agencies and workforce development organizations.
* Stay informed on national training grants, funding schemes, and workforce development initiatives applicable to the hospitality industry.

Financial Management
  
  

* Prepare and manage the annual Cluster Learning & Development budget.
* Monitor monthly training expenditure and maximize training resources efficiently.

title: Head, Community Engagement & Partnerships
description:
The Head, Community Engagement & Partnerships is a key member of AMP’s management team, contributing significantly to AMP’s leadership by shaping organisational priorities, strengthening cross-functional collaboration and shared accountability, and fostering a cohesive and inclusive management culture across AMP and its entities.
  
  
The Head provides strategic leadership and oversight of AMP's programmes and service delivery, ensuring that initiatives are responsive to the needs of clients and aligned with the organisation's mission, strategic priorities, governance requirements, and service standards. The role oversees the planning, development, implementation, and evaluation of programmes to achieve meaningful and sustainable outcomes for the community.
  
  
The Head is responsible for ensuring programme quality, managing operational risks and resources, overseeing budget utilisation, and driving continuous improvement in service delivery. The role also leads workforce and volunteer planning, develops the capabilities of staff and volunteers, and fosters strategic partnerships with government agencies, community partners, and other stakeholders to strengthen programme effectiveness and community impact. Through a client-centric and strategic approach, the Head supports organisational excellence while advancing AMP's outreach and service objectives.
  
  
MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
1. Build Professional Partnerships and Collaborations
  
  
a) Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with other agencies, other organisations, and stakeholders to strengthen service delivery and create integrated support pathways for clients
  
  
b) Collaborate with external agencies and partners to co-design, implement, and enhance programmes that address emerging community needs and achieve desired social outcomes.
  
  
c) Develop and implement community outreach strategies to engage target client groups, strengthen community awareness, and expand the reach and impact of AMP's services.
  
  
d) Identify service gaps, emerging social trends, and community needs to inform programme development and improve the effectiveness of social service interventions.
  
  
e) Manage stakeholder engagement, communications, and feedback to foster strong relationships, gather insights, and drive continuous improvement in programmes and services.
  
  
f) Represent AMP in external engagements, sector discussions, and collaborative initiatives to promote AMP's interests, contribute to sector development, and strengthen partnerships across the social service ecosystem.
  
  
2. Planning, Theory of Change (ToC) and Programme Development

title: Analyst/ Associate, Internal Control
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG is seeking a dedicated Internal Control Professional to join their Planning Department, Internal Control and Administration team for GCIB in Singapore. This role offers you the opportunity to play a pivotal part in ensuring robust governance and effective control activities across the division. You will be at the heart of maintaining high standards of compliance, supporting business continuity, and safeguarding information security within one of the world’s leading financial institutions. MUFG values your commitment to accuracy, your collaborative spirit, and your ability to connect with stakeholders across departments. The organisation is renowned for its supportive leadership, inclusive culture, and ongoing training opportunities that empower you to grow professionally while contributing meaningfully to the team’s success.

* Join a globally respected financial institution where your attention to detail and commitment to quality will directly impact divisional governance and operational excellence.
* Work closely with diverse teams and stakeholders, fostering strong inter-personal connections and sharing knowledge to ensure seamless implementation of internal controls.
Benefit from MUFG’s commitment to professional development, working opportunities, and a supportive team environment that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.  

**What you'll do:**

As an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you will take on a multifaceted role spanning internal controls, governance, operational resilience and management support. Working closely with various departments, you will help ensure that GCIB maintains effective controls, appropriate governance standards and accurate control-related records.

  

Your responsibilities will include coordinating GCIB self-inspections, managing SOX reporting processes, tracking remediation actions and following up on findings through to closure. You will also coordinate business continuity management activities, including disaster recovery exercises, and maintain critical records such as call trees and next-of-kin information.

  

In addition to overseeing and driving greater consistency in SOPs and governance documentation on SharePoint, you will support non-system information security controls to help ensure appropriate standards for information handling are maintained. You will also monitor incidents and support timely escalation and reporting where required.

  

Your responsibilities will extend to vault governance, including record reconciliation and periodic access reviews, as well as the maintenance of authorities-related documentation, including Letters of Delegation of Authority, Deeds of Substitution and authorised signature lists.

  

You will also provide ad-hoc administrative and management support to help ensure the smooth running of the department. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, sound control awareness and the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders, while remaining flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities.

* Perform and coordinate GCIB self-inspection processes, SOX reporting and spreadsheet controls, including the management of findings, supporting evidence, remediation tracking and follow-up actions.

* Oversee and drive greater consistency in standard operating procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices and internal guidelines, and maintain related governance documentation on GCIB SharePoint.

* Perform and coordinate business continuity management activities, including business impact analysis, call tree and next-of-kin record maintenance, disaster recovery exercises and other related activities.

* Serve as PIC for non-system information security controls, including data-handling requirements and information security exceptions, in accordance with Bank policies.

* Serve as PIC for incident monitoring and reporting, ensuring timely escalation, communication and accurate documentation of events affecting divisional operations.

* Manage GCIB Vault governance, including regular record reconciliation, access reviews and implementation of relevant controls to safeguard sensitive materials.

* Serve as PIC for authorities-related governance, including Letters of Authority, Deeds of Substitution and Powers of Attorney, and maintain the division’s authorised signature list.

* Provide administrative and management support as assigned by the Head of Department or Management, including ad-hoc responsibilities that contribute to the effective operation of the team.

* Collaborate with relevant departments and stakeholders to support the timely and accurate implementation of internal requirements, Head Office procedures and Bank policies.

* Maintain robust control-related records and procedures and support effective governance across GCIB functions.

**What you bring:**

To excel as an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you bring proven experience from roles involving internal control or audit functions, ideally within financial services. Your academic background equips you with essential theoretical understanding while your practical experience ensures you can navigate complex regulatory environments confidently. You possess exceptional attention to detail which allows you not only to spot inconsistencies but also deliver high-quality results every time. Managing competing priorities under tight deadlines is second nature; you remain calm yet responsive even when demands escalate. Communication is one of your strengths—you engage openly with colleagues at all levels fostering trustful relationships that drive collective achievement. Professionalism defines how you handle sensitive matters; integrity guides every decision you make. Your proactive attitude means you anticipate needs before they arise while collaborating seamlessly within teams regardless of pace or change. Technical proficiency across Microsoft tools supports your daily workflow; familiarity with business continuity practices further enhances your contribution during emergencies or disruptions. Ultimately your blend of analytical skills, interpersonal abilities, industry knowledge and unwavering commitment, makes you an invaluable asset for this role.

* Degree qualification is required for this position
* For Analyst: a minimum of three years’ experience in internal control, audit (internal or external), risk management, compliance or governance roles, preferably within a financial institution is essential for success.
* For Associate: a minimum of five years’ experience in internal control, audit (internal or external), risk management, compliance or governance roles, preferably within a financial institution is essential for success.
* Your strong attention to detail enables you to critically review information, identify gaps promptly, and deliver accurate outputs consistently.
* The ability to manage multiple priorities under strict timelines demonstrates your organisational skills and commitment to dependable follow-through.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills allow you to work confidently with management as well as stakeholders across departments and locations.
* Professionalism, integrity, and discretion are vital when handling confidential or sensitive information within the organisation.
* A proactive approach combined with collaborative teamwork ensures you adapt comfortably in fast-paced environments while supporting colleagues effectively.

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot, to support effective record-keeping, collaboration, and communication.
Experience supporting business continuity management activities adds value by enhancing operational resilience within the division. Familiarity with incident monitoring/reporting processes strengthens your ability to respond quickly during critical situations.  

  

**What sets this company apart:**

MUFG stands out as one of the world’s largest financial groups committed to delivering excellence through responsible banking practices. The company fosters an inclusive workplace where every team member’s voice is valued, encouraging collaboration across departments regardless of hierarchy or location. MUFG’s dedication to integrity permeates every aspect of its operations; employees are trusted partners who contribute meaningfully toward shared goals without compromising ethical standards. By joining MUFG’s Singapore office within GCIB’s Internal Control & Administration team you become part of a global network united by mutual respect, a place where knowledge-sharing thrives alongside innovation in governance practices.  

  

**What's next:**

  

If you are ready to take the next step in your career journey with MUFG’s Internal Control and Administration team in Singapore, apply now!

  

Apply today by clicking on the link provided below.

  

*We regret to inform that only shortlisted applicants will be notified.*

Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG) is an equal opportunity employer. We view our employees as our key assets as they are fundamental to our long-term growth and success. MUFG is committed to hiring based on merit and organsational fit, regardless of race, religion or gender.

description:

**About the Role**
------------------

Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) is looking for a driven and detail-oriented Manager to support our Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Business Continuity Management (BCM) programmes. In this role, you will play a central part in safeguarding the hospital's ability to deliver care, protecting our patients, staff, and operations from disruption and risk. If you thrive at the intersection of strategic thinking and hands-on programme management, this is a role where your work genuinely matters.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Drive risk management efforts across all departments, ensuring the hospital remains compliant with the National Healthcare Group (NHG) Enterprise Risk Management Policy, and report on risk activities to the Assigned Risk Lead and the Institution Risk Steering Committee.
* Prepare Key Risk Reports for senior governance bodies including TTSH's Senior Management Meeting and the NHG Board, aggregate clinical and non-clinical risks across all domains and moderate risk scores to ensure accurate representation.
* Analyse the hospital's operating environment following significant developments, interpret relevant BCM threats from the institution risk register, and review and update plans and strategies with the BCM Workgroup, Heads of Departments, and department BCM coordinators to ensure critical business functions can be recovered during a disruptive event.
* During a business continuity plan activation, serve as the key interface between Management and response teams. Provide accurate situational analysis and advising on the measures needed to recover critical business functions across affected departments.
* Build organisation-wide risk awareness by training staff, risk coordinators, and Heads of Departments, and review risk criteria and matrices to ensure they remain relevant to the institution.
* Plan and implement training programmes for department BCM coordinators, organise BCM awareness workshops, and contribute to intra-cluster learning and sharing sessions.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* A degree holder with experience in ERM and/or BCM .We value the quality of your experience over the number of years.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex risks, synthesise findings, and communicate them clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Someone who exercises sound judgement and discretion in ambiguous situations, with strong communication and interpersonal skills to work effectively across all levels of the organisation.
* Comfortable working in a structured, compliance-driven environment while also being proactive and solutions-focused.

**Nice-to-Haves**
-----------------

* Experience in emergency preparedness, including training, coordination, or project management.
* Professional certifications in ERM and/or relevant BCM accreditation (e.g., ISO 22301, BCCS, ISO 31000, COSO or equivalent).
* Prior experience in a healthcare or public sector setting.

description:

The Guestbook is the world's largest and fastest-growing loyalty program for independent and boutique brand hotels. To grow our hotel partner network across Asia-Pacific (APAC), we are in search of a Regional Development Manager who will be the consistent face of The Guestbook for hotels across APAC, from first conversation to long-term partnership.

You will engage hotel leads supplied by our lead generation team through outreach campaigns, book demos, and hand qualified opportunities to our Partnerships Team. As hotels join the program, you will onboard and train them, run regular performance reviews, and help them grow their direct booking revenue.

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Southeast Asia, such as Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, or the Philippines. * Gather feedback and represent the voice of APAC hotel partners in decisions across the Product, Marketing, and Partnerships Teams

* Travel from time to time for regional tradeshows, conferences, hotel association events, partner visits, and Team meetings

title: Safeguarding Controller - APAC
description:
Working alongside an existing team of Safeguarding specialists and reporting to the Global Safeguarding Accountable Owner, your role is to assist each of the existing controllers and product managers in ensuring the APAC safeguarding control framework runs smoothly. The role will span across both safeguarding for payments and e-money and investment business and offers a fantastic opportunity to learn about the handovers between the regimes. You will also be joining at an exciting time of product growth and expansion..
  
  
Your Mission
  
  
You will play a crucial role in ensuring that new product launches are compliant with safeguarding regulations and controlled in a proportionate manner
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring completeness of our policies and procedures and coordinate with individual controllers to obtain attestations of the controls operation and alignment to the controls framework
  
  
You will be responsible for coordinating and implementing a first line of defence assurance for APAC safeguarding controls
  
  
You will be responsible for maintaining the APAC safeguarding risk and controls matrix for the APAC entities
  
  
You will be the first point of escalation of discrepancies identified by the Reconciliations team for safeguarding reconciliations and provide SME advise on their resolution and treatment
  
  
You will be involved in the incidents management process and link incidents to control failures, which will enable senior management to see themes within the control environment
  
  
You will be responsible for MAS regulatory reporting and other safeguarding regulatory reporting preparation
  
  
You will be responsible for the annual safeguarding audit coordination
  
  
You will help document, challenge and build an end-to-end view of our internal control environment to illustrate key risks, controls and processes. This will all be done within our internal risk management software
  
  
Opportunities
  
  
Own your own path of success - You’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
  
  
Grow with the role - You will have the exposure and opportunity to speak to key senior members of the organisation getting into the details of remediation steps. You will be able to develop your technical skills and knowledge by being involved in several change management programmes relating to regulatory uplifts across different territories as well as related to implementing new products or features working with our engineering team to ensure these are safeguarding compliant.
  
  
Stepping stone - This role provides an excellent platform for someone looking to step into the safeguarding function of a fast-growing Fintech.
  
  
Develop an in-depth knowledge of Wise’s business - Get to know many teams across the business as you partner with them as part of day-to-day activities.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**A bit about you:**  
Technical knowledge - You have 5-8 years CASS (Client Assets Sourcebook) / Customer Moneys and Assets Protection (CMAP) framework experience in APAC (Singapore preferred) across investment business and payments.
  
  
Theory - You have strong understanding of Payments Services Act (PSA) under MAS.
  
  
Practice - You have sound writing skills and ability to convey regulation in a clear manner to fellow colleagues who are not SMEs and communicate key risks related to these regulations
  
  
Love getting things done - You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take responsibility to do whatever needs doing to solve problems. You take a proactive approach in resolving complex issues. We get it done!
  
  
Commercial acumen - You understand the value of taking a balanced approach to risk and controls to support the growth of the business.
  
  
Collaborative - You work well in a multinational team environment and know how to have an impact through others. No Drama Good Karma!
  
  
Development - You are keen to learn and develop your knowledge of how a FinTech and fast growing scale-up operates.
  
  
Our Safeguarding team is spread across the globe, but mainly in London and Tallinn, so there are some video calls and some travel involved for treasury wide initiatives.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
  
  
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
  
  
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
  
  
What it’s really like to work here
  
  
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
  
  
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
  
  
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

title: Product Sales Operations Manager - Satellite Connectivity & Terminal Solutions
description:
Extend Networks (X10)
  
  
delivers next-generation satellite network infrastructure and intelligent user terminal solutions across multi-orbit constellations (GEO, MEO, and LEO). We are pioneering the concept of a fully integrated satellite and cellular based Network-as-a-Service infrastructure solution. This ground-breaking model was developed to meet the demanding business and mission critical needs. As part of our APAC expansion, we are looking for someone who thrives on breaking new ground and is ready to own our product and sales operations cycles across the region.
  
  
ROLE SUMMARY
  
  
We are seeking a technically grounded Product/Sales Operations Manager specializing in satellite networks and user terminals. Serving as the critical bridge between product engineering, sales team and customers, you will shape solution designs of end-to-end terminal-to-teleport architectures, keep product and project documentation accurate, build compelling vertical use cases, and translate customer operational needs into scalable product roadmaps.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
Network & Terminal Solution Design (Pre/Post-Sales)
  
  

* End-to-End Architecture Design: Architect tailored satellite connectivity solutions spanning user terminals, RF subsystems, satellite modems/routers, and ground hubs.
* RFx & Technical Proposals: Lead technical responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, producing detailed system diagrams, bill-of-materials (BoM) pricing, and commercial packaging (CapEx, OpEx, and Hardware-as-a-Service models).
* PoCs & Field Trials: Scope, coordinate, and evaluate customer proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments, over-the-air (OTA) terminal demonstrations, and factory acceptance tests (FAT).

Product Documentation & Vertical Use Cases
  
  

* Technical Product Documentation: Author, maintain, and standardize customer-facing product documentation, including terminal datasheets, network architecture whitepapers, SLAs, installation/commissioning guides, and release notes.
* Use Case Development: Define, validate, and document vertical-specific operational use cases (e.g., maritime fleet digitalization, cellular backhaul, emergency response, and multi-orbit primary/backup failover) to demonstrate clear business value and ROI.
* Sales Enablement Collateral: Create reusable pre-sales toolkits, solution blueprints, reference designs, competitive battle cards, and technical presentation decks for internal sales teams and global channel partners.

Project Administration
  
  

* Customer Interface: Lead customer project implementation. Deliver full lifecycle and driving seamless onboarding and issues resolution. Support project managers and delivery teams with scheduling, milestone tracking, risk and issue logs, and status reporting.
* Manage purchase orders, vendor and supplier coordination, shipping and logistics, and customs or export documentation where relevant.
* Oversee contract administration: order forms, change requests, renewals, and acceptance signoffs.
* Tracking: project budgets, invoicing milestones, and handover to operations and support.

Product Lifecycle & Ecosystem Management
  
  

* Product Design Support: Design and perform sustainable end-to-end network sizing to support scalable product deployments and long-term capacity growth
* Voice-of-Customer (VoC) & Roadmap Input: Capture market feedback on terminal requirements, tracking performance, and network management features to feedback into product roadmaps.
* Multi-Orbit & SD-WAN Integration: Define requirements for multi-orbit handover logic (GEO/MEO/LEO), WAN bonding, SD-WAN orchestration, QoS traffic shaping, and cloud-based NMS.
* Compliance & Type Approvals: Collaborate with regulators, engineering team, and satellite operators to ensure terminal certifications, type approvals, and export compliance.

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
  
  
Preferred Experience & Skills
  
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/RF Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent industry experience).
* Industry Background: 7+ years of experience in product management, pre-sales solutions architecture, or systems engineering within satellite communications, VSAT, or wireless telecom.
* Terminal & Modem Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with satellite terminal hardware (stabilized maritime antennas, land-mobile/COTM, flat-panel ESAs) and hub/modem platforms (e.g., ST Engineering iDirect, Hughes, Gilat, Comtech).
* Networking & RF Fundamentals: Solid understanding of RF link budgets, DVB-S2X/TDMA waveforms, IP networking, and terminal control protocols.
* Documentation & Storytelling: Proven track record of writing clear technical documentation, solution briefs, and commercial use cases tailored to both C-level buyers and network engineers.
* Technical Writing Tools & Network sizing: Proficiency in diagramming and documentation tools alongside link budget modeling software.
* Commercial Acumen: Experience structuring managed service SLAs, airtime/terminal bundles, and total cost of ownership (TCO) models.

Extend Networks is a leading communication system integrator focused on difficult last-mile communications infrastructure solutions.

* Coordinate Regional merchandising deliverables across key seasonal milestones, ensuring pre-season and country inputs are received, consolidated and communicated on time.
* Maintain seasonal assortment tools, line lists, VLPs and other key merchandising documents.
* Act as a key Regional point of contact for product-related communication between Global and APAC Pre-Season and country teams.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

* Experience managing seasonal product assortments and working through structured merchandising calendars.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and product performance data.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and navigating ambiguity.

description:
**WHO WE ARE:**
===============

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

**About the Department**
========================

Markets Operations supports Global Markets across the trade lifecycle, including pre-settlement and post-settlement processing, confirmations, investigations, static data, controls and documentation. Singapore serves as a regional centre of excellence and supports selected APAC branches and subsidiaries through a centralized operating model.

The department is progressing its transformation agenda through process re-engineering, automation, straight-through processing, stronger data governance and disciplined risk management, while continuing to deliver timely and reliable service to internal and external stakeholders.

  

**Role Purpose**
================

Maintain accurate, complete and controlled static and reference data used by Treasury platforms and downstream processes, enabling reliable trade capture, accounting, confirmation, settlement and reporting.

  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Create and maintain approved counterparty, issuer, instrument, security, settlement-instruction, calendar, portfolio, product and other reference-data records in Murex, TSDS and relevant platforms.

* Review requests for completeness, validity and required approvals before processing, and clarify incomplete or ambiguous instructions with requestors.

* Perform maker or checker activities in accordance with segregation-of-duties requirements and maintain clear before-and-after evidence.

* Apply data standards, naming conventions, mapping rules and effective dates consistently across systems and entities.

* Monitor static-data requests and exception queues, prioritize time-critical requests, and meet agreed service levels and operational cut-offs.

* Investigate data issues and downstream breaks, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate remediation and prevent recurrence.

* Maintain controlled repositories for validated settlement instructions and supporting records, and ensure changes are traceable and auditable.

* Support periodic control activities such as dormant-record reviews, access reviews, data-quality checks, reconciliations and procedure reviews.

* Assess static-data implications for new products, new entities, system changes and projects; participate in requirements gathering, testing and implementation.

* Work with Global Markets, Operations, Finance, Risk, Compliance, Technology and external data providers to resolve data dependencies and control gaps.

* Identify opportunities to automate data sourcing, validation, enrichment, publication, monitoring and exception handling.

* Maintain current procedures and reference guides; support training, cross-skilling, business continuity and knowledge transfer.

* Comply with Bank policies, data-governance standards, operational risk requirements and applicable regulatory obligations.

  

**Skills and Experience**
=========================

* Degree or equivalent professional qualification preferred.

* Good knowledge of Treasury products such as securities, derivatives, foreign exchange and money markets.

* Good understanding of front-to-back trade processing and the related operational risks and controls.

* Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with sound judgement and accountability.

* Able to prioritize effectively and work accurately in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment.

* Improvement-oriented mindset with an interest in automation, data quality and operational efficiency.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with Murex, SWIFT or other Treasury platforms is advantageous.

* Experience in static data, reference data, instrument or counterparty setup, settlement instructions, or Treasury systems is advantageous.

* High level of attention to detail and an understanding of how data changes affect trade processing, accounting, settlement and reporting.

  

**Working Requirements**
========================

* The role may require support outside standard business hours, including selected public holidays or weekends, based on product and market coverage.

* Location is in Tampines.

  

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Accurate and timely completion of assigned activities within agreed service levels and cut-off times.

* Prompt identification, escalation and resolution of exceptions, with clear audit trails.

* Consistent adherence to maker-checker controls, procedures, operational risk standards and regulatory requirements.

* Constructive collaboration across teams and active contribution to process improvement, automation and team capability building.

**What we offer:**
==================

Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

title: AI Reliability Engineer I - APAC
description:
About Nscale
  
  
Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.
  
  
At Nscale, our Support and Operations team plays a critical role in maintaining service availability, driving service reliability and rapid response to customer tickets.
  
  
We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you’ll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you’ll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.
  
  
What You'll be Doing
  
  
Join the Support duty rotation and handle day-to-day tickets and alerts, escalating early and appropriately. Collaborate with Engineering, with guidance, when incidents or changes require it
  
  
**Perform GPU node triage and hardware troubleshooting:** interpret nvidia-smi/DCGM output and system logs, isolate faults across GPU, NIC, and server hardware, carry out physical remediation (reseats, swap testing, component checks), and prepare clean evidence for vendor RMA
  
  
Run fabric and link diagnostics following established runbooks (mlxlink or equivalent), capture evidence accurately, and escalate with a handover that lets the next engineer continue without starting from scratch
  
  
Assist with storage and data-path investigations (mounts, connectivity, client-side symptoms) on high-performance platforms, gathering evidence for Senior or Engineering-led diagnosis
  
  
Follow established runbooks to resolve common issues; propose improvements and contribute incremental fixes with review
  
  
Accurately record, update, manage, and resolve tickets, keeping all parties informed with clear notes, next steps, and customer communications via the agreed channels
  
  
Participate in monitoring, troubleshooting, and triage. Capture logs and facts to enable efficient handover
  
  
Participate in changes under peer review, learning risk assessment and backout practices in live customer environments
  
  
Help maintain source-of-truth accuracy across DCIM, inventory, and asset records (NetBox or similar patterns)
  
  
Identify opportunities for automation and contribute simple scripts and tooling improvements to optimise processes
  
  
Be the escalation point for onsite DC Operations staff; coordinate smart-hands tasks within your scope
  
  
Learn the Platform fundamentals so you can help customers get value from our services, asking for support when deeper expertise is needed
  
  
Share knowledge by documenting steps you've validated and contributing to training materials. Shadow Seniors during complex work to build capability
  
  
Take part in incident reviews as a contributor and help track preventative follow-ups in your scope
  
  
Deliver assigned tasks and project work to agreed quality and timelines. Flag blockers early and seek help when needed
  
  
Participate in on-call and out-of-hours work when scheduled and after onboarding. Travel to Nscale or customer locations to assist with deployments, troubleshooting, and operational tasks, and attend supplier training as required.
  
  
About You
  
  
3+ years in infrastructure support or support engineering, including support/service desk experience in structured, SLA-driven, customer-facing environments (cloud, data centre, or managed services)
  
  
Clear written notes, concise updates, and reliable follow-through. Able to explain technical issues accurately to customers and colleagues, and produce handovers the next shift can act on immediately
  
  
GPU and hardware troubleshooting.
  
  
**Working knowledge of GPU infrastructure:** hands-on with nvidia-smi or similar diagnostics, comfortable interpreting hardware error output and logs, and confident physically troubleshooting servers — reseating components, swap testing, working via BMC/out-of-band management — through to preparing RMA evidence. A strong technical base here is required, not a learning goal
  
  
**Solid working knowledge:** confident on the CLI with systemd, filesystems, permissions, and standard networking tools. Able to troubleshoot common issues independently and know when to escalate
  
  
Solid grasp of IP addressing, subnets, VLANs, routing, DNS, and firewalls. Awareness of high-performance east-west fabrics (RDMA/InfiniBand concepts) is a plus and a core growth area in this role
  
  
Ticketing and ITSM discipline.
  
  
Experience working within structured support processes (ITIL or similar): prioritisation, escalation, SLA awareness, and accurate documentation
  
  
Observability foundations.
  
  
Able to use dashboards and alerts to identify symptoms, gather evidence, and follow runbooks. Comfortable proposing simple alert or dashboard improvements with review
  
  
Scripting and automation basics.
  
  
Comfortable reading and writing simple Bash or Python, and using Git for version control
  
  
Platform and DC fundamentals.
  
  
Understanding of servers, networks, storage, and virtualisation concepts, ideally from a support or operations background
  
  
Growth mindset.
  
  
Curious, dependable, and collaborative. You seek feedback, ask questions, and invest in learning to progress toward Senior
  
  
Able to work in a fast-moving environment with evolving processes, participate in on-call after onboarding, and travel when needed
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
High-performance fabrics and GPU-HPC.
  
  
Exposure to RDMA/InfiniBand, link-level diagnostics (mlxlink, ibdiagnet, or equivalent), NCCL-based troubleshooting, or NVLink concepts
  
  
High-performance storage.
  
  
Exposure to VAST or comparable AI-optimised storage platforms, Ceph, or NFS at scale, including basic storage–network troubleshooting
  
  
OpenStack and fleet operations tooling.
  
  
Familiarity with OpenStack troubleshooting flows, or fleet-scale tooling for provisioning and health (MAAS, NetBox, Redfish, or similar)
  
  
Understanding of core concepts (nodes, pods, services, logs) and basic troubleshooting via runbooks. Helpful context for our platform, though not the core of this role
  
  
Automation and access tooling.
  
  
Experience with Ansible or Terraform, CI/CD participation (GitHub Actions or similar), or access and security tooling such as Teleport or Vault
  
  
Progress toward relevant Linux, networking, Kubernetes, cloud, or security certifications over time
  
  
In All We Do, Our Core Values Guide Us
  
  
Relentless Innovation
  
  
At Nscale, we constantly push the boundaries of innovation, embracing creative risks to shape the future. Our aim is to deliver products that not only meet but exceed today’s expectations, setting new standards for tomorrow.
  
  
Ownership and Accountability
  
  
Every Nscaler is fully accountable for their work, driving it with excellence and urgency. We set high standards, ensuring that our contributions are not just good but exceptional.
  
  
Openness and Transparency
  
  
We believe trust and transparency are key to our success. We maintain open communication within our teams and with stakeholders, sharing both successes and challenges. Our open-source approach allows customers to explore our technology, building trust and ensuring our solutions are both innovative, secure, and reliable.
  
  
Customer-Centric Focus
  
  
Our customers are central to our mission, and we are committed to delivering impactful solutions that drive real-world success. We focus on deeply understanding their needs and challenges, striving to exceed expectations in both product quality and service.
  
  
Sustainability
  
  
We are dedicated to considering the long-term environmental and societal impacts of our technologies. By integrating sustainability into our operations and product development, we ensure that our innovations are both effective and responsible, contributing positively to the world around us.
  
  
Full-Speed Collaboration
  
  
Collaboration at Nscale is fast, efficient, and respectful. We work together seamlessly, with clear communication and mutual respect, ensuring our shared goals are met with high standards and impactful outcomes.
  
  
Equal Opportunities Statement
  
  
We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.
  
  
If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
